source.text: Ἤγγιζεν δὲ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων ἡ λεγομένη Πάσχα.

records.literal_gloss: Was drawing near now the feast of the unleavened [bread], the [one] being called Passover.

en.L: Now the feast of Unleavened Bread, the [one] called Passover, was drawing near.
en.B: Now the time was drawing near for the feast of Unleavened Bread, which is known as the Passover.
en.R: It was almost time for the Feast of Unleavened Bread. This feast was also called the Passover.

es.L: Y se acercaba la fiesta de los Ázimos, la llamada Pascua.
es.B: Se acercaba la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura, que se conoce como la Pascua.
es.R: Faltaba poco para la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura. Esta fiesta también se llamaba la Pascua.

fr.L: Or la fête des Pains sans levain, celle qu’on appelle la Pâque, approchait.
fr.B: Le moment approchait de la fête des Pains sans levain, qu’on appelle aussi la Pâque.
fr.R: C’était bientôt la fête des Pains sans levain. On appelait aussi cette fête la Pâque.

sw.L: Basi ilikuwa inakaribia Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, iitwayo Pasaka.
sw.B: Wakati wa Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, inayojulikana kama Pasaka, ulikuwa unakaribia.
sw.R: Ilikuwa karibu wakati wa Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Sikukuu hii iliitwa pia Pasaka.

vi.L: Bấy giờ, lễ [Bánh] Không Men, gọi là Lễ Vượt Qua, đang đến gần.
vi.B: Bấy giờ đã gần đến Lễ Bánh Không Men, cũng gọi là Lễ Vượt Qua.
vi.R: Sắp đến Lễ Bánh Không Men. Lễ này cũng được gọi là Lễ Vượt Qua.

ko.L: 그런데 유월절이라고 하는, 누룩 없는 [빵]의 명절이 다가오고 있었다.
ko.B: 유월절이라고 하는 무교절이 다가오고 있었다.
ko.R: 무교절, 곧 누룩 없는 빵을 먹는 명절이 거의 다 되었다. 이 명절은 유월절이라고도 불렸다.

pt.L: E aproximava-se a festa dos Pães sem Fermento, a chamada Páscoa.
pt.B: Estava chegando a festa dos Pães sem Fermento, que é conhecida como Páscoa.
pt.R: Estava quase na época da festa dos Pães sem Fermento. Essa festa também era chamada de Páscoa.

decisions.choice: the feast of Unleavened Bread, called Passover: one festival season under two names
alternatives: two separate feasts at different times
decisions.reason: The Passover lamb was killed on the fourteenth day of the first month and eaten that night; the seven days of eating bread made without yeast followed at once (Exodus 12:1-20; Leviticus 23:5-8). Because they ran together, the whole season could be called by either name. It remembered how God brought Israel out of Egypt.

decisions.choice: was drawing near: the feast was close but had not yet begun
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense pictures the feast approaching. It arrives in 22:7.

decisions.choice: la fiesta de los Ázimos (L); la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura (B, R)
alternatives: la fiesta del Pan sin Levadura
decisions.reason: One festival season under two names (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the short traditional name "los Ázimos"; Balanced and Readable say what it is, the term used through the Gospels.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple (L, B) and the passé composé (R), with the imperfect for background ("approchait", "cherchaient"); speech in the passé composé at every level
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Luke: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative and suits a careful public reading; Readable tells the story as French is spoken today. What Jesus and the others say keeps the tenses of speech at every level. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: la fête des Pains sans levain; la Pâque
decisions.reason: "Les Azymes" is the traditional church word but is unknown to most readers; "Pains sans levain" says what they were. The Jewish feast is "la Pâque", singular, never the Christian "Pâques" (m1).

decisions.choice: Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu
decisions.reason: One festival season under two names (meaning decision m1). The name used through the Gospels: it says plainly that the bread has no yeast.

decisions.choice: "Lễ Bánh Không Men" and "Lễ Vượt Qua"
decisions.reason: The names used in the Vietnamese Mark 14:1 and John; Literal brackets "Bánh", which the Greek leaves to be understood.

decisions.choice: "누룩 없는 [빵]의 명절" (L); "무교절" (B, R), explained once at Readable
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "the feast of the unleavened [things]"; Literal shows that, bracketing the bread, while Balanced and Readable use "무교절", the established Korean name of the feast, as the Korean Mark 14:1 does.

source.text: καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὸ πῶς ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν, ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν.

records.literal_gloss: And were seeking the chief priests and the scribes the how they might put to death him, they were afraid for of the people.

en.L: And the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how they might put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to death, for they feared the people.
en.B: The chief priests and the scribes were looking for some way to put {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to death, because they were afraid of the people.
en.R: The chief priests and the teachers of the law were trying to find a way to kill Jesus. But they were afraid of what the people might do.

es.L: Y buscaban los principales sacerdotes y los escribas cómo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} eliminarían, porque temían al pueblo.
es.B: Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los escribas buscaban la manera de darle muerte, porque tenían miedo del pueblo.
es.R: Los jefes de los sacerdotes y los maestros de la ley buscaban la manera de matar a Jesús. Pero tenían miedo de lo que pudiera hacer la gente.

fr.L: Et les chefs des prêtres et les scribes cherchaient comment ils pourraient {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire mourir, car ils craignaient le peuple.
fr.B: Les chefs des prêtres et les scribes cherchaient un moyen de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} faire mourir, car ils avaient peur du peuple.
fr.R: Les chefs des prêtres et les spécialistes de la Loi cherchaient un moyen de tuer Jésus. Mais ils avaient peur de la réaction du peuple.

sw.L: Na wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi walikuwa wakitafuta jinsi ya kumwua, kwa maana waliwaogopa watu.
sw.B: Wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi walikuwa wakitafuta njia ya kumwua, kwa sababu waliwaogopa watu.
sw.R: Wakuu wa makuhani na walimu wa sheria walikuwa wakitafuta njia ya kumwua Yesu. Lakini waliogopa watu wangefanya nini.

vi.L: Và các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo tìm cách làm sao giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì họ sợ dân chúng.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy thông giáo tìm cách giết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì họ sợ dân chúng.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ cả và các thầy dạy luật tìm cách giết Đức Giê-xu. Nhưng họ sợ dân chúng sẽ phản ứng.

ko.L: 그리고 대제사장들과 율법학자들은 어떻게 하면 그분을 죽일 수 있을지 찾고 있었다. 그들이 백성을 두려워하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 대제사장들과 율법학자들은 예수를 죽일 방법을 찾고 있었다. 그들은 백성을 두려워하였기 때문이다.
ko.R: 대제사장들과 율법학자들은 예수를 죽일 방법을 찾고 있었다. 그러나 그들은 백성이 어떻게 나올지 두려웠다.

pt.L: E os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas procuravam como {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} eliminar, pois temiam o povo.
pt.B: Os chefes dos sacerdotes e os escribas procuravam um jeito de {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} matar, porque tinham medo do povo.
pt.R: Os chefes dos sacerdotes e os mestres da Lei estavam tentando achar um jeito de matar Jesus. Mas eles tinham medo do que o povo podia fazer.

decisions.choice: put to death: kill, here by having him executed
alternatives: get rid of in some other way
decisions.reason: The verb means to do away with someone, usually by killing. The leaders' plan has been growing since 19:47-48 and 20:19.

decisions.choice: they feared the people: the crowds who listened to Jesus in the temple
decisions.reason: Luke has just said that all the people came early to hear him in the temple (21:38). An open arrest during the feast might start a riot, so they needed to take him quietly (22:6).

decisions.choice: afraid of what the people might do
decisions.reason: Readable says what the leaders feared from the people (m2).

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and clitics (lo, le, me, él, su), not on verb endings or joined clitics (darle)
alternatives: a span wherever the English has one
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject pronoun out and joins some object pronouns to the verb, where there is nothing separate to capitalise. So the setting covers fewer words than in English. This holds for the whole chapter.

decisions.choice: los escribas (L, B); los maestros de la ley (R)
decisions.reason: The term used through the Gospels; Readable says what they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on verb prefixes (kumwua); spans only on free pronouns and possessives (yeye, wake, nami, kwangu)
alternatives: a span wherever the English has one
decisions.reason: Swahili carries "him" and "he" in the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives, as its style guide says. Swahili therefore has fewer spans than English throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: waandishi (L, B); walimu wa sheria (R)
decisions.reason: The term used through the Gospels; Readable says what they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các thầy tế lễ cả" (L, B, R); "các thầy thông giáo" (L, B), "các thầy dạy luật" (R)
decisions.reason: The Protestant terms settled for the Gospels, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:1; Readable says plainly what the scribes did.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, through Luke 22; the narrative honours Jesus with "께서" and -시- ("그분" at Literal), Jesus speaks in 해라체, the disciples speak to him in 합쇼체, he prays to the Father in 합쇼체, and his open opponents speak to him in 해라체
alternatives: Korean spans for pronouns referring to Jesus
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (Korean style guide, sections 4 and 7); the speech levels are those settled for the Korean Gospels and used in the Korean Mark 14.

decisions.choice: "대제사장들", "율법학자들" at every level, Readable included
alternatives: "율법 교사들" (R), as the English Readable's "teachers of the law"
decisions.reason: The terms settled for the Korean Gospels (Mark 14:1); both are plain enough for Readable.

source.text: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Σατανᾶς εἰς Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Ἰσκαριώτην, ὄντα ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τῶν δώδεκα·

records.literal_gloss: Entered then Satan into Judas the [one] being called Iscariot, being of the number of the Twelve;

en.L: Then Satan entered into Judas, the [one] called Iscariot, who was of the number of the Twelve.
en.B: Then Satan entered into Judas, the one called Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
en.R: Then Satan went into Judas, the one called Iscariot. Judas was one of the twelve apostles.

es.L: Y entró Satanás en Judas, el llamado Iscariote, que era del número de los Doce.
es.B: Entonces Satanás entró en Judas, el llamado Iscariote, que era uno de los Doce.
es.R: Entonces Satanás entró en Judas, al que llamaban Iscariote. Judas era uno de los doce apóstoles.

fr.L: Or Satan entra dans Judas, celui qu’on appelait Iscariot, qui était du nombre des Douze.
fr.B: Alors Satan entra en Judas, appelé Iscariot, qui était l’un des Douze.
fr.R: Alors Satan est entré dans Judas, celui qu’on appelait Iscariot. Judas était l’un des douze apôtres.

sw.L: Basi Shetani alimwingia Yuda, aitwaye Iskariote, aliyekuwa wa hesabu ya wale Kumi na Wawili.
sw.B: Kisha Shetani alimwingia Yuda, aliyeitwa Iskariote, ambaye alikuwa mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili.
sw.R: Kisha Shetani alimwingia Yuda, aliyeitwa Iskariote. Yuda alikuwa mmoja wa mitume kumi na wawili.

vi.L: Bấy giờ Sa-tan nhập vào Giu-đa, người được gọi là Ích-ca-ri-ốt, là người thuộc trong số [nhóm] Mười Hai.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Sa-tan nhập vào Giu-đa, người được gọi là Ích-ca-ri-ốt, một người trong nhóm Mười Hai.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Sa-tan nhập vào Giu-đa, cũng gọi là Ích-ca-ri-ốt. Giu-đa là một trong mười hai môn đồ.

ko.L: 그런데 사탄이, 열둘의 수에 속한 사람으로서 가룟이라고 불리는 유다에게 들어갔다.
ko.B: 그때 사탄이 열두 제자 가운데 하나인, 가룟이라고 하는 유다에게 들어갔다.
ko.R: 그때 사탄이 가룟 유다에게 들어갔다. 유다는 예수의 열두 제자 가운데 하나였다.

pt.L: Então Satanás entrou em Judas, o chamado Iscariotes, que era do número dos Doze.
pt.B: Então Satanás entrou em Judas, aquele que era chamado Iscariotes, que era um dos Doze.
pt.R: Então Satanás entrou em Judas, o chamado Iscariotes. Judas era um dos doze apóstolos.

decisions.choice: Satan entered Judas: Satan took hold of him and used him
alternatives: only a figure of speech for Judas' own evil choice
decisions.reason: Luke says plainly that Satan was at work, yet Judas still acts and is held responsible (22:22). After testing Jesus in the wilderness, the devil left him until a fitting time (4:13); now he returns. John says the same of Judas at the supper (John 13:2, 27).

decisions.choice: Iscariot: a second name that marked Judas off from the other Judas among the Twelve
alternatives: a known meaning such as "man of Kerioth"
decisions.reason: There was another apostle named Judas (6:16). What "Iscariot" meant is not certain; one common view is "man from Kerioth", a town in Judea (Joshua 15:25).

decisions.choice: of the number of the Twelve: one of the inner circle Jesus chose
decisions.reason: Luke stresses that the betrayer came from the twelve whom Jesus named apostles (6:13-16).

decisions.choice: the twelve apostles
decisions.reason: Readable says who "the Twelve" were (6:13).

decisions.choice: "[nhóm] Mười Hai" (L); "nhóm Mười Hai" (B); "mười hai môn đồ" (R); "nhập vào"
decisions.reason: The forms settled for the Twelve, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:10; Readable keeps "môn đồ" with the other Gospels, though the English Readable says "apostles". "Nhập vào" is the verb of John 13:27 for Satan entering Judas.

decisions.choice: "사탄" for satanas; "열둘" (L), "열두 제자" (B, R) for the Twelve
alternatives: "열두 사도" (R), as the English Readable's "twelve apostles"
decisions.reason: "사탄" for satanas and "마귀" for diabolos, as settled for the Korean Luke and Matthew; the Twelve are named as in the Korean Mark 14:10.

source.text: καὶ ἀπελθὼν συνελάλησεν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ στρατηγοῖς τὸ πῶς αὐτοῖς παραδῷ αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And having gone away he spoke with the chief priests and captains the how to them he might hand over him.

en.L: And going away, he discussed with the chief priests and captains how he might hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to them.
en.B: He went off and talked with the chief priests and the temple officers about how he could betray {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to them.
en.R: Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard. He talked with them about how he could help them arrest Jesus.

es.L: Y yéndose, conversó con los principales sacerdotes y [los] capitanes sobre cómo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregaría a ellos.
es.B: Fue y habló con los jefes de los sacerdotes y con los oficiales del templo sobre cómo podría traicionarlo y ponerlo en sus manos.
es.R: Judas fue a ver a los jefes de los sacerdotes y a los oficiales de la guardia del templo. Habló con ellos sobre cómo podía ayudarles a arrestar a Jesús.

fr.L: Et s’en étant allé, il s’entretint avec les chefs des prêtres et les commandants sur la manière dont il {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} leur livrerait.
fr.B: Il alla discuter avec les chefs des prêtres et les officiers du temple de la manière dont il pourrait {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} leur livrer par trahison.
fr.R: Judas est allé voir les chefs des prêtres et les officiers de la garde du temple. Il a parlé avec eux de la façon dont il pourrait les aider à arrêter Jésus.

sw.L: Naye akienda zake, alizungumza na wakuu wa makuhani na wakuu wa walinzi jinsi atakavyomkabidhi kwao.
sw.B: Akaenda, akazungumza na wakuu wa makuhani na wakuu wa walinzi wa hekalu jinsi ambavyo angeweza kumsaliti na kumtia mikononi mwao.
sw.R: Yuda alikwenda kwa wakuu wa makuhani na wakuu wa walinzi wa hekalu. Akazungumza nao jinsi ambavyo angeweza kuwasaidia kumkamata Yesu.

vi.L: Và ông ta đi bàn bạc với các thầy tế lễ cả và các viên chỉ huy về cách làm sao nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ.
vi.B: Ông ta đi bàn với các thầy tế lễ cả và các viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ về cách nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ.
vi.R: Giu-đa đi gặp các thầy tế lễ cả và các viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ. Ông ta bàn với họ cách giúp họ bắt Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 가서, 대제사장들과 경비대장들과 함께 어떻게 그분을 그들에게 넘겨줄지 의논하였다.
ko.B: 유다는 대제사장들과 성전 경비대장들을 찾아가서, 어떻게 예수를 그들에게 배반하여 넘겨줄지 의논하였다.
ko.R: 유다는 대제사장들과 성전 경비대의 대장들을 찾아갔다. 그리고 그들이 예수를 붙잡을 수 있도록 어떻게 도울지 함께 의논하였다.

pt.L: E, indo embora, ele conversou com os chefes dos sacerdotes e os capitães sobre como {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregaria a eles.
pt.B: Ele foi conversar com os chefes dos sacerdotes e os oficiais do templo sobre o modo de {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} trair e entregar a eles.
pt.R: Judas foi até os chefes dos sacerdotes e os oficiais da guarda do templo. Ele conversou com eles sobre como podia ajudá-los a prender Jesus.

decisions.choice: captains: the officers of the temple guard
decisions.reason: The word can mean a military or civil officer. Here, as in 22:52 where they are called captains of the temple, they are the officers of the Levites who kept order in the temple, under the chief priests (Acts 4:1; 5:24-26).

decisions.choice: hand over: deliver Jesus into the power of his enemies
decisions.reason: The same verb is used when Jesus says the Son of Man will be handed over to people (9:44; 18:32).

decisions.choice: hand over (L); betray (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to hand someone over to others. Luke uses it for the Son of Man being handed over (9:44; 18:32) and for what Judas does. Literal keeps "hand over" so that the link can be seen; Balanced and Readable say "betray", since a friend handing Jesus to his enemies is a betrayal.

decisions.choice: help them arrest Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what handing him over meant in practice.

decisions.choice: entregar (L); traicionar (B)
decisions.reason: To deliver Jesus into his enemies' power (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the Greek verb; Balanced names Judas's act as betrayal, as the English does, the choice used for Judas through the Gospels.

decisions.choice: livrer (L); livrer par trahison, trahir (B); as the English at Readable ("les aider à arrêter Jésus"); for the whole chapter
decisions.reason: As in English and in Mark 14: Literal keeps "livrer", the verb Luke also uses for the Son of Man being handed over (9:44; 18:32), so the link stays visible. Balanced says what Judas's handing over was, a betrayal; here it keeps "livrer" beside it, as Mark 14:10 does.

decisions.choice: les commandants (L); les officiers du temple (B); les officiers de la garde du temple (R)
decisions.reason: "Capitaines" is now a military or naval rank and would mislead. The men were the officers of the temple guard (m1); Literal keeps a single word, Balanced and Readable say whose officers they were.

decisions.choice: kumkabidhi (L); kumsaliti (B)
decisions.reason: To deliver Jesus into his enemies' power (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the Greek verb; Balanced names Judas's act as betrayal, as the English does, the choice used for Judas through the Gospels.

decisions.choice: wakuu wa walinzi (wa hekalu)
decisions.reason: The officers of the temple guard (meaning decision m1). "Akida" is kept for the Roman centurion.

decisions.choice: "các viên chỉ huy" (L); "các viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ" (B, R); "nộp ... cho họ" (L, B), "giúp họ bắt" (R)
decisions.reason: The captains were officers of the temple guard (meaning decision); "lính canh đền thờ" is the word the Vietnamese John uses for those guards. Vietnamese "phản bội" cannot take the people he is handed to, so Balanced keeps "nộp ... cho họ", as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:10; Judas is "ông ta", the neutral pronoun used there.

decisions.choice: "넘겨주다" (L); "배반하여 넘겨주다", "배반하다" (B, R) for paradidomi of Judas, through Luke 22
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:10: Literal keeps the verb used for Jesus being handed over; Balanced and Readable say it was a betrayal, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "경비대장들" (L); "성전 경비대장들" (B); "성전 경비대의 대장들" (R) for strategoi, also 22:52
decisions.reason: They were the officers of the temple guard (meaning decision); Literal keeps the bare "captains" as the Greek has it here, and "경비병" stays for the guards themselves (hyperetai, Mark 14:54).

decisions.choice: os capitães (L); os oficiais do templo (B); os oficiais da guarda do templo (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book. "Capitães" keeps the Greek title at Literal; Balanced and Readable say who these officers were, the Levites who kept order in the temple (m1), as the English does. "Comandantes" would suggest an army.

decisions.choice: trair e entregar
decisions.reason: "Trair" alone says what Judas did but loses the verb's picture of handing Jesus over, which Literal keeps with "entregar" (r-en-1). Balanced joins the two where the sentence has room, as Matthew's Balanced does ("está sendo traído e entregue"); where it does not, it says "trair", as the English Balanced says "betray".

source.text: καὶ ἐχάρησαν καὶ συνέθεντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι.

records.literal_gloss: And they rejoiced and agreed him money to give.

en.L: And they rejoiced and agreed to give him money.
en.B: They were glad and agreed to pay him money.
en.R: The leaders were very pleased. They agreed to pay Judas.

es.L: Y se alegraron y acordaron darle dinero.
es.B: Ellos se alegraron y se comprometieron a pagarle.
es.R: Los jefes se pusieron muy contentos. Acordaron pagarle a Judas.

fr.L: Et ils se réjouirent et convinrent de lui donner de l’argent.
fr.B: Ils en furent contents et s’engagèrent à lui donner de l’argent.
fr.R: Les chefs ont été très contents. Ils ont promis de payer Judas.

sw.L: Nao wakafurahi, wakakubaliana naye kumpa fedha.
sw.B: Walifurahi, wakakubali kumlipa fedha.
sw.R: Viongozi hao walifurahi sana. Wakakubali kumlipa Yuda pesa.

vi.L: Và họ vui mừng và thỏa thuận cho ông ta tiền.
vi.B: Họ rất mừng và đồng ý trả tiền cho ông ta.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo ấy rất vui. Họ đồng ý trả tiền cho Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 기뻐하며 그에게 은돈을 주기로 약정하였다.
ko.B: 그들은 기뻐하며 유다에게 돈을 주기로 약속하였다.
ko.R: 그 지도자들은 아주 기뻐했다. 그리고 유다에게 돈을 주겠다고 약속했다.

pt.L: E eles se alegraram e combinaram dar-lhe dinheiro.
pt.B: Eles ficaram contentes e concordaram em lhe pagar uma quantia em dinheiro.
pt.R: Os líderes ficaram muito contentes. Eles combinaram pagar a Judas.

decisions.choice: money: literally silver, the common word for money
decisions.reason: Luke does not give the sum. Matthew says it was thirty pieces of silver (Matthew 26:15).

decisions.choice: rejoiced: they were glad
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for joy elsewhere in Luke; here it shows the leaders' delight that one of Jesus' own men offered to help them.
The Greek word is "silver", meaning money (meaning decision); Literal keeps the metal in "은돈", as the Korean Mark 14:11 does.

source.text: καὶ ἐξωμολόγησεν, καὶ ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν ἄτερ ὄχλου αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: And he consented, and was seeking opportunity to hand over him apart from crowd to them.

en.L: And he agreed, and he was seeking an opportunity to hand {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over to them apart from a crowd.
en.B: He accepted, and from then on he looked for a good chance to betray {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to them when no crowd was around.
en.R: Judas agreed. From then on he watched for a good time to hand Jesus over to them, when there was no crowd around.

es.L: Y él consintió, y buscaba una oportunidad para entregárselo sin [que hubiera] multitud.
es.B: Judas aceptó, y desde entonces buscaba una buena ocasión para traicionarlo y entregárselo cuando no hubiera gente alrededor.
es.R: Judas estuvo de acuerdo. Desde entonces buscaba un buen momento para entregarles a Jesús, cuando no hubiera mucha gente cerca.

fr.L: Et il accepta, et il cherchait une occasion favorable pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} leur livrer à l’écart de la foule.
fr.B: Judas accepta, et dès lors il chercha une bonne occasion de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} leur livrer, quand la foule ne serait pas là.
fr.R: Judas a accepté. À partir de ce moment, il a attendu le bon moment pour leur livrer Jésus, quand il n’y aurait pas de foule autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Naye akakubali, akawa akitafuta nafasi ya kumkabidhi kwao pasipo umati.
sw.B: Alikubali, na tangu hapo akawa akitafuta nafasi nzuri ya kumsaliti na kumtia mikononi mwao wakati ambapo hakuna umati wa watu.
sw.R: Yuda akakubali. Tangu hapo akawa akingoja wakati mzuri wa kuwakabidhi Yesu, wakati ambapo hakuna umati wa watu karibu.

vi.L: Và ông ta bằng lòng, và tìm dịp thuận tiện để nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ lúc vắng đám đông.
vi.B: Ông ta nhận lời, và từ đó tìm dịp thuận tiện để nộp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho họ khi không có đám đông.
vi.R: Giu-đa đồng ý. Từ đó ông ta rình chờ dịp tốt để nộp Đức Giê-xu cho họ, lúc không có đám đông ở gần.

ko.L: 그러자 그는 동의하였다. 그리고 무리가 없을 때에 그분을 그들에게 넘겨줄 기회를 찾고 있었다.
ko.B: 유다는 그 제안을 받아들였다. 그리고 무리가 없을 때 예수를 그들에게 배반하여 넘겨줄 좋은 기회를 엿보았다.
ko.R: 유다는 그렇게 하기로 했다. 그때부터 유다는 주위에 사람들이 없을 때 예수를 그들에게 넘겨줄 알맞은 때를 기다렸다.

pt.L: E ele consentiu, e procurava uma oportunidade de {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregar a eles longe da multidão.
pt.B: Ele aceitou e, a partir de então, procurava uma boa ocasião para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} trair e entregar a eles quando não houvesse multidão por perto.
pt.R: Judas concordou. Desde então, ele ficou esperando uma boa hora para entregar Jesus a eles, quando não houvesse multidão por perto.

decisions.choice: agreed: he accepted their offer and committed himself
decisions.reason: The verb can mean confess or praise; here, after an offer of money, it means he consented.

decisions.choice: apart from a crowd: where no crowd was present
decisions.reason: The words explain how the leaders' fear of the people (22:2) would be met: the arrest had to happen out of sight of the crowds.

decisions.choice: hand over (L); betray (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to hand someone over to others. Luke uses it for the Son of Man being handed over (9:44; 18:32) and for what Judas does. Literal keeps "hand over" so that the link can be seen; Balanced and Readable say "betray", since a friend handing Jesus to his enemies is a betrayal.

decisions.choice: hand Jesus over
decisions.reason: Readable says "hand over" here, where the plan was to deliver him to the leaders.

source.text: Ἦλθεν δὲ ἡ ἡμέρα τῶν ἀζύμων, ᾗ ἔδει θύεσθαι τὸ πάσχα·

records.literal_gloss: Came then the day of the unleavened [bread], on which it was necessary to be sacrificed the Passover [lamb];

en.L: Then the day of Unleavened Bread came, on which the Passover [lamb] had to be sacrificed.
en.B: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread, the day when the Passover lamb had to be killed as a sacrifice.
en.R: Then the day came when the bread without yeast was eaten and the Passover lamb was killed as a sacrifice.

es.L: Y llegó el día de los Ázimos, en el cual debía ser sacrificado el [cordero de la] Pascua.
es.B: Llegó el día de los Panes sin Levadura, el día en que había que sacrificar el cordero de la Pascua.
es.R: Llegó el día en que se comía el pan sin levadura y se sacrificaba el cordero de la Pascua.

fr.L: Or vint le jour des Pains sans levain, où il fallait immoler la Pâque [l’agneau].
fr.B: Arriva le jour des Pains sans levain, le jour où l’on devait immoler l’agneau de la Pâque.
fr.R: Puis est arrivé le jour où l’on mangeait le pain sans levain. Ce jour-là, on tuait l’agneau de la Pâque pour l’offrir à Dieu.

sw.L: Basi ikafika siku ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, ambayo ilibidi [mwanakondoo wa] Pasaka achinjwe kuwa dhabihu.
sw.B: Kisha ikafika siku ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu, siku ambayo ilibidi mwanakondoo wa Pasaka achinjwe kuwa dhabihu.
sw.R: Kisha ikafika siku ambayo watu walikula mikate isiyotiwa chachu, na mwanakondoo wa Pasaka alichinjwa kuwa dhabihu.

vi.L: Bấy giờ đến ngày [Lễ Bánh] Không Men, là ngày phải giết [chiên con] Lễ Vượt Qua làm sinh tế.
vi.B: Rồi đến ngày Lễ Bánh Không Men, là ngày phải giết chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua làm sinh tế.
vi.R: Rồi đến ngày người ta ăn bánh không men và giết chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua làm sinh tế.

ko.L: 그런데 유월절 [양을] 제물로 잡아야 하는, 누룩 없는 [빵]의 날이 왔다.
ko.B: 유월절 양을 잡아 제물로 바쳐야 하는 무교절 날이 되었다.
ko.R: 누룩 없는 빵을 먹는 날이 되었다. 이날에는 유월절 양을 잡아 하나님께 제물로 바쳤다.

pt.L: Chegou então o dia dos Pães sem Fermento, em que era preciso sacrificar o [cordeiro da] Páscoa.
pt.B: Então chegou o dia dos Pães sem Fermento, o dia em que o cordeiro da Páscoa devia ser sacrificado.
pt.R: Então chegou o dia em que se comia o pão sem fermento e em que o cordeiro da Páscoa era morto como sacrifício.

decisions.choice: the Passover had to be sacrificed: the lambs were killed at the temple on the afternoon of the fourteenth day of the month
decisions.reason: The law set the day (Exodus 12:6; Deuteronomy 16:5-6). The meal was eaten that evening, after sunset, which counted as the start of the next day.

decisions.choice: the Passover: here the lamb killed for the meal
decisions.reason: The word can mean the feast, the meal or the lamb. With "sacrificed" it means the lamb.

decisions.choice: lamb
decisions.reason: The word "lamb" is supplied, in brackets at Literal, to make clear what was killed (m2).

decisions.choice: immoler la Pâque [l’agneau] (L)
decisions.reason: French, like Greek, can call the lamb itself "la Pâque", so Literal keeps the Greek noun as the object and adds what it means in brackets, after it; Balanced and Readable say "l’agneau de la Pâque" (m2).

source.text: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην εἰπών· Πορευθέντες ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν τὸ πάσχα ἵνα φάγωμεν.

records.literal_gloss: And he sent Peter and John having said, Having gone prepare for us the Passover that we may eat.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent Peter and John, saying, "Go [and] prepare the Passover for us, so that we may eat [it]."
en.B: So Jesus sent Peter and John with these instructions: "Go and get the Passover meal ready for us to eat."
en.R: Jesus sent Peter and John. He told them, "Go and prepare the Passover meal for us, so that we can eat it together."

es.L: Y envió a Pedro y a Juan, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} [y] {{plural_you:prepárennos|preparadnos}} la Pascua, para que [la] comamos».
es.B: Entonces Jesús envió a Pedro y a Juan con estas instrucciones: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:prepárennos|preparadnos}} la cena de la Pascua para que la comamos».
es.R: Jesús envió a Pedro y a Juan. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Vayan|Id}} y {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} la cena de la Pascua para nosotros. Así podremos comerla juntos».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} envoya Pierre et Jean, en disant : « Allez [et] préparez-nous la Pâque, afin que nous [la] mangions. »
fr.B: Jésus envoya donc Pierre et Jean avec cette consigne : « Allez nous préparer le repas de la Pâque, pour que nous le mangions. »
fr.R: Jésus a envoyé Pierre et Jean. Il leur a dit : « Allez préparer le repas de la Pâque pour nous, pour que nous puissions le manger ensemble. »

sw.L: Naye akawatuma Petro na Yohana, akisema, "Nendeni mkatuandalie Pasaka, ili tuile."
sw.B: Basi Yesu aliwatuma Petro na Yohana, akawaagiza, "Nendeni mkatuandalie chakula cha Pasaka tukile."
sw.R: Yesu aliwatuma Petro na Yohana. Akawaambia, "Nendeni mkatuandalie chakula cha Pasaka, ili tukile pamoja."

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đi, nói: "Hãy đi chuẩn bị [bữa ăn] Lễ Vượt Qua cho chúng ta, để chúng ta ăn."
vi.B: Vậy Đức Giê-xu sai Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đi và dặn: "Hãy đi chuẩn bị bữa ăn Lễ Vượt Qua cho chúng ta."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu sai Phi-e-rơ và Giăng đi. Ngài dặn họ: "Hãy đi chuẩn bị bữa ăn Lễ Vượt Qua để chúng ta cùng ăn."

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 베드로와 요한을 보내시며 말씀하셨다. "가서, 우리가 먹을 수 있도록 우리를 위하여 유월절 [음식을] 준비하여라."
ko.B: 예수께서 베드로와 요한을 보내시며 이르셨다. "가서 우리가 먹을 유월절 음식을 준비하여라."
ko.R: 예수께서 베드로와 요한을 보내시며 말씀하셨다. "가서 우리가 함께 먹을 유월절 음식을 준비하여라."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} enviou Pedro e João, dizendo: "Vão [e] preparem para nós a Páscoa, para que [a] comamos."
pt.B: Então Jesus enviou Pedro e João com estas instruções: "Vão e preparem a ceia da Páscoa para nós comermos."
pt.R: Jesus enviou Pedro e João. Ele disse a eles: "Vão e preparem a ceia da Páscoa para nós, para que possamos comer juntos."

decisions.choice: prepare the Passover: get the lamb killed at the temple and make ready the meal and the room
decisions.reason: Preparing meant taking the lamb to the temple to be killed, roasting it, and setting out unleavened bread, wine, bitter herbs and the other foods of the meal (Exodus 12:8).

decisions.choice: Jesus
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus at the start of a new section.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans on every plural "you" (Vayan|Id, prepárennos|preparadnos)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Peter and John together. Spanish plural forms take the plural_you setting, which chooses between Latin American "ustedes" and Peninsular "vosotros"; English has no such choice. The same throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "[bữa ăn] Lễ Vượt Qua" (L); "bữa ăn Lễ Vượt Qua" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "chuẩn bị Lễ Vượt Qua" would sound like preparing the whole festival; the meal is meant (meaning decision), as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:12.

decisions.choice: 유월절 [음식을] (L), as 유월절 [양을] in 22:7
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the Passover", meaning the lamb in 22:7 and the meal here (meaning decisions); Korean needs the noun, which Literal brackets.

source.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμεν;

records.literal_gloss: They and said to him, Where do you want [that] we should prepare?

en.L: And they said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Where do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want us to prepare [it]?"
en.B: They asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Where do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want us to get it ready?"
en.R: They asked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Where do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want us to prepare it?"

es.L: Y ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijeron: «¿Dónde quieres que [la] preparemos?».
es.B: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «¿Dónde quieres que la preparemos?».
es.R: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} preguntaron: «¿Dónde quieres que preparemos la cena?».

fr.L: Et ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Où veux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que nous [la] préparions ? »
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent : « Où veux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que nous la préparions ? »
fr.R: Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont demandé : « Où veux-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que nous le préparions ? »

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, "Wataka tuiandae wapi?"
sw.B: Wakamwuliza, "Unataka tuiandae wapi?"
sw.R: Wakamwuliza, "Unataka tukaandae wapi chakula hicho?"

vi.L: Và họ nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy muốn chúng con chuẩn bị ở đâu?"
vi.B: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy muốn chúng con chuẩn bị ở đâu?"
vi.R: Họ hỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Thầy muốn chúng con chuẩn bị bữa ăn ở đâu?"

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 그분께 말했다. "저희가 어디에 준비하기를 원하십니까?"
ko.B: 그들이 예수께 여쭈었다. "저희가 어디에 준비하기를 원하십니까?"
ko.R: 제자들이 예수께 여쭈었다. "저희가 어디에다 준비하면 되겠습니까?"

pt.L: E eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disseram: "Onde queres que [a] preparemos?"
pt.B: Eles {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} perguntaram: "Onde queres que a preparemos?"
pt.R: Eles perguntaram a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}: "Onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres que nós preparemos a ceia?"

decisions.choice: where: the meal had to be eaten inside Jerusalem
decisions.reason: By custom the Passover was eaten within the city, and it was crowded with pilgrims, so a room had to be found.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "you" and "chúng con" for "we", with no setting span
decisions.reason: Disciples speak to Jesus as their teacher (style guide section 6), as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:12; "Thầy" is a noun of address and takes no setting, though the English has a deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: 합쇼체 with "저희" and the honorific "원하십니까", no word for "you"
decisions.reason: The disciples speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 (settled); Korean leaves the "you" unsaid and honours him with -시-, and "여쭈다" (B, R) is the humble verb for asking a superior.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἰδοὺ εἰσελθόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν πόλιν συναντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων· ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεται.

records.literal_gloss: He and said to them, Look, having entered of you into the city will meet you a man a jar of water carrying; follow him into the house into which he enters.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Look, when you have entered the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him into the house that he enters.
en.B: He told them, "As you go into the city, you will be met by a man who is carrying a jar of water. Follow him into whatever house he goes into.
en.R: Jesus said to them, "When you go into the city, a man carrying a jar of water will come to meet you. Follow him to the house he goes into.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, al entrar {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en la ciudad, {{plural_you:les|os}} saldrá al encuentro un hombre que lleva un cántaro de agua; {{plural_you:síganlo|seguidlo}} a la casa en que entre.
es.B: Él les respondió: «Al entrar en la ciudad, {{plural_you:les|os}} saldrá al encuentro un hombre que lleva un cántaro de agua. {{plural_you:Síganlo|Seguidlo}} hasta la casa en que entre.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Cuando {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} en la ciudad, un hombre que lleva un cántaro de agua vendrá hacia {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Síganlo|Seguidlo}} hasta la casa adonde vaya.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Voici, quand vous serez entrés dans la ville, un homme portant une cruche d’eau viendra à votre rencontre. Suivez-le dans la maison où il entre.
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « En entrant dans la ville, vous rencontrerez un homme qui porte une cruche d’eau. Suivez-le jusque dans la maison où il entrera.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Quand vous entrerez dans la ville, un homme qui porte une cruche d’eau va venir vers vous. Suivez-le jusqu’à la maison où il va entrer.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Tazama, mtakapokuwa mmeingia mjini, mtu anayebeba mtungi wa maji atakutana nanyi; mfuateni mpaka katika nyumba atakayoingia.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Mnapoingia mjini, mtu mmoja anayebeba mtungi wa maji atakutana nanyi. Mfuateni mpaka nyumba yoyote atakayoingia.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Mtakapoingia mjini, mtu mmoja anayebeba mtungi wa maji atakuja kukutana nanyi. Mfuateni mpaka kwenye nyumba atakayoingia.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Kìa, khi các con vào thành, một người đàn ông mang một vò nước sẽ gặp các con. Hãy đi theo người ấy vào nhà mà người ấy vào.
vi.B: Ngài bảo họ: "Khi các con vào thành, sẽ có một người đàn ông mang vò nước đến gặp các con. Hãy đi theo người ấy vào ngôi nhà mà người ấy bước vào.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Khi các con vào thành, sẽ có một người đàn ông mang một vò nước đến gặp các con. Hãy đi theo người ấy đến ngôi nhà người ấy vào.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "보라, 너희가 성 안으로 들어가면 물 항아리를 지고 가는 사람이 너희를 만날 것이다. 그가 들어가는 집으로 그를 따라가거라.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희가 성 안으로 들어가면 물 항아리를 메고 가는 남자를 만날 것이다. 그 사람이 들어가는 집으로 따라 들어가거라.
ko.R: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "너희가 성 안으로 들어가면, 물 항아리를 들고 가는 남자가 너희 앞에 나타날 것이다. 그 사람을 따라 그가 들어가는 집으로 가거라.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Vejam, quando vocês entrarem na cidade, um homem carregando um cântaro de água virá ao encontro de vocês. Sigam-no até a casa em que ele entrar.
pt.B: Ele lhes disse: "Quando vocês entrarem na cidade, virá ao encontro de vocês um homem carregando um cântaro de água. Sigam-no até a casa em que ele entrar.
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Quando vocês entrarem na cidade, um homem carregando um pote de água vai se encontrar com vocês. Sigam esse homem até a casa em que ele entrar.

decisions.choice: a man carrying a jar of water: an unusual sight that would make him easy to recognize
alternatives: an ordinary sight with no meaning
decisions.reason: Fetching water in jars was usually women's work; men more often carried water in skins. A man with a jar would stand out in the crowd.

decisions.choice: will meet you: Jesus tells beforehand what will happen
alternatives: a meeting Jesus had arranged in secret
decisions.reason: Luke does not say whether Jesus had arranged this or foresaw it. Either way the disciples find everything as he had said (22:13), as with the colt in 19:30-32.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Kìa" (L) for "look"; not rendered (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Luke 10:3: Literal keeps the Greek word that draws attention; Balanced and Readable leave it out, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "보라" (L) for idou, through Luke 22; not rendered as a word at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek call to look with the plain "보라", as in the Korean Luke 11-14 and Matthew 26; Balanced and Readable carry its force in the sentence, as the English does. Where the disciples speak to Jesus (22:38) the polite form is used.

decisions.choice: "남자" (B, R) for the man carrying the water jar
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:13: the sign works because a man carrying a water jar was unusual (meaning decision), and Korean "사람" does not say it was a man.

source.text: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ τῆς οἰκίας· Λέγει σοι ὁ διδάσκαλος· Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμα ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω;

records.literal_gloss: And you will say to the master of the house, Says to you the Teacher, Where is the guest room where the Passover with the disciples of me I may eat?

en.L: And you will say to the master of the house, 'The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} disciples?"'
en.B: Say to the owner of the house, 'The Teacher asks you, "Which is the guest room where I can eat the Passover with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} disciples?"'
en.R: Then say to the owner of the house, 'The Teacher wants to know, "Where is the guest room? I want to eat the Passover meal there with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} disciples."'

es.L: Y {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}} al señor de la casa: “El Maestro te dice: ‘¿Dónde está la habitación de huéspedes donde coma la Pascua con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} discípulos?’”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} al dueño de la casa: “El Maestro te pregunta: ‘¿Cuál es la habitación de huéspedes donde voy a comer la Pascua con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} discípulos?’”.
es.R: Luego {{plural_you:díganle|decidle}} al dueño de la casa: “El Maestro quiere saber: ‘¿Dónde está la habitación para los huéspedes? Quiero comer allí la cena de la Pascua con {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} discípulos’”.

fr.L: Et vous direz au maître de la maison : “Le Maître te dit : Où est la salle des hôtes où je mangerai la Pâque avec {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} disciples ?”
fr.B: Vous direz au propriétaire de la maison : “Le Maître te fait demander : Quelle est la salle des hôtes où je pourrai manger la Pâque avec {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} disciples ?”
fr.R: Puis dites au propriétaire de la maison : “Le Maître veut savoir où est la chambre des invités. Il veut y manger le repas de la Pâque avec {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples.”

sw.L: Nanyi mtamwambia mwenye nyumba, 'Mwalimu anakuambia, "Kiko wapi chumba cha wageni, ambamo nitaila Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}?"'
sw.B: Mwambieni mwenye nyumba, 'Mwalimu anakuuliza, "Kiko wapi chumba cha wageni ambamo nitakula Pasaka pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}?"'
sw.R: Kisha mwambieni mwenye nyumba hiyo, 'Mwalimu anataka kujua, "Kiko wapi chumba cha wageni? Nataka kula chakula cha Pasaka humo pamoja na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."'

vi.L: Và các con sẽ nói với chủ nhà: 'Thầy nói với ông: "Phòng khách ở đâu, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ăn Lễ Vượt Qua với các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"'
vi.B: Hãy nói với chủ nhà: 'Thầy hỏi ông: "Phòng khách ở đâu, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có thể ăn Lễ Vượt Qua với các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?"'
vi.R: Rồi hãy nói với chủ nhà: 'Thầy muốn hỏi ông: "Phòng dành cho khách ở đâu? Ta muốn ăn bữa Lễ Vượt Qua tại đó với các môn đồ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."'

ko.L: 그리고 그 집 주인에게 말하여라. '선생님께서 주인께 말씀하십니다. "내가 내 제자들과 함께 유월절 [음식을] 먹을 객실이 어디 있느냐?"'
ko.B: 그 집 주인에게 이렇게 말하여라. '선생님께서 물으십니다. "내가 내 제자들과 함께 유월절 음식을 먹을 객실이 어디 있느냐?"'
ko.R: 그리고 그 집 주인에게 말하여라. '선생님께서 물어보라고 하셨습니다. "객실이 어디 있느냐? 내가 거기서 내 제자들과 함께 유월절 음식을 먹으려고 한다."'

pt.L: E vocês dirão ao dono da casa: 'O Mestre lhe diz: "Onde está o quarto de hóspedes em que eu possa comer a Páscoa com os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} discípulos?"'
pt.B: Digam ao dono da casa: 'O Mestre lhe pergunta: "Qual é o quarto de hóspedes em que vou comer a Páscoa com os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} discípulos?"'
pt.R: Depois digam ao dono da casa: 'O Mestre quer saber: "Onde fica o quarto de hóspedes? Eu quero comer a ceia da Páscoa ali com os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} discípulos."'

decisions.choice: guest room: a room in a house set aside for guests
decisions.reason: This is the word used in 2:7, where there was no place for Mary and Joseph in the guest room. At his birth there was no room for Jesus; now a room is ready for him, and in it he gives himself for his disciples. Luke uses a different word for an inn (10:34).

decisions.choice: the master of the house: the owner, who would lend a room to pilgrims for the feast
alternatives: a servant in charge of the house
decisions.reason: Households in Jerusalem made rooms available to pilgrims who came for Passover. The owner is expected to know who "the Teacher" is, which suggests he was a follower or friend.

decisions.choice: The Teacher says to you: a message passed on in Jesus' name
alternatives: a request the disciples make for themselves
decisions.reason: The disciples are to speak for Jesus, giving his words as his messengers.

decisions.choice: le Maître; la salle des hôtes (L, B), la chambre des invités (R)
decisions.reason: "Le Maître" is the French title for a teacher with disciples, as in Mark 14:14. The room is the same word as the guest room of 2:7, so the wording of that verse is kept.

decisions.choice: the Teacher's question reported in the third person at Readable ("Le Maître veut savoir où est … Il veut y manger … avec ses disciples")
alternatives: a third level of quotation inside “ ”, as the English Readable
decisions.reason: French has no ready mark for a quotation inside a quotation inside a quotation. Readable reports the Teacher's words, so the message reads plainly; "ses disciples" then refers to Jesus and carries the span.

decisions.choice: "Thầy" for "the Teacher"; "ông" for the owner of the house
decisions.reason: The disciples speak of Jesus as they speak to him, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:14; they address a householder they do not know with the courteous "ông".

decisions.choice: "선생님께서 주인께 말씀하십니다" (L); "선생님께서 물으십니다" (B); "선생님께서 물어보라고 하셨습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: The disciples speak to a householder they do not know, so they use 합쇼체 and honour their Teacher, as in the Korean Mark 14:14; Korean addresses the owner by his title ("주인께") rather than with "당신", which sounds blunt. Jesus' own question keeps his plain style.

decisions.choice: o quarto de hóspedes
decisions.reason: The same word as the room with no space for Mary and Joseph in 2:7, as the meaning note links the two; Portuguese keeps the link with the same phrase at every level.

source.text: κἀκεῖνος ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον· ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε.

records.literal_gloss: And that one you will show an upper room large having been spread; there prepare.

en.L: And that [man] will show you a large upper room, furnished; prepare [it] there."
en.B: He will show you a large room upstairs, with everything laid out. Get the meal ready there."
en.R: He will take you upstairs and show you a large room. It will have couches and cushions set out for a meal. Get everything ready there."

es.L: Y aquel {{plural_you:les|os}} mostrará un aposento alto, grande, dispuesto; {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} allí».
es.B: Él {{plural_you:les|os}} mostrará en el piso de arriba una sala grande, con todo dispuesto. {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} allí la cena».
es.R: Él {{plural_you:los|os}} llevará al piso de arriba y {{plural_you:les|os}} mostrará una sala grande. Allí habrá divanes y cojines preparados para la comida. {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} allí todo lo necesario».

fr.L: Et celui-là vous montrera une grande chambre haute, garnie ; là, préparez[-la]. »
fr.B: Il vous montrera à l’étage une grande salle toute garnie. C’est là que vous ferez les préparatifs. »
fr.R: Il va vous faire monter à l’étage et vous montrer une grande salle. Vous y trouverez des divans et des coussins installés pour le repas. Préparez tout là-bas. »

sw.L: Naye yule atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa cha ghorofani, kilichotandikwa; andaeni humo."
sw.B: Yeye atawaonyesha chumba kikubwa cha ghorofani, ambamo kila kitu kimepangwa tayari. Andaeni chakula humo."
sw.R: Atawapeleka ghorofani na kuwaonyesha chumba kikubwa. Kitakuwa na viti vya kuegemea na mito iliyopangwa kwa ajili ya chakula. Andaeni kila kitu humo."

vi.L: Và chính người ấy sẽ chỉ cho các con một phòng lớn trên lầu, đã bày sẵn [chỗ ngồi]; hãy chuẩn bị ở đó."
vi.B: Người ấy sẽ chỉ cho các con một phòng lớn trên lầu đã bày biện sẵn. Hãy chuẩn bị bữa ăn ở đó."
vi.R: Người ấy sẽ đưa các con lên lầu và chỉ cho các con một căn phòng lớn. Trong phòng đã bày sẵn chỗ ngồi cho bữa ăn. Hãy chuẩn bị mọi thứ ở đó."

ko.L: 그러면 그 사람이 너희에게 [자리가] 깔린 큰 다락방을 보여 줄 것이다. 거기서 준비하여라."
ko.B: 그 사람이 자리를 다 마련해 놓은 큰 다락방을 보여 줄 것이다. 거기에 음식을 준비하여라."
ko.R: 그 사람이 너희를 위층으로 데려가서 큰 방을 보여 줄 것이다. 그 방에는 기대어 앉아 먹을 자리와 방석이 다 놓여 있을 것이다. 거기에 모든 것을 준비하여라."

pt.L: E ele lhes mostrará uma grande sala no andar de cima, mobiliada; ali preparem [tudo]."
pt.B: Ele vai lhes mostrar uma sala grande no andar de cima, com tudo arrumado. Preparem a ceia ali."
pt.R: Ele vai levar vocês para o andar de cima e mostrar uma sala grande. Ela vai ter divãs e almofadas arrumados para a refeição. Preparem tudo ali."

decisions.choice: furnished: spread with couches or rugs and cushions for guests to recline at the meal
decisions.reason: The word means spread or laid out. At a festive meal people lay on couches or cushions around a low table (22:14).

decisions.choice: upper room: a room built on the flat roof or on the upper floor of a house
alternatives: a room in a public building
decisions.reason: Larger houses had a room upstairs that could hold many guests. Luke uses a similar word for the upstairs room where the disciples met after the ascension (Acts 1:13), but it is not certain they were the same room.

decisions.choice: couches and cushions set out for a meal
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a furnished dining room was like (m1).

source.text: ἀπελθόντες δὲ εὗρον καθὼς εἰρήκει αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.

records.literal_gloss: Having gone away then they found as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

en.L: And going away, they found [it] just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had told them, and they prepared the Passover.
en.B: So they went off and found it all just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had said, and they got the Passover ready.
en.R: So they went. They found everything just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover meal there.

es.L: Y yéndose, encontraron [todo] tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les había dicho, y prepararon la Pascua.
es.B: Fueron, pues, y lo encontraron todo tal como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les había dicho, y prepararon la Pascua.
es.R: Entonces fueron. Encontraron todo tal como Jesús les había dicho. Y allí prepararon la cena de la Pascua.

fr.L: Et s’en étant allés, ils trouvèrent [tout] comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait dit, et ils préparèrent la Pâque.
fr.B: Ils partirent et trouvèrent tout comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le leur avait dit ; et ils préparèrent la Pâque.
fr.R: Ils sont donc partis. Ils ont tout trouvé comme Jésus le leur avait dit. Et ils ont préparé là le repas de la Pâque.

sw.L: Basi wakienda zao, walikuta [kila kitu] kama alivyokuwa amewaambia, wakaiandaa Pasaka.
sw.B: Basi wakaenda, wakakuta kila kitu kama alivyokuwa amewaambia, wakaiandaa Pasaka.
sw.R: Basi wakaenda. Wakakuta kila kitu kama Yesu alivyowaambia. Nao wakaandaa chakula cha Pasaka humo.

vi.L: Và họ đi và thấy [mọi sự] đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói với họ, và họ chuẩn bị Lễ Vượt Qua.
vi.B: Vậy họ đi và thấy mọi việc đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói. Họ chuẩn bị bữa ăn Lễ Vượt Qua.
vi.R: Hai môn đồ ra đi. Họ thấy mọi việc đúng như Đức Giê-xu đã nói với họ. Rồi họ chuẩn bị bữa ăn Lễ Vượt Qua tại đó.

ko.L: 그래서 그들이 가서, 그분이 그들에게 말씀하신 대로 [모든 것을] 찾았다. 그리고 유월절 [음식을] 준비하였다.
ko.B: 두 제자가 가 보니, 예수께서 말씀하신 그대로였다. 그들은 거기서 유월절 음식을 준비하였다.
ko.R: 두 제자는 성 안으로 갔다. 모든 것이 예수께서 말씀하신 그대로였다. 그래서 그들은 그곳에서 유월절 음식을 준비했다.

pt.L: E, indo, encontraram [tudo] como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes tinha dito, e prepararam a Páscoa.
pt.B: Eles foram e encontraram tudo exatamente como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha dito, e prepararam a Páscoa.
pt.R: Então eles foram. Encontraram tudo exatamente como Jesus tinha dito a eles. E ali prepararam a ceia da Páscoa.

decisions.choice: as he had told them: Jesus' word comes true
decisions.reason: Luke repeats this phrase from 19:32. What Jesus foretells happens, which prepares the reader for the hard things he foretells at this meal (22:21, 34).

source.text: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡ ὥρα, ἀνέπεσεν καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι σὺν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And when came the hour, he reclined and the apostles with him.

en.L: And when the hour came, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} reclined [at table], and the apostles with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: When the hour came, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place at the table, and the apostles with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: When it was time for the meal, Jesus lay down at the table, and the apostles with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y cuando llegó la hora, se reclinó [a la mesa], y los apóstoles con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Cuando llegó la hora, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ocupó {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar en la mesa, y los apóstoles con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Cuando llegó la hora de la cena, Jesús se recostó junto a la mesa, y los apóstoles con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et quand l’heure fut venue, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se mit à table, et les apôtres avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Quand l’heure fut venue, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prit place à table, et les apôtres avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Quand ça a été l’heure du repas, Jésus s’est allongé à table, et les apôtres avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Na saa ilipofika, aliegemea [mezani], na mitume pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.B: Saa ilipowadia, aliketi mahali pake mezani, na mitume pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.R: Wakati wa chakula ulipofika, Yesu aliegemea mezani, na mitume pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.

vi.L: Và khi đến giờ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngả mình [bên bàn ăn], và các sứ đồ cùng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi đến giờ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngồi vào bàn ăn, các sứ đồ cũng ngồi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi đến giờ ăn, Đức Giê-xu ngồi vào bàn cùng với các sứ đồ.

ko.L: 그리고 때가 되자, 그분이 [식탁에] 기대어 앉으셨고, 사도들도 그분과 함께 [앉았다].
ko.B: 때가 되자 예수께서 식탁에 앉으셨고, 사도들도 함께 앉았다.
ko.R: 식사할 때가 되자, 예수께서 식탁에 기대어 앉으셨다. 사도들도 예수와 함께 앉았다.

pt.L: E, quando chegou a hora, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se reclinou [à mesa], e os apóstolos com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: Quando chegou a hora, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tomou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar à mesa, e os apóstolos com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Quando chegou a hora da ceia, Jesus se deitou junto à mesa, e os apóstolos com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

decisions.choice: reclined: lay on couches or cushions around the table, as at a festive meal
decisions.reason: At a formal meal, and at Passover above all, guests lay on their left side with their heads toward the table. Reclining at Passover was a sign of free people, no longer slaves.

decisions.choice: the hour: the appointed time for the Passover meal, after sunset
decisions.reason: First of all the hour is the time of the meal. Luke also uses "hour" for the moment of the leaders' power at his arrest (22:53).

decisions.choice: the apostles: the Twelve
decisions.reason: Luke calls the Twelve apostles (6:13). He does not name anyone else at this meal.

decisions.choice: [at table]
decisions.reason: Literal adds in brackets where they reclined, since the verb alone is unclear.

decisions.choice: se mit à table (L), with no bracket
decisions.reason: French "se mettre à table" carries the place in the verb itself, so Literal needs no bracket where the English adds "[at table]". Readable keeps the picture of lying at table that the English Readable gives (m1).

decisions.choice: "ngả mình [bên bàn ăn]" (L); "ngồi vào bàn ăn" (B, R); "các sứ đồ"
decisions.reason: Guests at a festive meal lay on couches (meaning decision); Literal keeps that picture, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:3, while Balanced and Readable use the ordinary Vietnamese way of taking one's place at a meal. "Sứ đồ" is the Protestant word for apostle (Luke 6:13).

decisions.choice: "때" for hora; "사도들" at every level
decisions.reason: "때" is the word the Korean Gospels use for an appointed hour, which here is the time of the meal (meaning decision); Luke names the Twelve "apostles" here, and the Korean keeps his word, as in the Korean Luke 6:13 and 9:10.

source.text: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἐπεθύμησα τοῦτο τὸ πάσχα φαγεῖν μεθ’ ὑμῶν πρὸ τοῦ με παθεῖν·

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, With desire I have desired this the Passover to eat with you before the me to suffer;

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "With desire I have desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
en.B: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "How I have longed to eat this Passover with you before I suffer!
en.R: Jesus said to them, "I have wanted very much to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer.

es.L: Y les dijo: «Con deseo he deseado comer esta Pascua con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} antes de padecer.
es.B: Y les dijo: «¡Cuánto he deseado comer esta Pascua con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} antes de padecer!
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «He deseado muchísimo comer esta cena de la Pascua con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} antes de sufrir.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « J’ai désiré d’un grand désir manger cette Pâque avec vous avant de souffrir.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Comme j’ai désiré manger cette Pâque avec vous avant de souffrir !
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « J’ai très envie de manger ce repas de la Pâque avec vous avant de souffrir.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Kwa shauku nimetamani kuila Pasaka hii pamoja nanyi kabla sijateswa.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Jinsi nilivyotamani sana kuila Pasaka hii pamoja nanyi kabla sijateswa!
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Nimetamani sana kula chakula hiki cha Pasaka pamoja nanyi kabla sijateswa.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Ta đã khao khát thiết tha được ăn Lễ Vượt Qua này với các con trước khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chịu khổ.
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Ta đã mong mỏi biết bao được ăn Lễ Vượt Qua này với các con trước khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chịu khổ!
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta rất mong được ăn bữa Lễ Vượt Qua này với các con trước khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chịu khổ.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "나는 고난을 받기 전에 너희와 함께 이 유월절 [음식을] 먹기를 바라고 또 바랐다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 고난을 받기 전에 너희와 함께 이 유월절 음식을 먹기를 얼마나 간절히 바랐는지 모른다!
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "나는 고난을 받기 전에 너희와 함께 이 유월절 음식을 꼭 먹고 싶었다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Com desejo desejei comer esta Páscoa com vocês antes de eu sofrer.
pt.B: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Como desejei comer esta Páscoa com vocês antes de sofrer!
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Eu queria muito comer esta ceia da Páscoa com vocês antes de sofrer.

decisions.choice: with desire I have desired: I have longed very much
decisions.reason: Repeating the verb with its noun is a Hebrew way of making the verb stronger, found in the Greek Old Testament (Genesis 31:30). The word for desire here is a good longing, not a wrong one.

decisions.choice: before I suffer: before his death
decisions.reason: Jesus has foretold that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be killed (9:22; 17:25). Luke uses "suffer" for his death (24:26, 46).

decisions.choice: How I have longed
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the strength of the repeated verb (m1) with an exclamation.

decisions.choice: J’ai très envie de (R), a present
decisions.reason: The Greek past looks back on a longing that is still present as Jesus speaks, and "désirer" is a formal word; Readable says it as a French speaker would at the table.

decisions.choice: "khao khát thiết tha" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek repeats the word for desire for emphasis (meaning decision); Vietnamese cannot repeat the noun and verb, so Literal pairs two words of longing.

decisions.choice: "바라고 또 바랐다" (L); "얼마나 간절히 바랐는지 모른다" (B); "꼭 먹고 싶었다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek repeats the word for desire to make it strong (meaning decision); Literal keeps the repetition in a natural Korean doubling, and Balanced and Readable give its force.

source.text: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ φάγω αὐτὸ ἕως ὅτου πληρωθῇ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: I say for to you that not not I will eat it until when it is fulfilled in the kingdom of the God.

en.L: For I tell you that I will certainly not eat it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God."
en.B: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds its fulfillment in the kingdom of God."
en.R: I tell you, I will not eat this meal again until it comes true in the kingdom of God."

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que de ninguna manera la comeré hasta que se cumpla en el reino de Dios».
es.B: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que no volveré a comerla hasta que alcance su cumplimiento en el reino de Dios».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que no volveré a comer esta cena hasta que se haga realidad en el reino de Dios».

fr.L: Car je vous dis que je ne la mangerai certainement pas jusqu’à ce qu’elle soit accomplie dans le royaume de Dieu. »
fr.B: Car, je vous le dis, je ne la mangerai plus jusqu’à ce qu’elle trouve son accomplissement dans le royaume de Dieu. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis, je ne mangerai plus ce repas avant qu’il ne se réalise dans le royaume de Dieu. »

sw.L: Kwa maana nawaambia kwamba sitaila kamwe mpaka itakapotimizwa katika ufalme wa Mungu."
sw.B: Kwa maana nawaambia, sitaila tena mpaka itakapopata utimilifu wake katika ufalme wa Mungu."
sw.R: Nawaambia, sitakula chakula hiki tena mpaka kitakapotimia katika ufalme wa Mungu."

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ không ăn lễ ấy cho đến khi lễ ấy được làm trọn trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ăn lễ này nữa cho đến khi lễ ấy được làm trọn trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời."
vi.R: Ta nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không ăn bữa này nữa cho đến khi nó trở thành sự thật trong vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời."

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 그것이 하나님의 나라에서 이루어질 때까지, 나는 결코 그것을 먹지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 이 유월절이 하나님의 나라에서 온전히 이루어질 때까지, 나는 다시는 이것을 먹지 않을 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 말한다. 하나님의 나라에서 이 식사의 뜻이 다 이루어질 때까지, 나는 이 음식을 다시는 먹지 않을 것이다."

pt.L: Pois eu lhes digo que de modo nenhum a comerei até que ela se cumpra no Reino de Deus."
pt.B: Pois eu lhes digo: não a comerei de novo até que ela se cumpra plenamente no Reino de Deus."
pt.R: Eu digo a vocês: não vou comer esta ceia de novo até que ela se torne realidade no Reino de Deus."

decisions.choice: I will not eat it, the reading of the SBLGNT
alternatives: I will no longer eat it, the reading of many manuscripts
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add a word meaning "no longer". Several early ones do not have it. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: will not eat it until: this is the last Passover he will eat before the kingdom comes
alternatives: Jesus refuses to eat this Passover at all
decisions.reason: The strong double negative can be read as a vow not to eat this meal, so that Jesus fasts while the others eat. More likely, after saying how he longed to eat it with them (22:15), he means he will not eat it again. The words for "again" in Balanced and Readable express this reading.

decisions.choice: fulfilled in the kingdom of God: the Passover points ahead to what God will do
decisions.reason: Passover remembered the rescue from Egypt. Jesus says it will reach its full meaning in the kingdom of God, pictured as a feast (13:29; 14:15; 22:30).

decisions.choice: again
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "again" to give the more likely sense (m2), even though the SBLGNT does not have the word "no longer" (m1).

decisions.choice: "vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời"; "được làm trọn" (L, B), "trở thành sự thật" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 14:25; "làm trọn" is used for fulfilling in Matthew 5:17, and Readable uses the plain phrase used for fulfilled Scripture in Mark 14:49.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 나라" at every level; "이루어지다" for "be fulfilled"
decisions.reason: The form of the Korean Mark and Luke; "이루어지다" is the Korean Gospels' word for fulfilment.

source.text: καὶ δεξάμενος ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας εἶπεν· Λάβετε τοῦτο καὶ διαμερίσατε εἰς ἑαυτούς·

records.literal_gloss: And having received a cup, having given thanks he said, Take this and divide [it] among yourselves;

en.L: And receiving a cup [and] giving thanks, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "Take this and divide [it] among yourselves.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took a cup, gave thanks, and said, "Take this and share it among yourselves.
en.R: Then Jesus took a cup of wine and thanked God for it. He said, "Take this and share it with each other.

es.L: Y recibiendo una copa [y] dando gracias, dijo: «{{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} esto y {{plural_you:repártanlo|repartidlo}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Luego tomó una copa, dio gracias y dijo: «{{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} esto y {{plural_you:compártanlo|compartidlo}} entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Luego Jesús tomó una copa de vino y le dio gracias a Dios por ella. Dijo: «{{plural_you:Tomen|Tomad}} esto y {{plural_you:compártanlo|compartidlo}} unos con otros.

fr.L: Et ayant reçu une coupe [et] ayant rendu grâces, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Prenez ceci et partagez[-le] entre vous.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prit une coupe, rendit grâces et dit : « Prenez cette coupe et partagez-la entre vous.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus a pris une coupe de vin et a remercié Dieu pour ce vin. Il a dit : « Prenez cette coupe et partagez-la entre vous.

sw.L: Na akipokea kikombe [na] kushukuru, alisema, "Chukueni hiki, mkigawanye kati yenu.
sw.B: Kisha alichukua kikombe, akashukuru, akasema, "Chukueni hiki mgawane kati yenu.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alichukua kikombe cha divai, akamshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yake. Akasema, "Chukueni hiki mgawane ninyi kwa ninyi.

vi.L: Và nhận lấy chén, sau khi tạ ơn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Hãy lấy chén này và chia nhau giữa các con.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầm lấy chén, tạ ơn, và nói: "Hãy lấy chén này và chia nhau mà uống.
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu cầm lấy một chén rượu nho và cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài nói: "Hãy lấy chén này và chia nhau uống.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 잔을 받아 감사를 드리시고 말씀하셨다. "이것을 받아 너희끼리 나누어라.
ko.B: 그리고 예수께서 잔을 받아 감사 기도를 드리신 뒤에 말씀하셨다. "이것을 받아서 서로 나누어 마셔라.
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 포도주 잔을 들고 하나님께 감사드리셨다. 그리고 말씀하셨다. "이것을 받아서 서로 나누어 마셔라.

pt.L: E, recebendo um cálice [e] dando graças, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "Tomem isto e repartam entre vocês.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tomou um cálice, deu graças e disse: "Tomem isto e repartam entre vocês.
pt.R: Então Jesus pegou um cálice de vinho e agradeceu a Deus por ele. Ele disse: "Peguem isto e dividam entre vocês.

decisions.choice: a cup: one of the cups of wine shared during the Passover meal
decisions.reason: Luke mentions two cups, one here before the bread and one after supper (22:20). Later Jewish writings describe four cups of wine at the Passover meal; how fixed that order was in Jesus' day is not certain.

decisions.choice: giving thanks: blessing God for the wine, as was done at every meal
decisions.reason: Before drinking or eating, Jews thanked God the giver. The verb is the one from which "Eucharist" comes.

decisions.choice: a cup of wine; thanked God for it
decisions.reason: Readable says what was in the cup and to whom thanks were given.

decisions.choice: "tạ ơn" (L, B); "cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Mark 14:23 for giving thanks over the cup; Readable names God, as the English Readable does.

source.text: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως οὗ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἔλθῃ.

records.literal_gloss: I say for to you, not not I will drink from the now from the fruit of the vine until that the kingdom of the God comes.

en.L: For I tell you, from now on I will certainly not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
en.B: I tell you, from now on I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
en.R: I tell you, I will not drink wine again until the kingdom of God comes."

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que desde ahora de ninguna manera beberé del fruto de la vid hasta que venga el reino de Dios».
es.B: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que desde ahora no beberé del fruto de la vid hasta que venga el reino de Dios».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que no volveré a beber vino hasta que venga el reino de Dios».

fr.L: Car je vous dis : désormais je ne boirai certainement pas du fruit de la vigne jusqu’à ce que le royaume de Dieu vienne. »
fr.B: Je vous le dis, désormais je ne boirai plus du fruit de la vigne jusqu’à ce que vienne le royaume de Dieu. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis, je ne boirai plus de vin avant que le royaume de Dieu vienne. »

sw.L: Kwa maana nawaambia, tangu sasa sitakunywa kamwe katika tunda la mzabibu mpaka ufalme wa Mungu utakapokuja."
sw.B: Nawaambia, tangu sasa sitakunywa tunda la mzabibu mpaka ufalme wa Mungu utakapokuja."
sw.R: Nawaambia, sitakunywa divai tena mpaka ufalme wa Mungu utakapokuja."

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, từ nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chắc chắn sẽ không uống sản vật của cây nho nữa cho đến khi vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đến."
vi.B: Ta nói với các con, từ nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không uống sản vật của cây nho nữa cho đến khi vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đến."
vi.R: Ta nói với các con, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không uống rượu nho nữa cho đến khi vương quốc của Đức Chúa Trời đến."

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 이제부터 나는 하나님의 나라가 올 때까지 포도나무의 열매에서 난 것을 결코 마시지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. 이제부터 하나님의 나라가 올 때까지, 나는 포도나무 열매로 만든 것을 마시지 않을 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 말한다. 하나님의 나라가 올 때까지, 나는 다시는 포도주를 마시지 않을 것이다."

pt.L: Pois eu lhes digo: de agora em diante, de modo nenhum beberei do fruto da videira até que venha o Reino de Deus."
pt.B: Eu lhes digo: de agora em diante não beberei do fruto da videira até que venha o Reino de Deus."
pt.R: Eu digo a vocês: não vou beber vinho de novo até que o Reino de Deus venha."

decisions.choice: the fruit of the vine: wine
alternatives: grape juice as opposed to wine
decisions.reason: The phrase comes from the Jewish blessing said over wine, which thanks God for creating the fruit of the vine.

decisions.choice: until the kingdom of God comes: Jesus looks past his death to the coming of the kingdom
alternatives: a promise to drink with them the next day
decisions.reason: As in 22:16, Jesus speaks of a coming feast in the kingdom. He will not share this cup again until then.

decisions.choice: wine
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase (m1).

decisions.choice: "sản vật của cây nho" (L, B); "rượu nho" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Vietnamese Mark 14:25, the parallel saying; Readable names the wine (meaning decision).

source.text: καὶ λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν διδόμενον· τοῦτο ποιεῖτε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν.

records.literal_gloss: And having taken bread, having given thanks he broke and gave to them saying, This is the body of me the [one] for you being given; this do in the my remembrance.

en.L: And taking bread [and] giving thanks, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke [it] and gave [it] to them, saying, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took bread, and after giving thanks {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke it and handed it to them, saying, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: Then Jesus took some bread and thanked God for it. He broke it and gave it to them. He said, "This is {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} body. It is given for you. Do this to remember {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Y tomando pan [y] dando gracias, [lo] partió y [se lo] dio, diciendo: «Esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo, que es dado a favor de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} esto en recuerdo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}».
es.B: Luego tomó pan, y después de dar gracias lo partió y se lo dio, diciendo: «Esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo, que se da por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} esto en recuerdo de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.R: Luego Jesús tomó un pan y le dio gracias a Dios por él. Lo partió y se lo dio a ellos. Les dijo: «Esto es {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuerpo. Se da por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} esto {{plural_you:para acordarse|para acordaros}} de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».

fr.L: Et ayant pris du pain [et] ayant rendu grâces, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [le] rompit et [le] leur donna, en disant : « Ceci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} corps, qui est donné pour vous ; faites ceci en mémoire de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prit du pain et, après avoir rendu grâces, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le rompit et le leur donna en disant : « Ceci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} corps, donné pour vous. Faites ceci en mémoire de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: Puis Jésus a pris du pain et a remercié Dieu pour ce pain. Il l’a rompu et le leur a donné. Il a dit : « Ceci est {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} corps. Il est donné pour vous. Faites cela pour vous souvenir de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »

sw.L: Na akichukua mkate [na] kushukuru, aliumega, akawapa, akisema, "Huu ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} unaotolewa kwa ajili yenu; fanyeni hivi kuwa ukumbusho {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: Kisha alichukua mkate, na baada ya kushukuru akaumega, akawapa, akisema, "Huu ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, unaotolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi ili mnikumbuke {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alichukua mkate, akamshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yake. Akaumega, akawapa. Akasema, "Huu ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Unatolewa kwa ajili yenu. Fanyeni hivi ili kunikumbuka."

vi.L: Và cầm lấy bánh, sau khi tạ ơn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ ra và đưa cho họ, nói: "Đây là thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, được ban cho vì các con; hãy làm điều này để tưởng nhớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầm lấy bánh, tạ ơn, bẻ ra và trao cho họ mà nói: "Đây là thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, được hiến dâng vì các con. Hãy làm điều này để tưởng nhớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu cầm lấy bánh và cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài bẻ bánh ra và trao cho họ. Ngài nói: "Đây là thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Thân thể này được hiến dâng vì các con. Hãy làm điều này để nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 그리고 빵을 들어 감사를 드리시고, [그것을] 떼어 그들에게 주시며 말씀하셨다. "이것은 너희를 위하여 주어지는 내 몸이다. 나를 기억하여 이것을 행하여라."
ko.B: 그리고 예수께서 빵을 들어 감사 기도를 드리신 뒤에 떼어 그들에게 주시며 말씀하셨다. "이것은 너희를 위하여 내어 주는 내 몸이다. 나를 기억하여 이것을 행하여라."
ko.R: 그리고 예수께서 빵을 들고 하나님께 감사드리셨다. 그리고 빵을 떼어 제자들에게 주시며 말씀하셨다. "이것은 내 몸이다. 너희를 위하여 내어 주는 것이다. 이렇게 하면서 나를 기억하여라."

pt.L: E, tomando pão [e] dando graças, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} [o] partiu e [o] deu a eles, dizendo: "Isto é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} corpo, que é dado em favor de vocês. Façam isto em memória de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.B: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tomou um pão e, tendo dado graças, partiu-o e o deu a eles, dizendo: "Isto é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} corpo, que é dado por vocês. Façam isto em memória de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.R: Depois Jesus pegou um pão e agradeceu a Deus por ele. Partiu o pão e deu os pedaços a eles. Ele disse: "Isto é o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} corpo. Ele é dado em favor de vocês. Façam isto para se lembrarem de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."

decisions.choice: the longer text, with "which is given for you" and the whole of 22:20 (SBLGNT, in square brackets)
alternatives: the shorter text, which ends with "This is my body" and leaves out the rest of 22:19 and all of 22:20
other short forms that move the cup of 22:17-18 after the bread
decisions.reason: Almost all manuscripts have the longer text, among them early ones such as Papyrus 75, Codex Sinaiticus, Codex Vaticanus and Codex Alexandrinus. The shorter text is found in Codex Bezae and in some Old Latin manuscripts; some Old Latin and Old Syriac witnesses have other forms that put the cup after the bread. The SBLGNT prints the longer words in square brackets to show that their place in the text is doubted. The shorter text is harder to explain as a change, since it leaves a meal with the cup before the bread; the longer text has the wide and early support. The longer words are close to Paul's account in 1 Corinthians 11:24-25. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: giving thanks: thanking God for the bread, as at every meal
decisions.reason: As in 22:17, Jesus says the thanksgiving to God that began a Jewish meal.

decisions.choice: given for you: his body handed over to death for their sake
decisions.reason: "For you" means for your good, in your place. It points to his death the next day, as the cup does (22:20), and echoes the servant of Isaiah 53 who bears the sins of many, the passage Jesus quotes in 22:37.

decisions.choice: in remembrance of me: to remember me, by doing this
decisions.reason: Passover was a remembrance of the exodus (Exodus 12:14). Jesus tells the apostles to repeat this meal to remember him and what he does for them.

decisions.choice: to remember me
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words; Literal and Balanced keep the familiar phrase, which is close to the Greek.

decisions.choice: en mémoire de moi (L, B); pour vous souvenir de moi (R)
decisions.reason: "En mémoire de moi" is close to the Greek and is the phrase French-speaking churches use at the Lord's Supper, so Literal and Balanced keep it; Readable says it with a plain verb, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: rendre grâces (L, B); remercier Dieu (R), here and in 22:17
decisions.reason: The verb is giving thanks (m2). "Rendre grâces" is the established French for it; Readable says plainly whom he thanked.

decisions.choice: "được ban cho" (L); "được hiến dâng" (B, R); "để tưởng nhớ Ta" (L, B), "để nhớ đến Ta" (R)
