decisions.reason: His body is given up to death for them (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "hiến dâng" (offered up), which carries that, where Literal keeps the plain verb "give". "Tưởng nhớ" is remembering with honor; Readable uses the everyday "nhớ đến".

decisions.choice: "빵" at every level; "감사를 드리다" (L), "감사 기도를 드리다" (B), "하나님께 감사드리다" (R) for eucharisteo, also 22:17
decisions.reason: As in the Korean John and Mark: "떡" is rice cake to Korean readers today. Luke's verb is thanksgiving, not Mark's blessing, so the Korean says "감사".

decisions.choice: Façam isto em memória de mim (L, B); Façam isto para se lembrarem de mim (R)
decisions.reason: "Em memória de" is the ordinary Portuguese phrase for doing something to keep a person in mind, and the one by which Brazilian readers know these words; it stays close to the Greek noun (m4). Readable uses the verb "lembrar-se", as the English Readable says "to remember me".

decisions.choice: em favor de vocês (L, R); por vocês (B)
decisions.reason: "For you" means for their good and in their place (m3). "Em favor de" says that plainly, as Matthew's "em favor de muitos" (26:28); Balanced's shorter "por vocês" carries both senses. "Para vocês" would say only that the body was handed to them.

source.text: καὶ τὸ ποτήριον ὡσαύτως μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι, λέγων· Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐν τῷ αἵματί μου, τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐκχυννόμενον.

records.literal_gloss: And the cup likewise after the having supped, saying, This the cup [is] the new covenant in the blood of me, the [one] for you being poured out.

en.L: And [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did] likewise with the cup after they had eaten, saying, "This cup [is] the new covenant in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} blood, which is poured out for you.
en.B: In the same way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took the cup after the meal, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} blood, poured out for you.
en.R: After the meal Jesus did the same with the cup. He said, "This cup is God's new covenant, made by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} blood. My blood is poured out for you.

es.L: E [hizo] lo mismo con la copa después de cenar, diciendo: «Esta copa [es] el nuevo pacto en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sangre, la que es derramada a favor de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Del mismo modo tomó la copa después de la cena, y dijo: «Esta copa es el nuevo pacto en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sangre, derramada por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Después de la cena, Jesús hizo lo mismo con la copa. Dijo: «Esta copa es el nuevo pacto de Dios, hecho con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} sangre. Mi sangre se derrama por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Et [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fit] de même avec la coupe, après qu’ils eurent mangé, en disant : « Cette coupe [est] la nouvelle alliance dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sang, qui est répandu pour vous.
fr.B: De même, après le repas, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prit la coupe en disant : « Cette coupe est la nouvelle alliance dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sang, versé pour vous.
fr.R: Après le repas, Jésus a fait la même chose avec la coupe. Il a dit : « Cette coupe, c’est la nouvelle alliance de Dieu, établie par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sang. Mon sang est versé pour vous.

sw.L: Na [akafanya] vivyo hivyo na kikombe baada ya kula, akisema, "Kikombe hiki [ni] agano jipya katika damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, inayomwagwa kwa ajili yenu.
sw.B: Vivyo hivyo alichukua kikombe baada ya chakula, akasema, "Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya lililofanywa kwa damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ambayo inamwagwa kwa ajili yenu.
sw.R: Baada ya chakula, Yesu alifanya vivyo hivyo na kikombe. Akasema, "Kikombe hiki ni agano jipya la Mungu, lililofanywa kwa damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Damu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inamwagwa kwa ajili yenu.

vi.L: Và [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng làm] như vậy với chén sau bữa ăn, nói: "Chén này [là] giao ước mới trong huyết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, [huyết] đổ ra vì các con.
vi.B: Cũng vậy, sau bữa ăn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầm lấy chén và nói: "Chén này là giao ước mới trong huyết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, huyết đổ ra vì các con.
vi.R: Sau bữa ăn, Đức Giê-xu cũng làm như vậy với chén. Ngài nói: "Chén này là giao ước mới của Đức Chúa Trời, được lập bằng máu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Máu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đổ ra vì các con.

ko.L: 그리고 식사를 마치신 뒤에 잔도 그와 같이 [하시며] 말씀하셨다. "이 잔은 내 피로 [세우는] 새 언약, 너희를 위하여 쏟아지는 [것]이다.
ko.B: 식사를 마치신 뒤에 예수께서 잔도 그와 같이 하시며 말씀하셨다. "이 잔은 너희를 위하여 쏟는 내 피로 세우는 새 언약이다.
ko.R: 식사를 마친 뒤에 예수께서 잔을 들고도 그와 같이 하셨다. 그리고 말씀하셨다. "이 잔은 내 피로 세우는 하나님의 새 언약이다. 내 피는 너희를 위하여 쏟아진다.

pt.L: E do mesmo modo [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez] com o cálice, depois de terem ceado, dizendo: "Este cálice [é] a nova aliança no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sangue, que é derramado em favor de vocês.
pt.B: Da mesma forma, depois da ceia, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tomou o cálice, dizendo: "Este cálice é a nova aliança no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sangue, derramado em favor de vocês.
pt.R: Depois da ceia, Jesus fez o mesmo com o cálice. Ele disse: "Este cálice é a nova aliança de Deus, feita por meio do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sangue. O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} sangue é derramado em favor de vocês.

decisions.choice: this verse is part of the text (SBLGNT, in square brackets)
alternatives: left out in the shorter text
decisions.reason: The whole verse is missing from the shorter text described at 22:19. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the new covenant: the covenant God promised through Jeremiah
alternatives: a new agreement among the disciples
decisions.reason: God promised a new covenant in which he would write his law on hearts and forgive sins (Jeremiah 31:31-34). The covenant at Sinai was sealed with blood (Exodus 24:8). Jesus says the new covenant is made by his blood.

decisions.choice: which is poured out for you: his blood, shed in death
decisions.reason: In the Greek the words "poured out" agree in form with "cup" rather than "blood", but the cup stands for his blood. The pouring out of blood means a violent death, and "for you" means for their sake (22:19).

decisions.choice: after they had eaten: after the main meal
decisions.reason: This cup came at the end of the meal, after the bread, when a final cup of blessing was drunk.

decisions.choice: [he did] likewise with (L); in the same way he took (B); did the same with (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb here; the verbs of 22:19 are understood. Literal brackets them.

decisions.choice: God's new covenant, made by my blood
alternatives: the new covenant in my blood
decisions.reason: Readable explains whose covenant it is and how the blood makes it (m2).

decisions.choice: pacto
decisions.reason: The new covenant God promised through Jeremiah (meaning decision m2), "pacto" as in Mark 14:24 and Hebrews. "Testamento" would read as a will.

decisions.choice: "giao ước mới"; "huyết" (L, B), "máu" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 14:24: "huyết" is the word the church uses for this saying and for sacrificial blood; Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "새 언약" for "the new covenant"; "쏟다" for "pour out"
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:24: "언약" is the Protestant word for God's covenant and links this with the new covenant of Jeremiah (meaning decision); "계약" sounds like a business contract.

decisions.choice: [하시며]; 내 피로 [세우는]; 쏟아지는 [것] (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb for what Jesus did with the cup, says "in my blood", and leaves the noun after "poured out" unstated; Korean needs each, and Literal brackets them.

source.text: πλὴν ἰδοὺ ἡ χεὶρ τοῦ παραδιδόντος με μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης·

records.literal_gloss: But look, the hand of the [one] handing over me [is] with me on the table;

en.L: But look, the hand of the one handing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} over [is] with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the table.
en.B: Yet the hand of the man who is betraying {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} is here with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the table.
en.R: But the man who is going to betray {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} is here, eating at this table with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, la mano del que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entrega [está] conmigo sobre la mesa.
es.B: Sin embargo, la mano del que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traiciona está aquí conmigo sobre la mesa.
es.R: Pero el hombre que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} va a traicionar está aquí, comiendo conmigo en esta mesa.

fr.L: Mais voici, la main de celui qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} livre [est] avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur la table.
fr.B: Et pourtant, la main de celui qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trahit est là, avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, sur cette table.
fr.R: Mais l’homme qui va {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trahir est ici. Il mange à cette table avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Lakini tazama, mkono wa yule anayenikabidhi [uko] pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} mezani.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mkono wa mtu anayenisaliti uko hapa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} mezani.
sw.R: Lakini mtu atakayenisaliti yuko hapa, anakula pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwenye meza hii.

vi.L: Nhưng kìa, tay của kẻ nộp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [đang] ở với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên bàn.
vi.B: Thế nhưng, bàn tay của kẻ phản bội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang ở trên bàn này cùng với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nhưng kẻ sẽ phản bội {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang ngồi ăn với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tại bàn này.

ko.L: 그러나 보라, 나를 넘겨주는 자의 손이 나와 함께 식탁 위에 있다.
ko.B: 그러나 나를 배반하는 사람의 손이 지금 나와 함께 이 식탁 위에 있다.
ko.R: 그러나 나를 배반할 사람이 지금 여기서 나와 함께 이 식탁에서 먹고 있다.

pt.L: Mas vejam: a mão daquele que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entrega [está] {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} sobre a mesa.
pt.B: Contudo, a mão do homem que está {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traindo está aqui {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}, sobre a mesa.
pt.R: Mas o homem que vai {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trair está aqui, comendo nesta mesa {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}.

decisions.choice: the hand ... on the table: the betrayer is sharing this meal
alternatives: only that his hand happens to lie there
decisions.reason: To eat with someone was a bond of friendship. The psalmist grieves over a close friend who shared his bread and turned against him (Psalm 41:10). That makes the betrayal worse.

decisions.choice: the one handing me over: the betrayal is already under way
alternatives: the one who will one day betray me
decisions.reason: The present participle shows Judas has already agreed to it (22:4-6).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: the man ... eating at this table
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the hand on the table (m1).

decisions.choice: "nộp" (L); "phản bội" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 14:18: "phản bội" names Judas's act where no one is named to receive Jesus; Literal keeps the plain "hand over".

source.text: ὅτι ὁ υἱὸς μὲν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου κατὰ τὸ ὡρισμένον πορεύεται, πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι’ οὗ παραδίδοται.

records.literal_gloss: For the Son indeed of the man according to the having been determined goes, but woe to the man that through whom he is handed over.

en.L: For the Son of Man indeed goes according to what has been determined, but woe to that man through whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is handed over!"
en.B: The Son of Man is going the way that has been marked out for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But how terrible it will be for that man who betrays {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!"
en.R: The Son of Man will die, just as God has planned. But how terrible it will be for the man who betrays {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!"

es.L: Porque el Hijo del Hombre ciertamente va según lo que ha sido determinado; pero ¡ay de aquel hombre por medio del cual es entregado!».
es.B: El Hijo del Hombre sigue el camino que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha trazado. Pero ¡ay de aquel hombre que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} traiciona!».
es.R: El Hijo del Hombre va a morir, tal como Dios lo ha planeado. Pero ¡qué terrible será para el hombre que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} traiciona!».

fr.L: Car le Fils de l’homme, lui, s’en va selon ce qui a été fixé, mais malheur à cet homme par qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est livré ! »
fr.B: Le Fils de l’homme s’en va par le chemin qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a été tracé. Mais malheur à l’homme qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trahit ! »
fr.R: Le Fils de l’homme va mourir, comme Dieu l’a prévu. Mais quel malheur pour l’homme qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trahit ! »

sw.L: Kwa maana Mwana wa Adamu kweli anaenda kama ilivyokwisha kuamuliwa; lakini ole wake mtu yule ambaye kupitia kwake anakabidhiwa!"
sw.B: Mwana wa Adamu anaenda njia aliyowekewa. Lakini ole wake mtu yule anayemsaliti!"
sw.R: Mwana wa Adamu atakufa, kama Mungu alivyopanga. Lakini itakuwa vibaya sana kwa mtu yule anayemsaliti!"

vi.L: Vì quả thật Con Người ra đi theo như điều đã được định, nhưng khốn cho người mà qua người ấy Con Người bị nộp!"
vi.B: Con Người ra đi theo con đường đã được định sẵn. Nhưng khốn thay cho kẻ phản bội Con Người!"
vi.R: Con Người sẽ chết, đúng như Đức Chúa Trời đã định. Nhưng kẻ phản bội Con Người thật khốn khổ biết bao!"

ko.L: 인자는 정해진 대로 가지만, 그로 말미암아 인자가 넘겨지는 그 사람에게는 화가 있다!"
ko.B: 인자는 정해진 길을 가지만, 인자를 배반하는 그 사람은 얼마나 불행하냐!"
ko.R: 인자는 하나님께서 정하신 대로 죽을 것이다. 그러나 인자를 배반하는 그 사람은 얼마나 불행할까!"

pt.L: Pois o Filho do Homem, de fato, vai segundo o que foi determinado, mas ai daquele homem por meio de quem {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é entregue!"
pt.B: O Filho do Homem segue o caminho que foi traçado para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. Mas ai daquele homem que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} trai!"
pt.R: O Filho do Homem vai morrer, como Deus planejou. Mas como vai ser terrível para o homem que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} trair!"

decisions.choice: goes according to what has been determined: his death happens by God's plan
alternatives: by the plan of his enemies
decisions.reason: "Determined" means fixed beforehand. Luke says the same in Acts 2:23: Jesus was handed over by God's set plan and foreknowledge, yet those who killed him did wrong.

decisions.choice: goes: goes away to his death
decisions.reason: "Go" is used for departing this life, as Jesus' journey to Jerusalem has been leading to his death (9:51; 13:33).

decisions.choice: woe to that man: God's plan does not excuse the betrayer
decisions.reason: "Woe" is a cry of grief and warning (6:24-26; 17:1). God's plan and human guilt stand side by side.

decisions.choice: how terrible it will be for
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable avoid the old word "woe", as elsewhere in Luke.

decisions.choice: will die, just as God has planned
alternatives: goes according to what has been determined
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "goes" means (m2) and who determined it (m1).

decisions.choice: handed over (L); betrays (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 22:4, Literal keeps the plain sense of the verb.

decisions.choice: el Hijo del Hombre; ¡ay de! (L, B), qué terrible será (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used through the Gospels, recorded once in this chapter. "¡Ay de...!" carries both grief and warning (meaning decision m3); Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: malheur à (B); quel malheur pour (R)
alternatives: quel malheur pour (B), as the English "how terrible it will be"
decisions.reason: "Malheur à" is still current French, not archaic as "woe" is in English, so Balanced keeps it, as in the woes of 6:24-26; Readable says "quel malheur pour", as there.

decisions.choice: Mwana wa Adamu; ole wake (L, B), itakuwa vibaya sana (R)
decisions.reason: The terms used through the Gospels, recorded once in this chapter. "Ole" carries both grief and warning (meaning decision m3); Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Con Người" repeated for "him", with no setting span
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks of himself as the Son of Man; Vietnamese repeats the title rather than have him call himself "Ngài", as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:21.

decisions.choice: "인자" at every level; "화가 있다" (L), "얼마나 불행하냐" (B), "얼마나 불행할까" (R) for ouai
decisions.reason: The title and the cry of woe as in the Korean Mark 14:21. Literal keeps the Greek passive "is handed over" with "넘겨지다".

decisions.choice: ai daquele homem
alternatives: como vai ser terrível para aquele homem
decisions.reason: The English Balanced leaves "woe" because it is old-fashioned. Portuguese "ai de" is not: it is still the living cry of grief and warning, so Balanced keeps it, as Matthew's Balanced does in 26:24 (style §6). Readable says "como vai ser terrível", as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς τὸ τίς ἄρα εἴη ἐξ αὐτῶν ὁ τοῦτο μέλλων πράσσειν.

records.literal_gloss: And they began to discuss among themselves the who then it might be of them the [one] this being about to do.

en.L: And they began to question among themselves which of them it could be who was about to do this.
en.B: They began to ask one another which of them it could possibly be who was going to do such a thing.
en.R: The apostles began to ask each other, "Which one of us would do this?"

es.L: Y ellos comenzaron a discutir entre sí quién de ellos sería el que iba a hacer esto.
es.B: Ellos comenzaron a preguntarse unos a otros quién de ellos podría ser el que iba a hacer semejante cosa.
es.R: Los apóstoles comenzaron a preguntarse unos a otros: «¿Quién de nosotros haría algo así?».

fr.L: Et eux commencèrent à se demander entre eux qui donc d’entre eux pouvait être celui qui allait faire cela.
fr.B: Ils se mirent à se demander les uns aux autres lequel d’entre eux pouvait bien être celui qui allait faire une chose pareille.
fr.R: Les apôtres ont commencé à se demander entre eux : « Lequel d’entre nous va faire cela ? »

sw.L: Nao wakaanza kujadiliana wao kwa wao ni nani basi kati yao atakayefanya jambo hili.
sw.B: Wakaanza kuulizana wao kwa wao ni nani kati yao ambaye angeweza kufanya jambo kama hilo.
sw.R: Mitume wakaanza kuulizana, "Ni nani kati yetu angefanya jambo hili?"

vi.L: Và họ bắt đầu hỏi nhau xem ai trong họ là người sẽ làm điều này.
vi.B: Các môn đồ bắt đầu hỏi nhau xem ai trong họ lại có thể làm một việc như thế.
vi.R: Các sứ đồ bắt đầu hỏi nhau: "Ai trong chúng ta sẽ làm việc này?"

ko.L: 그러자 그들은 자기들 가운데 이 일을 하려는 사람이 도대체 누구일지 서로 묻기 시작했다.
ko.B: 그들은 자기들 가운데 누가 그런 일을 하려는 것인지 서로 묻기 시작했다.
ko.R: 사도들은 서로 묻기 시작했다. "우리 가운데 누가 그런 일을 하겠느냐?"

pt.L: E eles começaram a discutir entre si qual deles seria, então, o que estava para fazer isso.
pt.B: Eles começaram a perguntar uns aos outros qual deles poderia ser o que ia fazer uma coisa dessas.
pt.R: Os apóstolos começaram a perguntar uns aos outros: "Qual de nós faria uma coisa dessas?"

decisions.choice: who then it might be: they could not guess who it was
decisions.reason: The optative mood with "then" makes a doubtful question. None of them knew.

decisions.choice: a direct question
alternatives: which of them it could be
decisions.reason: Readable turns the indirect question into the words they might have said.

source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ καὶ φιλονεικία ἐν αὐτοῖς, τὸ τίς αὐτῶν δοκεῖ εἶναι μείζων.

records.literal_gloss: There was then also a dispute among them, the which of them seems to be greater.

en.L: And there was also a dispute among them, as to which of them seemed to be greater.
en.B: A quarrel also broke out among them over which of them was to be thought the greatest.
en.R: Then the apostles started to argue about which of them was the most important.

es.L: Y hubo también una disputa entre ellos sobre cuál de ellos parecía ser mayor.
es.B: Surgió además entre ellos una discusión sobre cuál de ellos debía ser considerado el mayor.
es.R: Luego los apóstoles empezaron a discutir sobre cuál de ellos era el más importante.

fr.L: Et il y eut aussi une querelle entre eux : lequel d’entre eux paraissait être le plus grand.
fr.B: Il s’éleva aussi entre eux une dispute : lequel d’entre eux devait être considéré comme le plus grand ?
fr.R: Ensuite, les apôtres se sont disputés pour savoir lequel d’entre eux était le plus important.

sw.L: Tena kukatokea ubishi kati yao, ni nani kati yao anayeonekana kuwa mkubwa zaidi.
sw.B: Pia kukazuka ugomvi kati yao kuhusu ni nani kati yao ahesabiwe kuwa mkuu kuliko wote.
sw.R: Kisha mitume wakaanza kubishana kuhusu ni nani kati yao aliyekuwa muhimu kuliko wote.

vi.L: Và cũng có một cuộc tranh cãi giữa họ, về việc ai trong họ được xem là lớn hơn.
vi.B: Giữa họ cũng nổ ra một cuộc tranh cãi xem ai trong họ được coi là lớn nhất.
vi.R: Rồi các sứ đồ cãi nhau xem ai trong họ là người quan trọng nhất.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 가운데 누가 더 크다고 여겨지는지를 두고 다툼도 일어났다.
ko.B: 그들 사이에 누가 가장 큰 사람으로 여겨지는지를 두고 다툼도 벌어졌다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 사도들은 자기들 가운데 누가 가장 중요한 사람인지를 두고 서로 다투기 시작했다.

pt.L: E houve também uma disputa entre eles [sobre] qual deles parecia ser maior.
pt.B: Surgiu também entre eles uma discussão sobre qual deles devia ser considerado o maior.
pt.R: Depois os apóstolos começaram a discutir sobre qual deles era o mais importante.

decisions.choice: dispute: a quarrel driven by love of winning
decisions.reason: The word means a love of strife, a contest. It comes right after the talk of betrayal, which makes it the more shameful.

decisions.choice: greater: the greatest, the one ranked first
decisions.reason: Greek often uses the comparative form for the superlative. They argue about rank among themselves, as in 9:46.

decisions.choice: seemed to be: was regarded as
alternatives: only appeared to be, but was not
decisions.reason: The verb means to be thought of or reckoned. Their question is about standing in others' eyes.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν κυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐξουσιάζοντες αὐτῶν εὐεργέται καλοῦνται.

records.literal_gloss: He and said to them, The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those exercising authority over them benefactors are called.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those who exercise authority over them are called benefactors.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles act as lords over their people, and those who hold power over them are given the title 'Benefactor'.
en.R: Jesus said to them, "The kings of the other nations rule over their people like masters. And men in power are honored with the title 'Benefactor', which means one who does good to others.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «Los reyes de los gentiles se enseñorean de ellos, y los que tienen autoridad sobre ellos son llamados benefactores.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «Los reyes de los gentiles dominan a sus pueblos como señores, y a los que tienen el poder sobre ellos se les da el título de “Benefactor”.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Los reyes de las otras naciones mandan sobre su gente como amos. Y a los hombres que tienen poder los honran con el título de “Benefactor”, que quiere decir “el que hace el bien a los demás”.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Les rois des nations dominent sur elles, et ceux qui exercent l’autorité sur elles se font appeler Bienfaiteurs.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Les rois des non-Juifs se conduisent en maîtres envers leurs peuples, et ceux qui ont le pouvoir sur eux reçoivent le titre de “Bienfaiteur”.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Les rois des autres nations commandent leurs peuples comme des maîtres. Et les gens qui ont du pouvoir reçoivent le titre de “Bienfaiteur”, c’est-à-dire celui qui fait du bien aux autres.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Wafalme wa mataifa hujifanya mabwana juu yao, na wale wenye mamlaka juu yao huitwa wafadhili.
sw.B: Lakini akawaambia, "Wafalme wa watu wa mataifa huwatawala watu wao kama mabwana, na wale wenye mamlaka juu yao hupewa cheo cha 'Mfadhili.'
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Wafalme wa mataifa mengine huwatawala watu wao kama mabwana. Na watu wenye mamlaka hupewa heshima ya kuitwa 'Mfadhili,' maana yake mtu anayewatendea wengine mema.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các vua của dân ngoại thống trị họ, và những người cầm quyền trên họ được gọi là ân nhân.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Các vua của các dân tộc làm chủ dân mình, và những người cầm quyền trên dân được tôn xưng là 'Ân Nhân'.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Vua chúa của các nước khác cai trị dân mình như những ông chủ. Những người có quyền thế được người ta tôn xưng là 'Ân Nhân', nghĩa là người làm ơn cho người khác.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이방인들의 왕들은 그들을 주인으로서 다스리고, 그들에게 권세를 부리는 자들은 은인이라고 불린다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "이방 사람들의 왕들은 백성 위에 군림하고, 백성을 다스리는 권력자들은 '은인'이라는 칭호를 얻는다.
ko.R: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "하나님을 모르는 민족들의 왕들은 주인처럼 백성을 다스린다. 그리고 권력을 가진 사람들은 '은인'이라는 칭호를 받는다. '은인'은 남에게 좋은 일을 해 주는 사람이라는 뜻이다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Os reis das nações dominam sobre elas, e os que exercem autoridade sobre elas são chamados benfeitores.
pt.B: Mas {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Os reis dos povos não judeus agem como senhores sobre eles, e os que têm poder sobre eles recebem o título de 'Benfeitor'.
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Os reis das outras nações mandam no seu povo como donos. E os homens que têm poder recebem a honra do título de 'Benfeitor', que quer dizer alguém que faz o bem aos outros.

decisions.choice: benefactors: a title of honor given to rulers and rich patrons
alternatives: a plain description of kind rulers
decisions.reason: Cities set up inscriptions calling kings and wealthy men "Benefactor" for their gifts, and some kings took it as part of their name. The title praised generosity, but it also put the giver above those who owed him thanks.

decisions.choice: are called: are given the title, or perhaps call themselves
decisions.reason: The form can be passive or middle. Either way the point is the same: rulers are honored for using power over others.

decisions.choice: lord it over: rule as masters
decisions.reason: The verb is built on the word for lord or master. It is not always harsh, but here it is set against serving (22:26).

decisions.choice: which means one who does good to others
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title (m1).

decisions.choice: the other nations
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words for peoples who were not Jews.

decisions.choice: se font appeler (L); reçoivent le titre (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek form can mean "are called" or "call themselves" (m2). French "se font appeler" at Literal leaves both readings open, as the English "are called" does; Balanced and Readable follow the English "are given the title".

decisions.choice: wafadhili (L); 'Mfadhili' (B, R)
decisions.reason: A title of honour for rulers and rich patrons (meaning decision m1). "Mfadhili" is one who supports and does good to others, the word still used of patrons and sponsors.

decisions.choice: "dân ngoại" (L); "các dân tộc" (B); "các nước khác" (R)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Mark 10:42, the parallel saying: Literal keeps the word for the Gentiles, Balanced and Readable speak of the nations and their rulers.

decisions.choice: "ân nhân" (L); "'Ân Nhân'" as a title (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Ân nhân" is the ordinary Vietnamese word for a benefactor; Balanced and Readable write it as the title of honor it was (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "이방인들" (L); "이방 사람들" (B); "하나님을 모르는 민족들" (R) for ta ethne
decisions.reason: The words settled for the Korean Matthew; Readable keeps "민족" so that the peoples ruled by kings stay in view.

decisions.choice: "은인" for euergetai, in quotation marks at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: A title of honour for rulers and patrons (meaning decision); "은인" is a person who has done one good, and Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: as nações (L); os povos não judeus (B); as outras nações (R)
decisions.reason: As style §6: Literal says "as nações", Balanced "não judeus" where the English says "Gentiles", here "os povos não judeus" because kings rule peoples. "Gentios" is church jargon few Brazilian readers use; "pagãos" is kept for a different Greek word (style §11).

source.text: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως, ἀλλ’ ὁ μείζων ἐν ὑμῖν γινέσθω ὡς ὁ νεώτερος, καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος ὡς ὁ διακονῶν·

records.literal_gloss: You but not thus, but the greater among you let him become as the younger, and the [one] leading as the [one] serving;

en.L: But you [are] not so; rather, let the greatest among you become as the youngest, and the one who leads as the one who serves.
en.B: With you it must not be this way. Instead, the greatest among you must become like the youngest, and the one in charge like the one who waits on others.
en.R: But you must not be like them. The most important person among you should act like the youngest. The leader should be like a servant.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no así; al contrario, el mayor entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} llegue a ser como el más joven, y el que dirige, como el que sirve.
es.B: Entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no debe ser así. Al contrario, el mayor entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe hacerse como el más joven, y el que manda, como el que atiende a los demás.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} ser como ellos. La persona más importante entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe portarse como el más joven. El que dirige debe ser como un servidor.

fr.L: Mais vous, non pas ainsi ; au contraire, que le plus grand parmi vous devienne comme le plus jeune, et celui qui dirige comme celui qui sert.
fr.B: Pour vous, il ne doit pas en être ainsi. Au contraire, que le plus grand parmi vous devienne comme le plus jeune, et celui qui commande comme celui qui fait le service.
fr.R: Mais vous, vous ne devez pas faire comme eux. Le plus important d’entre vous doit agir comme le plus jeune. Et celui qui dirige doit être comme un serviteur.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi si hivyo; bali aliye mkubwa kati yenu na awe kama aliye mdogo, na anayeongoza kama anayehudumu.
sw.B: Lakini kwenu isiwe hivyo. Badala yake, aliye mkubwa kati yenu awe kama aliye mdogo kuliko wote, na aliye kiongozi awe kama yule anayewahudumia wengine.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi msiwe kama wao. Mtu aliye muhimu zaidi kati yenu anapaswa kujifanya kama aliye mdogo kuliko wote. Kiongozi anapaswa kuwa kama mhudumu.

vi.L: Nhưng các con thì không như vậy; trái lại, người lớn nhất giữa các con hãy trở nên như người nhỏ nhất, và người lãnh đạo như người phục vụ.
vi.B: Nhưng giữa các con thì không được như vậy. Trái lại, người lớn nhất trong các con phải trở nên như người nhỏ nhất, và người lãnh đạo phải như người phục vụ.
vi.R: Nhưng các con không được như họ. Người quan trọng nhất trong các con phải cư xử như người nhỏ tuổi nhất. Người lãnh đạo phải giống như người phục vụ.

ko.L: 그러나 너희는 그렇게 [하지] 마라. 도리어 너희 가운데 더 큰 사람은 더 어린 사람처럼 되고, 다스리는 사람은 섬기는 사람처럼 되어라.
ko.B: 그러나 너희는 그래서는 안 된다. 너희 가운데 가장 큰 사람은 가장 어린 사람처럼 되어야 하고, 지도자는 섬기는 사람처럼 되어야 한다.
ko.R: 그러나 너희는 그들처럼 해서는 안 된다. 너희 가운데 가장 중요한 사람은 가장 어린 사람처럼 행동해야 한다. 지도자는 남을 섬기는 사람이 되어야 한다.

pt.L: Vocês, porém, não [sejam] assim; antes, o maior entre vocês se torne como o mais novo, e o que governa, como o que serve.
pt.B: Entre vocês não deve ser assim. Pelo contrário, o maior entre vocês deve se tornar como o mais novo, e quem lidera, como quem serve.
pt.R: Mas vocês não devem ser como eles. A pessoa mais importante entre vocês deve agir como o mais novo de todos. O líder deve ser como alguém que serve os outros.

decisions.choice: the youngest: the one with the lowest place, who did the humble tasks
decisions.reason: In that culture age gave rank. The youngest served the older ones and took the last place.

decisions.choice: the one who serves: the one who waits on people at table
decisions.reason: The verb is used for serving food at a meal (10:40; 12:37; 17:8), which fits the setting of the Last Supper and leads into 22:27.

decisions.choice: you not so: a command, not only a description
alternatives: a statement that they are already different
decisions.reason: There is no verb. The next words are commands, so this is best read as a command too.

decisions.choice: a servant
decisions.reason: Readable uses a single word; this is the verb for serving, not the word for slave.

decisions.choice: "người phục vụ" for the one who serves (diakonōn)
decisions.reason: The word of the Vietnamese Mark 10:43 for diakonos; "đầy tớ" is kept for doulos, so the two Greek words stay apart.

decisions.choice: "섬기는 사람" for ho diakonon (22:26-27); "시중드는 사람" (B) in the table picture of 22:27a
decisions.reason: The Greek word is one who waits on others at table (meaning decision); "섬기는 사람" keeps the saying about Jesus himself in 22:27, and "종" stays for doulos (22:50).

decisions.choice: "그렇게 [하지] 마라" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb, and the meaning decision reads it as a command; Korean must choose a verb, and Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: não [sejam] assim
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb. The meaning note (m3) reads it as a command, and Portuguese must choose a mood, so Literal supplies the subjunctive of command, in brackets, where the English could leave "[are]" open.

source.text: τίς γὰρ μείζων, ὁ ἀνακείμενος ἢ ὁ διακονῶν;

records.literal_gloss: Who for [is] greater, the [one] reclining or the [one] serving?

en.L: For who [is] greater, the one reclining [at table] or the one serving?
en.B: Think about it: who is greater, the guest who lies at the table, or the one who serves the meal?
en.R: Who is more important, the person eating at the table or the one serving the food?

es.L: Porque ¿quién [es] mayor, el que está reclinado [a la mesa] o el que sirve?
es.B: {{plural_you:Piénsenlo|Pensadlo}}: ¿quién es mayor, el invitado que está a la mesa o el que sirve la comida?
es.R: ¿Quién es más importante, el que está comiendo a la mesa o el que sirve la comida?

fr.L: Car qui [est] le plus grand, celui qui est à table ou celui qui sert ?
fr.B: Réfléchissez : qui est le plus grand, l’invité allongé à table ou celui qui sert le repas ?
fr.R: Qui est le plus important : celui qui mange à table ou celui qui sert les plats ?

sw.L: Kwa maana ni nani aliye mkubwa, yule anayeegemea [mezani] au yule anayehudumu?
sw.B: Fikirini: ni nani mkubwa zaidi, mgeni aliyeegemea mezani, au yule anayewahudumia chakula?
sw.R: Ni nani aliye muhimu zaidi, mtu anayekula mezani au yule anayewaletea watu chakula?

vi.L: Vì ai lớn hơn, người ngả mình [bên bàn ăn] hay người phục vụ?
vi.B: Hãy nghĩ xem: ai lớn hơn, người khách ngồi ăn hay người dọn bữa?
vi.R: Ai quan trọng hơn, người ngồi ăn hay người dọn thức ăn?

ko.L: 누가 더 크냐? [식탁에] 기대어 앉은 사람이냐, 섬기는 사람이냐?
ko.B: 생각해 보아라. 누가 더 높으냐? 식탁에 앉아 있는 손님이냐, 시중드는 사람이냐?
ko.R: 누가 더 중요하냐? 식탁에 앉아서 먹는 사람이냐, 음식을 나르는 사람이냐?

pt.L: Pois quem [é] maior, o que está reclinado [à mesa] ou o que serve?
pt.B: Pensem bem: quem é maior, o convidado que está à mesa ou aquele que serve a refeição?
pt.R: Quem é mais importante: a pessoa que está comendo à mesa ou a que está servindo a comida?

decisions.choice: the one reclining: the guest at a meal
decisions.reason: Guests lay at the table (22:14) while servants brought the food.

decisions.choice: Think about it
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the force of "for", which brings a reason, as a call to consider.

source.text: οὐχὶ ὁ ἀνακείμενος;

records.literal_gloss: Not the [one] reclining?

en.L: [Is it] not the one reclining?
en.B: Surely the one at the table.
en.R: Everyone would say it is the one eating.

es.L: ¿No [es] el que está reclinado?
es.B: Sin duda, el que está a la mesa.
es.R: Todos dirían que el que come.

fr.L: N’[est-ce] pas celui qui est à table ?
fr.B: C’est évidemment celui qui est à table.
fr.R: Tout le monde dira que c’est celui qui mange.

sw.L: Si yule anayeegemea [mezani]?
sw.B: Bila shaka ni yule aliye mezani.
sw.R: Kila mtu angesema ni yule anayekula.

vi.L: Chẳng phải là người ngả mình [bên bàn ăn] sao?
vi.B: Hẳn là người ngồi ăn rồi.
vi.R: Ai cũng sẽ nói là người ngồi ăn.

ko.L: [식탁에] 기대어 앉은 사람이 아니냐?
ko.B: 물론 식탁에 앉아 있는 사람이다.
ko.R: 누구나 식탁에 앉아서 먹는 사람이라고 말할 것이다.

pt.L: Não [é] o que está reclinado?
pt.B: Com certeza é o que está à mesa.
pt.R: Todo mundo diria que é a que está comendo.

decisions.choice: not the one reclining?: a question that expects the answer yes
decisions.reason: The negative used here expects agreement. By the world's measure, the guest is greater.

decisions.choice: a statement
alternatives: Is it not the one at the table?
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the answer the question expects (m1).

source.text: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν εἰμι ὡς ὁ διακονῶν.

records.literal_gloss: I but in midst of you am as the [one] serving.

en.L: But I am in [the] midst of you as the one serving.
en.B: Yet here I am among you as the one who serves.
en.R: But I am here with you as one who serves you.

es.L: Pero yo estoy en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como el que sirve.
es.B: Sin embargo, aquí estoy yo entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como el que sirve.
es.R: Pero yo estoy aquí con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} como uno que {{plural_you:les|os}} sirve.

fr.L: Mais moi, je suis au milieu de vous comme celui qui sert.
fr.B: Et pourtant, moi, je suis parmi vous comme celui qui sert.
fr.R: Mais moi, je suis ici avec vous comme quelqu’un qui vous sert.

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko katikati yenu kama yule anayehudumu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko hapa kati yenu kama yule anayehudumu.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} niko hapa pamoja nanyi kama mtu anayewahudumia.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở giữa các con như người phục vụ.
vi.B: Thế mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở giữa các con như người phục vụ.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đây với các con như một người phục vụ các con.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 너희 가운데에서 섬기는 사람으로 있다.
ko.B: 그런데 나는 너희 가운데에서 섬기는 사람으로 있다.
ko.R: 그러나 나는 너희와 함께 있으면서 너희를 섬기고 있다.

pt.L: Mas eu estou no meio de vocês como o que serve.
pt.B: No entanto, aqui estou eu entre vocês como aquele que serve.
pt.R: Mas eu estou aqui com vocês como alguém que serve vocês.

decisions.choice: I am among you as the one serving: Jesus turns the order upside down
alternatives: he only played the part of a servant this once
decisions.reason: Jesus, their Lord and teacher, takes the servant's place, as he pictures the master who serves his slaves in 12:37. John tells how he washed their feet at this meal (John 13:4-15).

decisions.choice: "moi, je" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The stressed "moi" here only doubles the subject "je", which never carries the span when Jesus speaks; the English "I" has none either.

source.text: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε οἱ διαμεμενηκότες μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν τοῖς πειρασμοῖς μου·

records.literal_gloss: You and are those having remained with me in the trials of me;

en.L: And you are those who have remained with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} trials.
en.B: You are the ones who have stood by {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} trials.
en.R: You have stayed with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} through all {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hard times.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:ustedes son|vosotros sois}} los que {{plural_you:han permanecido|habéis permanecido}} conmigo en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pruebas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} los que {{plural_you:se han mantenido|os habéis mantenido}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lado en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} pruebas.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes se han quedado|Vosotros os habéis quedado}} conmigo en todos {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} momentos difíciles.

fr.L: Et vous, vous êtes ceux qui sont demeurés avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} épreuves.
fr.B: Vous, vous êtes restés fidèlement avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} épreuves.
fr.R: Vous êtes restés avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pendant tous {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} moments difficiles.

sw.L: Nanyi ndinyi mliodumu pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} katika majaribu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Ninyi ndio mliosimama pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} katika majaribu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Ninyi mmekaa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} katika taabu zote {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.

vi.L: Còn các con là những người đã ở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong những cơn thử thách của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Các con là những người đã luôn đứng bên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong những lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bị thử thách.
vi.R: Các con đã ở bên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong mọi lúc khó khăn của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그런데 너희는 내 시련들 가운데서 나와 함께 끝까지 머물러 있던 사람들이다.
ko.B: 너희는 내가 시련을 겪을 때마다 내 곁을 떠나지 않은 사람들이다.
ko.R: 너희는 내가 어려운 일을 당할 때마다 언제나 나와 함께 있어 주었다.

pt.L: E vocês são os que permaneceram {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} nas {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} provações.
pt.B: Vocês são os que ficaram ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lado nas {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} provações.
pt.R: Vocês ficaram {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}} em todos os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} momentos difíceis.

decisions.choice: trials: hardships and tests
decisions.reason: The word can mean temptation (22:40) or trial. Here it means the opposition and testing Jesus met during his work, which the apostles shared.

decisions.choice: have remained: they stayed loyal, and still are with him
decisions.reason: The perfect tense looks at their loyalty up to now. Jesus praises them even though he knows they will soon fail (22:34, 45).

decisions.choice: "thử thách" (L, B); "lúc khó khăn" (R) for peirasmoi
decisions.reason: Here the word means hardships and tests that Jesus went through (meaning decision), not the temptation to fall of 22:40 and 22:46, where "cám dỗ" is used.

decisions.choice: "시련" (L, B); "어려운 일" (R) for peirasmoi here
decisions.reason: The same Greek word is "시험" in 22:40 and 22:46, where it is the testing that could make the disciples fall; here it means the hardships Jesus has met (meaning decision), which "시련" says.

source.text: κἀγὼ διατίθεμαι ὑμῖν, καθὼς διέθετό μοι ὁ πατήρ μου βασιλείαν, ἵνα ἔσθητε καὶ πίνητε ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ μου, καὶ καθήσεσθε ἐπὶ θρόνων τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς κρίνοντες τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.

records.literal_gloss: And I assign to you, as assigned to me the Father of me a kingdom, \v 30 so that you may eat and may drink at the table of me in the kingdom of me, and you will sit on thrones the twelve tribes judging of the Israel.

en.L: And I assign to you, just as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father assigned to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, a kingdom, \v 30 so that you may eat and drink at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} table in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} kingdom, and you will sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
en.B: And just as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Father has granted {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a kingdom, so I grant one to you. \v 30 You will eat and drink at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} table in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} kingdom, and you will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
en.R: My Father has given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} a kingdom. In the same way, I am giving you a share in ruling it. \v 30 You will eat and drink at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} table in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} kingdom. And you will sit on thrones and judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

es.L: Y yo {{plural_you:les|os}} asigno, así como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} asignó, un reino, \v 30 para que {{plural_you:coman|comáis}} y {{plural_you:beban|bebáis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mesa en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reino, y {{plural_you:se sentarán|os sentaréis}} sobre tronos juzgando a las doce tribus de Israel.
es.B: Y así como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} Padre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha concedido un reino, así también yo {{plural_you:les|os}} concedo uno a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 30 {{plural_you:Comerán|Comeréis}} y {{plural_you:beberán|beberéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mesa en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reino, y {{plural_you:se sentarán|os sentaréis}} en tronos para juzgar a las doce tribus de Israel.
es.R: Mi Padre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha dado un reino. De la misma manera, yo {{plural_you:les|os}} doy a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una parte en el gobierno de ese reino. \v 30 {{plural_you:Comerán|Comeréis}} y {{plural_you:beberán|beberéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mesa en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reino. Y {{plural_you:se sentarán|os sentaréis}} en tronos para juzgar a las doce tribus de Israel.

fr.L: Et moi, je dispose pour vous, comme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père a disposé pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, d’un royaume, \v 30 afin que vous mangiez et buviez à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} table dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} royaume, et vous siégerez sur des trônes, jugeant les douze tribus d’Israël.
fr.B: Comme {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} Père {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a confié un royaume, je vous en confie un à mon tour. \v 30 Vous mangerez et boirez à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} table dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} royaume, et vous siégerez sur des trônes pour juger les douze tribus d’Israël.
fr.R: Mon Père {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donné un royaume. De la même façon, je vous donne une part dans le gouvernement de ce royaume. \v 30 Vous mangerez et vous boirez à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} table dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} royaume. Et vous serez assis sur des trônes pour juger les douze tribus d’Israël.

sw.L: Nami nawawekea, kama vile Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} alivyoniwekea {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, ufalme, \v 30 ili mle na mnywe katika meza {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nanyi mtaketi juu ya viti vya enzi mkiyahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
sw.B: Na kama vile Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} alivyonipa ufalme, ndivyo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninavyowapa ninyi. \v 30 Mtakula na kunywa katika meza {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na mtaketi juu ya viti vya enzi, mkiyahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.
sw.R: Baba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} amenipa ufalme. Vivyo hivyo {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} ninawapa sehemu katika kuutawala. \v 30 Mtakula na kunywa katika meza {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} katika ufalme {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nanyi mtaketi juu ya viti vya enzi na kuyahukumu makabila kumi na mawili ya Israeli.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ban cho các con, như Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, một vương quốc, \v 30 để các con được ăn uống tại bàn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và các con sẽ ngồi trên các ngai mà xét xử mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Như Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một vương quốc, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ban cho các con như vậy. \v 30 Các con sẽ được ăn uống tại bàn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và sẽ ngồi trên các ngai để xét xử mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Cha {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một vương quốc. Cũng vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho các con cùng cai trị vương quốc ấy với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \v 30 Các con sẽ ăn uống tại bàn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong vương quốc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Các con sẽ ngồi trên các ngai và xét xử mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 내 아버지께서 나에게 나라를 맡겨 주신 것처럼, 나도 너희에게 [나라를] 맡겨 준다. \v 30 이는 너희가 내 나라에서 내 식탁에서 먹고 마시게 하려는 것이다. 그리고 너희는 보좌들에 앉아 이스라엘의 열두 지파를 심판할 것이다.
ko.B: 내 아버지께서 나에게 나라를 맡겨 주신 것처럼, 나도 너희에게 나라를 맡겨 준다. \v 30 너희는 내 나라에서 내 식탁에 앉아 먹고 마실 것이며, 보좌에 앉아 이스라엘의 열두 지파를 심판할 것이다.
ko.R: 내 아버지께서 나에게 나라를 주셨다. 그와 같이 나도 너희에게 그 나라를 다스리는 일을 함께 맡긴다. \v 30 너희는 내 나라에서 내 식탁에 앉아 나와 함께 먹고 마실 것이다. 그리고 보좌에 앉아 이스라엘의 열두 지파를 심판할 것이다.

pt.L: E eu lhes confiro, assim como o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conferiu, um reino, \v 30 para que comam e bebam à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mesa no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Reino, e vocês se sentarão sobre tronos, julgando as doze tribos de Israel.
pt.B: E, assim como o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} concedeu um reino, eu também concedo um a vocês. \v 30 Vocês vão comer e beber à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mesa no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Reino e vão se sentar em tronos, julgando as doze tribos de Israel.
pt.R: O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Pai {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deu um reino. Do mesmo modo, eu estou dando a vocês uma parte no governo desse reino. \v 30 Vocês vão comer e beber à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mesa no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} Reino. E vão se sentar em tronos e julgar as doze tribos de Israel.

decisions.choice: assign: grant by a solemn arrangement
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word for covenant in 22:20 and can mean to make a covenant or a will. Here it means to grant or hand on. The link with the new covenant may be intended.

decisions.choice: I assign to you a kingdom: the kingdom is the object of both verbs
alternatives: I make a covenant with you, as my Father gave me a kingdom, that you may eat
decisions.reason: The word "kingdom" comes at the end of the clause about the Father, but it belongs to both: as the Father granted Jesus a kingdom, Jesus grants it to them. Another reading takes Jesus' gift to be the right to eat and drink at his table.

decisions.choice: sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes: share in ruling God's people
decisions.reason: "Judging" can mean ruling, as Israel's judges ruled. The twelve apostles stand for a renewed Israel under Jesus' rule (Matthew 19:28).

decisions.choice: eat and drink at my table: share the feast of the kingdom
decisions.reason: Eating at a king's table was an honor (2 Samuel 9:7). The kingdom is pictured as a feast (13:29; 14:15).

decisions.choice: the Father's gift first, then Jesus' gift
alternatives: I assign to you, as my Father assigned to me, a kingdom
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the Father's gift first so the sentence reads clearly.

decisions.choice: a share in ruling it
decisions.reason: Readable explains what it means for the apostles to receive a kingdom (m3).

decisions.choice: disposer de (L); confier (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is used for settling something on someone by a formal arrangement (m1). "Disposer pour vous d’un royaume" keeps the Greek order at Literal, with the kingdom as the object of both verbs (m2); "léguer" would add the idea of a will. Balanced says "confier", which puts the kingdom in their hands without saying more.

decisions.choice: nawawekea
decisions.reason: To grant by a solemn arrangement (meaning decision m1, uncertain). "Kuwekea" is to set something aside for someone, which keeps the sense of an appointed gift; Balanced and Readable say "kupa" (give), as the English says "grant".

decisions.choice: "ngồi trên các ngai"; "mười hai chi phái Y-sơ-ra-ên"
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Matthew 19:28, the parallel promise; "ngai" is a royal seat.

decisions.choice: "Cha Ta", with the span on "Ta" only
decisions.reason: "Cha" is a noun of address, always capitalised (style guide section 7); only the pronoun takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "맡겨 주다" for diatithemi; "내 아버지께서 ... 주신" with the honorific
decisions.reason: The verb is a solemn granting (meaning decision); "맡겨 주다" says the kingdom is given into their charge. Jesus speaks of the Father with the honorific, as everywhere in the Korean Gospels.

decisions.choice: um reino; no meu Reino
decisions.reason: The kingdom granted is first named without the article, "um reino", in lower case. "My kingdom" at the table is the kingdom of God of 22:16 and 22:18, so it takes the capital Portuguese gives "o Reino de Deus" (style §5).

source.text: Σίμων Σίμων, ἰδοὺ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐξῃτήσατο ὑμᾶς τοῦ σινιάσαι ὡς τὸν σῖτον·

records.literal_gloss: Simon, Simon, look, the Satan demanded to have you to sift as the wheat;

en.L: Simon, Simon, look, Satan has demanded [to have] you, to sift [you] like wheat.
en.B: Simon, Simon, Satan has demanded to have all of you, to sift you like wheat.
en.R: Simon, Simon, listen! Satan has asked to have all of you. He wants to shake you the way a farmer shakes wheat to sift it.

es.L: Simón, Simón, mira, Satanás {{plural_you:los|os}} ha reclamado para {{plural_you:zarandearlos|zarandearos}} como al trigo.
es.B: Simón, Simón, Satanás {{plural_you:los|os}} ha reclamado a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para {{plural_you:zarandearlos|zarandearos}} como se zarandea el trigo.
es.R: Simón, Simón, ¡escucha! Satanás ha pedido {{plural_you:tenerlos|teneros}} a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Quiere {{plural_you:sacudirlos|sacudiros}} como el campesino sacude el trigo para limpiarlo.

fr.L: Simon, Simon, voici, Satan vous a réclamés pour vous passer au crible comme le blé.
fr.B: Simon, Simon, Satan vous a réclamés, tous, pour vous secouer au crible comme on fait pour le blé.
fr.R: Simon, Simon, écoute ! Satan a demandé à vous avoir, vous tous. Il veut vous secouer, comme un paysan secoue le blé dans un tamis.

sw.L: Simoni, Simoni, tazama, Shetani amedai [kuwapata] ninyi, ili awapepete kama ngano.
sw.B: Simoni, Simoni, Shetani ameomba awapate ninyi nyote, ili awapepete kama ngano.
sw.R: Simoni, Simoni, sikiliza! Shetani ameomba awapate ninyi nyote. Anataka kuwatikisa kama mkulima anavyotikisa ngano ili kuitenga na makapi.

vi.L: Si-môn, Si-môn, kìa, Sa-tan đã đòi [được] các con, để sàng [các con] như [sàng] lúa mì.
vi.B: Si-môn, Si-môn, Sa-tan đã đòi được sàng tất cả các con như người ta sàng lúa mì.
vi.R: Si-môn, Si-môn, hãy nghe đây! Sa-tan đã xin được thử thách tất cả các con. Nó muốn lắc mạnh các con, như người nông dân lắc sàng để sàng lúa mì.

ko.L: 시몬아, 시몬아, 보라, 사탄이 너희를 밀처럼 체질하겠다고 너희를 요구하였다.
ko.B: 시몬아, 시몬아, 사탄이 너희를 밀처럼 체질하겠다고 너희를 내어 달라고 요구하였다.
ko.R: 시몬아, 시몬아, 잘 들어라! 사탄이 너희를 자기에게 넘겨 달라고 요구하였다. 농부가 밀을 체에 넣고 흔들듯이, 사탄은 너희를 마구 흔들어 보려고 한다.

pt.L: Simão, Simão, veja: Satanás reclamou vocês, para peneirá-los como o trigo.
pt.B: Simão, Simão, Satanás pediu para ter todos vocês, para peneirá-los como trigo.
pt.R: Simão, Simão, escute! Satanás pediu para ter todos vocês. Ele quer sacudir vocês como o agricultor sacode o trigo para peneirá-lo.

decisions.choice: no introduction (SBLGNT)
alternatives: many later manuscripts begin with "And the Lord said"
decisions.reason: Several early manuscripts have no words of introduction, so Jesus' speech runs on from 22:30. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: you: all of you, the apostles
decisions.reason: The pronoun is plural. Satan wants all of them; Jesus prays for Simon in particular (22:32, where "you" is singular).

decisions.choice: demanded: asked for and obtained permission
decisions.reason: The verb means to ask for someone to be handed over. As in Job 1-2, Satan can test God's people only with God's leave.

decisions.choice: to sift like wheat: to shake them hard, testing them to see what falls away
decisions.reason: Grain was shaken in a sieve to separate it from dirt and chaff. Satan wants to shake their faith with trouble (Amos 9:9).

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: the way a farmer shakes wheat to sift it
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m4).

decisions.choice: los|os (plural) even at Literal
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Simon, but the "you" Satan has demanded is all the apostles (meaning decision m2). Spanish shows the plural in the pronoun at every level, so Literal needs no added "all".

decisions.choice: vous (plural) to the apostles, then "tu" to Simon in 22:32
decisions.reason: Greek changes from plural to singular between the two verses (m2 here; m1 of 22:32), and French shows it with "vous" and "tu" as the English cannot; Balanced and Readable add "tous" as the English adds "all of you".

decisions.choice: ninyi, awapepete (plural)
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to Simon, but the "you" Satan has demanded is all the apostles (meaning decision m2). Swahili shows the plural in "ninyi" and the object marker "-wa-". "Kupepeta" is to toss grain on a tray to separate the chaff, the Swahili picture for sifting.

decisions.choice: "các con", plural, though Jesus speaks to Simon
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" is plural here (meaning decision), all the apostles, while in 22:32 it turns singular, Simon alone; Vietnamese shows the change with "các con" and "con".

decisions.choice: "Nó" (R) for Satan
decisions.reason: Satan is spoken of with "nó", as in the Vietnamese Luke 11:18.

decisions.choice: "너희" for the plural "you", though Jesus speaks to Simon
decisions.reason: Satan asked for all the apostles (meaning decision); Korean marks the plural with "너희", so the change to "너" in 22:32 stays visible, as in the Greek.

decisions.choice: vocês (here); você (22:32)
decisions.reason: Portuguese can show what the Greek shows and the English cannot: Satan asks for all the apostles ("vocês", plural, m2), while Jesus prays for Simon alone ("você", 22:32, m1). Literal's "veja" is singular, since it is said to Simon.

source.text: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐδεήθην περὶ σοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἐκλίπῃ ἡ πίστις σου· καὶ σύ ποτε ἐπιστρέψας στήρισον τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου.

records.literal_gloss: I but begged for you that not may fail the faith of you; and you once having turned back strengthen the brothers of you.

en.L: But I have prayed for you, that your faith may not fail; and you, when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."
en.B: But I have prayed for you, so that your faith will not give out. And you, once you have turned back, must strengthen your brothers."
en.R: But I have prayed for you, Simon. I asked that your faith would not fail. When you have come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, help your brothers to stand firm."

es.L: Pero yo he rogado por ti, para que no falle tu fe; y tú, una vez que hayas vuelto, fortalece a tus hermanos».
es.B: Pero yo he orado por ti, para que tu fe no se agote. Y tú, cuando hayas vuelto, tienes que fortalecer a tus hermanos».
es.R: Pero yo he orado por ti, Simón. He pedido que tu fe no se acabe. Cuando hayas vuelto a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, ayuda a tus hermanos a mantenerse firmes».

fr.L: Mais moi, j’ai prié pour toi, afin que ta foi ne défaille pas ; et toi, quand tu seras revenu, affermis tes frères. »
fr.B: Mais moi, j’ai prié pour toi, pour que ta foi ne s’éteigne pas. Et toi, quand tu seras revenu, fortifie tes frères. »
fr.R: Mais moi, j’ai prié pour toi, Simon. J’ai demandé que ta foi ne disparaisse pas. Quand tu seras revenu vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, aide tes frères à tenir bon. »

sw.L: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimekuombea, ili imani yako isikome; nawe ukisha kurudi, uwaimarishe ndugu zako."
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimekuombea ili imani yako isikome. Nawe, utakapokuwa umerudi, uwatie nguvu ndugu zako."
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nimekuombea, Simoni. Nimeomba imani yako isikome. Utakaporudi {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, uwasaidie ndugu zako wasimame imara."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cầu xin cho con, để đức tin con không bị mất; và khi con đã quay trở lại, hãy làm cho anh em con vững mạnh."
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cầu nguyện cho con, để đức tin con không suy sụp. Và khi con đã quay trở lại, hãy làm cho anh em con được vững vàng."
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cầu nguyện cho con, Si-môn. Ta cầu xin để đức tin của con không mất đi. Khi con đã quay trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy giúp anh em con đứng vững."

ko.L: 그러나 나는 네 믿음이 떨어지지 않도록 너를 위하여 간구하였다. 그리고 너는 언젠가 돌이킨 뒤에 네 형제들을 굳세게 하여라."
ko.B: 그러나 나는 네 믿음이 꺾이지 않도록 너를 위하여 기도하였다. 그러니 너는 돌아온 뒤에 네 형제들을 굳세게 해 주어라."
ko.R: 그러나 시몬아, 나는 너를 위하여 기도하였다. 네가 믿음을 잃지 않게 해 달라고 기도하였다. 네가 나에게 다시 돌아오면, 네 형제들이 굳게 서도록 도와주어라."

pt.L: Mas eu roguei por você, para que a sua fé não desfaleça; e você, quando tiver voltado, fortaleça os seus irmãos."
pt.B: Mas eu orei por você, para que a sua fé não se acabe. E você, depois de ter voltado, fortaleça os seus irmãos."
pt.R: Mas eu orei por você, Simão. Pedi que a sua fé não falhasse. Quando você voltar para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, ajude os seus irmãos a ficarem firmes."

decisions.choice: you: Simon alone
decisions.reason: These pronouns are singular, unlike "you" in 22:31. Jesus prays for Simon, who will deny him and then be restored.

decisions.choice: turned back: come back after failing
alternatives: been converted for the first time
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn around or return. Jesus foresees Peter's denial and his return.

decisions.choice: your brothers: the other apostles and fellow believers
decisions.reason: Peter later strengthens the believers (Acts 1:15; 2:14). Here the word means the men around the table, so no gender alternative is given.

decisions.choice: fail: give out, die away
decisions.reason: The verb is used of something running out (16:9). Peter's courage fails, but his faith is not lost.

decisions.choice: come back to me; Simon
decisions.reason: Readable names Simon and says to whom he returns (m2).

decisions.choice: "con", singular, for Simon
decisions.reason: Jesus now speaks to Simon alone (meaning decision), as a teacher to one disciple, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:30.

decisions.choice: "믿음" at every level; "형제들" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Faith is a key term. The English has no gender setting here, where the brothers are first the other apostles (meaning decision); the Korean follows it.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Κύριε, μετὰ σοῦ ἕτοιμός εἰμι καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν καὶ εἰς θάνατον πορεύεσθαι.

records.literal_gloss: He and said to him, Lord, with you ready I am both to prison and to death to go.

en.L: And he said to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I am ready to go both to prison and to death."
en.B: Peter answered {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Lord, I am ready to go to prison with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and even to die with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.R: Peter said, "Lord, I am ready to go to prison with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I am even ready to die with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!"

es.L: Y él {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dijo: «Señor, contigo estoy dispuesto a ir tanto a la cárcel como a la muerte».
es.B: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondió: «Señor, estoy dispuesto a ir contigo a la cárcel, y hasta a morir contigo».
es.R: Pedro dijo: «Señor, estoy listo para ir contigo a la cárcel. ¡Estoy listo incluso para morir contigo!».

fr.L: Et il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dit : « Seigneur, avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je suis prêt à aller et en prison et à la mort. »
fr.B: Pierre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} répondit : « Seigneur, je suis prêt à aller en prison avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et même à mourir avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. »
fr.R: Pierre a dit : « Seigneur, je suis prêt à aller en prison avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Je suis même prêt à mourir avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! »

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Bwana, pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} niko tayari kwenda hata gerezani na hata kifoni."
sw.B: Petro akamjibu, "Bwana, niko tayari kwenda gerezani pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}, na hata kufa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}."
sw.R: Petro akasema, "Bwana, niko tayari kwenda gerezani pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. Niko tayari hata kufa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}!"

vi.L: Nhưng ông nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Lạy Chúa, với Chúa, con sẵn sàng đi cả vào tù lẫn vào cõi chết."
vi.B: Phi-e-rơ thưa với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Lạy Chúa, con sẵn sàng đi tù với Chúa, và cả chết với Chúa nữa."
vi.R: Phi-e-rơ thưa: "Lạy Chúa, con sẵn sàng đi tù với Chúa. Con cũng sẵn sàng chết với Chúa nữa!"

ko.L: 그러자 그가 그분께 말했다. "주님, 저는 주님과 함께라면 감옥에도, 죽음에도 갈 준비가 되어 있습니다."
ko.B: 베드로가 예수께 말했다. "주님, 저는 주님과 함께 감옥에 갈 각오도, 죽을 각오도 되어 있습니다."
ko.R: 베드로가 말했다. "주님, 저는 주님과 함께 감옥에 갈 수도 있습니다. 주님과 함께 죽을 각오도 되어 있습니다!"

pt.L: E ele {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} disse: "Senhor, {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}} estou pronto a ir tanto para a prisão como para a morte."
pt.B: Pedro {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} respondeu: "Senhor, estou pronto para ir {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}} para a prisão, e até para morrer {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}."
pt.R: Pedro disse: "Senhor, eu estou pronto para ir {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}} para a prisão. Estou pronto até para morrer {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}!"

decisions.choice: with you: placed first for emphasis
decisions.reason: Peter puts "with you" first: whatever happens to Jesus, he will share it.

decisions.choice: Peter
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker.

decisions.choice: "Lạy Chúa", "Chúa" for "you" and "con" for himself, with no setting span
decisions.reason: Peter calls Jesus "Lord" (kyrie); as in the Vietnamese Luke 12:41, disciples who call Jesus Lord say "Lạy Chúa" and use "Chúa" for "you"; words of address take no span.

decisions.choice: "주님" for kyrie and for "you"; Peter speaks in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: As the disciples speak to Jesus through the Korean Luke: kyrie from a disciple is "주님", and Korean repeats the title where English says "you".

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Λέγω σοι, Πέτρε, οὐ φωνήσει σήμερον ἀλέκτωρ ἕως τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ εἰδέναι.

records.literal_gloss: He and said, I tell you, Peter, not will crow today a rooster until three times me you will deny knowing.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "I tell you, Peter, a rooster will not crow today until you deny three times that you know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: Jesus replied, "I tell you, Peter, before a rooster crows today, you will have said three times that you do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: Jesus answered, "Peter, I tell you, before the rooster crows today, three times you will say that you do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dijo: «Te digo, Pedro, que no cantará hoy el gallo hasta que tres veces hayas negado que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoces».
es.B: Jesús le respondió: «Te digo, Pedro, que antes de que un gallo cante hoy, tú habrás dicho tres veces que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoces».
es.R: Jesús le contestó: «Pedro, te digo que hoy, antes de que cante el gallo, tres veces dirás que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoces».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Je te le dis, Pierre, le coq ne chantera pas aujourd’hui avant que tu aies nié trois fois {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître. »
fr.B: Jésus lui répondit : « Je te le dis, Pierre, avant que le coq chante aujourd’hui, tu auras déclaré trois fois que tu ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connais pas. »
fr.R: Jésus lui a répondu : « Pierre, je te le dis : aujourd’hui, avant que le coq chante, tu diras trois fois que tu ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connais pas. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Nakuambia, Petro, jogoo hatawika leo mpaka utakapokana mara tatu kwamba unanijua."
sw.B: Yesu akajibu, "Nakuambia, Petro, kabla jogoo hajawika leo, utakuwa umesema mara tatu kwamba hunijui."
sw.R: Yesu akamjibu, "Petro, nakuambia, leo kabla jogoo hajawika, mara tatu utasema kwamba hunijui."

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói: "Phi-e-rơ, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với con, hôm nay gà sẽ không gáy cho đến khi con chối ba lần rằng con biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Phi-e-rơ, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với con, hôm nay trước khi gà gáy, con sẽ ba lần chối rằng con không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Phi-e-rơ, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với con: hôm nay, trước khi gà gáy, con sẽ ba lần nói rằng con không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 말씀하셨다. "베드로야, 내가 너에게 말한다. 네가 나를 안다는 것을 세 번 부인하기까지 오늘 닭이 울지 않을 것이다."
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "베드로야, 내가 너에게 말한다. 오늘 닭이 울기 전에, 너는 나를 모른다고 세 번 부인할 것이다."
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "베드로야, 내가 말한다. 오늘 닭이 울기 전에, 너는 나를 모른다고 세 번이나 말할 것이다."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} disse: "Eu lhe digo, Pedro, um galo não cantará hoje até que você negue três vezes que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhece."
pt.B: Jesus respondeu: "Eu lhe digo, Pedro: antes que um galo cante hoje, você terá dito três vezes que não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhece."
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "Pedro, eu digo a você: antes que o galo cante hoje, você vai dizer três vezes que não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhece."

decisions.choice: today a rooster will not crow: the day had begun at sunset, so before morning
decisions.reason: The Jewish day began in the evening. Before the roosters crowed near dawn, while it was still "today", Peter would deny Jesus.

decisions.choice: deny knowing me: say he does not know Jesus
alternatives: deny that Jesus is the Christ
decisions.reason: In 22:57-60 Peter says that he does not know him, not that he does not believe him.

decisions.choice: Peter: Jesus uses the name he gave Simon
decisions.reason: Only here in Luke does Jesus call him Peter, the name he gave him (6:14), meaning rock.

decisions.choice: negar (L); decir que no me conoces (B, R)
decisions.reason: To disown Jesus by saying he does not know him (meaning decision m2). "Negar" is the word for Peter's denial through the Gospels; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: le coq ne chantera pas … avant que tu aies nié (L)
alternatives: le coq ne chantera pas … jusqu’à ce que tu aies nié
decisions.reason: French "ne … pas jusqu’à ce que" is awkward and can be misread; "ne … pas avant que" keeps the negative and the order of the Greek and says the same thing. "Le coq" rather than "un coq", as French speaks of the cock's crow at dawn.

decisions.choice: kukana (L); kusema kwamba hunijui (B, R)
decisions.reason: To disown Jesus by saying he does not know him (meaning decision m2). "Kukana" is the word for Peter's denial through the Gospels; "kukataa" is to refuse. Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "chối ... rằng con biết Ta" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek "deny knowing me"; Vietnamese "chối" (deny) can take what is denied, so the "không" of Balanced and Readable is not needed there.

decisions.choice: "부인하다" (L, B); "모른다고 말하다" (R) for aparneomai, also 22:57 and 22:61
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:30 and John 13:38; Readable says what Peter will do, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ὅτε ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς ἄτερ βαλλαντίου καὶ πήρας καὶ ὑποδημάτων, μή τινος ὑστερήσατε;

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, When I sent you without money bag and bag and sandals, not anything did you lack?

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "When I sent you out without money bag and bag and sandals, did you lack anything?"
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "When I sent you out with no money bag, no traveler's bag and no sandals, were you short of anything?"
en.R: Then Jesus asked them, "Remember when I sent you out without any money, travel bag or sandals? Did you need anything you did not have?"

es.L: Y les dijo: «Cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} envié sin bolsa de dinero, ni alforja, ni sandalias, ¿{{plural_you:les|os}} faltó algo?».
es.B: Luego les dijo: «Cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} envié sin bolsa de dinero, sin alforja y sin sandalias, ¿{{plural_you:les|os}} hizo falta alguna cosa?».
es.R: Luego Jesús les preguntó: «¿{{plural_you:Recuerdan|Recordáis}} cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} envié sin dinero, sin bolsa de viaje y sin sandalias? ¿{{plural_you:Necesitaron|Necesitasteis}} algo que no {{plural_you:tuvieran|tuvierais}}?».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Quand je vous ai envoyés sans bourse, ni sac, ni sandales, avez-vous manqué de quelque chose ? »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Quand je vous ai envoyés sans bourse, sans sac de voyage et sans sandales, avez-vous manqué de quoi que ce soit ? »
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus leur a demandé : « Vous vous souvenez ? Je vous ai envoyés sans argent, sans sac de voyage et sans sandales. Est-ce qu’il vous a manqué quelque chose ? »

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Nilipowatuma bila mfuko wa fedha na mkoba na viatu, mlipungukiwa na kitu chochote?"
sw.B: Kisha akawaambia, "Nilipowatuma bila mfuko wa fedha, bila mkoba wa safari, wala viatu, je, mlikosa kitu chochote?"
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akawauliza, "Mnakumbuka nilipowatuma bila pesa, bila mkoba wa safari, wala viatu? Je, mlihitaji kitu ambacho hamkuwa nacho?"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai các con đi không có túi tiền, bao bị và dép, các con có thiếu gì không?"
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hỏi họ: "Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai các con đi mà không có túi tiền, túi hành lý hay dép, các con có thiếu thốn gì không?"
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu hỏi họ: "Các con có nhớ khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai các con đi mà không mang theo tiền, túi xách hay dép không? Lúc ấy các con có thiếu gì không?"

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 너희를 돈주머니와 자루와 신발 없이 보냈을 때에, 너희에게 무엇이 부족하였느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 너희를 돈주머니도, 여행 자루도, 신발도 없이 보냈을 때에, 너희에게 모자란 것이 있었느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 제자들에게 물으셨다. "내가 너희를 보낼 때에 돈도, 가방도, 신발도 가지고 가지 말라고 했던 것을 기억하느냐? 그때 너희에게 없어서 아쉬운 것이 있었느냐?"

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Quando eu os enviei sem bolsa, e sacola, e sandálias, faltou-lhes alguma coisa?"
pt.B: Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Quando eu os enviei sem bolsa de dinheiro, sem sacola de viagem e sem sandálias, faltou alguma coisa a vocês?"
pt.R: Depois Jesus perguntou a eles: "Vocês se lembram de quando eu os enviei sem dinheiro, sem sacola de viagem e sem sandálias? Vocês precisaram de alguma coisa que não tinham?"

decisions.choice: when I sent you: the earlier missions in Galilee
decisions.reason: Jesus sent the Twelve out with nothing for the road (9:3), and gave the seventy-two the same words, no money bag, no bag, no sandals (10:4).

decisions.choice: did you lack anything?: a question that expects the answer no
decisions.reason: The negative used here expects a no, and the apostles give it.

decisions.choice: bag: a traveler's bag for food and belongings
decisions.reason: The word means a leather bag carried on a journey.

decisions.choice: une bourse; un sac (L), un sac de voyage (B, R); de l’argent (R)
decisions.reason: "Bourse" is the plain French word for a purse of coins in older times; "besace" is the beggar's or traveller's bag but now sounds quaint. Readable says "argent", as the English Readable says "money"; the same words serve in 22:36.

decisions.choice: "túi tiền"; "bao bị" (L), "túi hành lý" (B), "túi xách" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Luke 9:3 and 10:4, the missions Jesus recalls (meaning decision).

source.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Οὐθενός.

records.literal_gloss: They and said, Nothing.

en.L: And they said, "Nothing."
en.B: They said, "Not a thing."
en.R: "Nothing," they answered.

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «Nada».
es.B: Ellos respondieron: «Nada en absoluto».
es.R: «Nada», respondieron.

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Rien. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent : « Nous n’avons manqué de rien. »
fr.R: « Non, il ne nous a rien manqué », ont-ils répondu.

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Hakuna kitu."
sw.B: Wakajibu, "Hatukukosa kitu chochote."
sw.R: "Hakuna," wakajibu.

vi.L: Và họ nói: "Không [thiếu] gì cả."
vi.B: Họ thưa: "Không thiếu thứ gì cả."
vi.R: Họ trả lời: "Không thiếu gì cả."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "아무것도 [부족하지 않았습니다]."
ko.B: 그들이 대답했다. "하나도 없었습니다."
ko.R: 그들이 대답했다. "아무것도 없었습니다."

pt.L: E eles disseram: "Nada."
pt.B: Eles disseram: "Nada mesmo."
pt.R: "Nada", eles responderam.

decisions.choice: nothing: God provided all they needed
decisions.reason: Their answer shows that the people they visited gave them what they needed.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς· Ἀλλὰ νῦν ὁ ἔχων βαλλάντιον ἀράτω, ὁμοίως καὶ πήραν, καὶ ὁ μὴ ἔχων πωλησάτω τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀγορασάτω μάχαιραν.

records.literal_gloss: He said then to them, But now the [one] having a money bag let him take [it], likewise also a bag, and the [one] not having let him sell the cloak of him and let him buy a sword.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "But now, let the one who has a money bag take [it], and likewise a bag; and let the one who does not have [one] sell {{gender:their|his}} cloak and buy a sword.
en.B: He said to them, "But now, whoever has a money bag must take it along, and a traveler's bag too. And whoever has no sword should sell {{gender:their|his}} cloak and buy one.
en.R: Jesus told them, "But now things are different. If you have money, take it with you. Take your travel bag too. And if you do not have a sword, sell your coat and buy one.

es.L: Y les dijo: «Pero ahora, el que tenga bolsa de dinero, que [la] tome, y lo mismo la alforja; y el que no tenga, que venda su manto y compre una espada.
es.B: Les dijo: «Pero ahora, el que tenga bolsa de dinero, que la lleve consigo, y también la alforja. Y el que no tenga espada, que venda su manto y se compre una.
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Pero ahora las cosas son distintas. Si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} dinero, {{plural_you:llévenlo|llevadlo}}. {{plural_you:Lleven|Llevad}} también {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} bolsa de viaje. Y si no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} espada, {{plural_you:vendan|vended}} {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} capa y {{plural_you:compren|comprad}} una.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Mais maintenant, que celui qui a une bourse la prenne, de même aussi un sac ; et que celui qui n’[en] a pas vende son manteau et achète une épée.
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Mais maintenant, que celui qui a une bourse la prenne avec lui, et de même un sac de voyage. Et que celui qui n’a pas d’épée vende son manteau pour en acheter une.
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Mais maintenant, ce n’est plus pareil. Si vous avez de l’argent, prenez-le avec vous. Prenez aussi votre sac de voyage. Et celui qui n’a pas d’épée doit vendre son manteau et en acheter une.

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Lakini sasa, aliye na mfuko wa fedha na auchukue, vivyo hivyo na mkoba; na asiye nao, auze vazi lake na anunue upanga.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Lakini sasa, aliye na mfuko wa fedha na auchukue, pamoja na mkoba wake wa safari. Na asiye na upanga auze vazi lake la nje, ajinunulie upanga.
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Lakini sasa mambo yamebadilika. Kama mna pesa, zichukueni. Chukueni pia mikoba yenu ya safari. Na kama hamna upanga, uzeni makoti yenu mnunue upanga.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Nhưng bây giờ, ai có túi tiền hãy mang theo, bao bị cũng vậy; và ai không có [gươm] hãy bán áo choàng mình mà mua một thanh gươm.
vi.B: Ngài nói với họ: "Nhưng bây giờ, ai có túi tiền hãy mang theo, túi hành lý cũng vậy. Còn ai không có gươm thì hãy bán áo choàng mình mà mua một thanh.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Nhưng bây giờ mọi sự đã khác. Ai có tiền thì hãy mang theo. Hãy mang theo cả túi xách nữa. Ai không có gươm thì hãy bán áo khoác của mình để mua một thanh gươm.

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그러나 이제는 돈주머니가 있는 사람은 그것을 가지고 가고, 자루도 그렇게 하여라. 그리고 없는 사람은 자기 겉옷을 팔아 칼을 사라.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그러나 이제는 돈주머니가 있는 사람은 그것을 챙기고, 여행 자루도 챙겨라. 그리고 칼이 없는 사람은 자기 겉옷을 팔아서 칼을 사라.
ko.R: 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "그러나 이제는 사정이 달라졌다. 돈이 있으면 가지고 가거라. 가방도 가지고 가거라. 그리고 칼이 없으면 겉옷을 팔아서 칼을 사라.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Mas agora, quem tem bolsa, que a leve, e do mesmo modo também a sacola; e quem não tem, que venda o seu manto e compre uma espada.
pt.B: Ele lhes disse: "Mas agora, quem tiver uma bolsa de dinheiro deve levá-la, e a sacola de viagem também. E quem não tiver espada venda o seu manto e compre uma.
