pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Mas agora as coisas são diferentes. Se vocês têm dinheiro, levem com vocês. Levem também a sacola de viagem. E, se vocês não têm espada, vendam a capa e comprem uma.

decisions.choice: the one who does not have: probably does not have a sword
alternatives: does not have a money bag
decisions.reason: The object is not stated. It may be the money bag (then he must raise money by selling his cloak), or the sword named at the end. Either way the cloak is sold to buy a sword.

decisions.choice: but now: a new time of danger and opposition
alternatives: the old instructions were a mistake
decisions.reason: Before, the disciples were welcomed; now their master is to be counted with criminals (22:37) and they will face hostility.

decisions.choice: sword: a short sword or long knife
decisions.reason: The word means a short sword or dagger. Whether Jesus meant real swords or spoke in a picture of the hostility ahead is debated; his reply in 22:38 and his rebuke in 22:51 suggest he did not mean them to fight.

decisions.choice: cloak: the outer garment, also used as a blanket at night
decisions.reason: Selling the cloak was a serious matter, since a poor man needed it (Exodus 22:26-27). The saying stresses how serious the danger is.

decisions.choice: whoever has no sword
alternatives: the one who does not have
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies the likely object (m1).

decisions.choice: now things are different
decisions.reason: Readable explains the contrast with 22:35 (m2).

decisions.choice: su manto, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "their" against "his" under the gender setting. Spanish "su" already serves for anyone, so there is nothing to switch.

decisions.choice: "celui qui … son manteau" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs "{{gender:their|his}} cloak"; French "son" is the same for a man or a woman, and "celui qui" already means anyone (style guide §7), so no setting is needed. Readable keeps "celui qui" for the sword, where the English turns to "you", so that the plain sense stays general.

decisions.choice: vazi lake, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English sets "their" against "his" under the gender setting. Swahili "lake" already serves for anyone, so there is nothing to switch.

decisions.choice: "áo choàng mình" (L, B), "áo khoác của mình" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The reflexive "mình" already covers men and women, so the English gender span (their/his) has no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: "[gươm]" (L)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the one who has none as one who has no sword; Vietnamese needs the object, so Literal supplies it in brackets.

decisions.choice: "자기 겉옷" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender setting on the pronoun, as in English
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" serves for men and women alike, so the English gender span has nothing to change in Korean, as at Luke 13.

decisions.choice: o seu manto, with no gender setting
alternatives: {{gender:o manto dele ou dela|o seu manto}}
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "their" and "his". Portuguese "seu" does not mark the owner's sex, so "quem não tem ... venda o seu manto" already speaks of anyone, and no setting is needed. Readable speaks to "vocês", as the English Readable says "you".

source.text: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦτο τὸ γεγραμμένον δεῖ τελεσθῆναι ἐν ἐμοί, τό· Καὶ μετὰ ἀνόμων ἐλογίσθη· καὶ γὰρ τὸ περὶ ἐμοῦ τέλος ἔχει.

records.literal_gloss: I say for to you that this the having been written it is necessary to be fulfilled in me, the, And with lawless [ones] he was counted; and for the [things] concerning me an end has.

en.L: For I tell you that this which has been written must be fulfilled in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: 'And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was counted with the lawless.' For indeed what concerns {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has an end."
en.B: For I tell you, what is written must be fulfilled in {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: 'He was counted among the lawless.' Yes, what was written about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} is reaching its end."
en.R: I tell you, the Scriptures say, 'He was treated as a criminal.' This must come true about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Everything written about {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} is now coming true."

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que esto que está escrito tiene que cumplirse en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}: “Y fue contado con los sin ley”. Porque también lo [que se refiere] a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} tiene fin».
es.B: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que tiene que cumplirse en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} lo que la Escritura dice: “Fue contado entre los malhechores”. Sí, lo que está escrito acerca de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} está llegando a su fin».
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo que la Escritura dice: “Lo trataron como a un criminal”. Esto tiene que cumplirse en {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Todo lo que está escrito sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} se está cumpliendo ahora».

fr.L: Car je vous dis que ce qui est écrit doit s’accomplir en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} : “Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été compté avec les sans-loi.” Car ce qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} concerne touche aussi à sa fin. »
fr.B: Car, je vous le dis, ce qui est écrit doit s’accomplir en {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} : “Il a été mis au nombre des hors-la-loi.” Oui, ce qui a été écrit à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} sujet arrive à son terme. »
fr.R: Je vous le dis, les Écritures disent : “On {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a traité comme un criminel.” Cela doit se réaliser pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Tout ce qui est écrit sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} est en train de se réaliser. »

sw.L: Kwa maana nawaambia kwamba hili lililoandikwa lazima litimizwe ndani {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}: 'Naye alihesabiwa pamoja na wasiofuata sheria.' Kwa maana mambo yanayonihusu yanafikia mwisho."
sw.B: Kwa maana nawaambia, lazima yatimizwe {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} yale Maandiko yanayosema: 'Alihesabiwa pamoja na wahalifu.' Naam, yaliyoandikwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} yanafikia mwisho wake."
sw.R: Nawaambia, Maandiko yanasema, 'Alitendewa kama mhalifu.' Jambo hili lazima litimie {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. Kila kitu kilichoandikwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} sasa kinatimia."

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng lời đã chép này phải được ứng nghiệm nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị kể vào hàng những kẻ phạm pháp.' Vì thật, những điều về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang đến lúc kết thúc."
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, lời Kinh Thánh này phải được ứng nghiệm nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Ngài đã bị kể vào hàng những kẻ phạm pháp.' Đúng vậy, những gì đã chép về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang đi đến chỗ hoàn tất."
vi.R: Ta nói với các con, Kinh Thánh có chép: 'Ngài bị đối xử như một kẻ tội phạm.' Lời ấy phải trở thành sự thật nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Mọi điều đã chép về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nay đang trở thành sự thật."

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 말한다. '그리고 그는 불법자들과 함께 여겨졌다' 하고 기록된 이 말씀이 내게서 이루어져야 한다. 참으로 나에 관한 것은 끝에 이르고 있다."
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 말한다. '그는 불법자들과 한 무리로 여겨졌다' 하고 기록된 말씀이 내게서 이루어져야 한다. 참으로 나에 대하여 기록된 일이 이제 이루어지고 있다."
ko.R: 내가 말한다. 성경에 '그는 범죄자들과 같은 취급을 받았다' 하고 기록되어 있다. 이 말씀이 나에게 꼭 이루어져야 한다. 나에 대하여 기록된 모든 일이 이제 이루어지고 있다."

pt.L: Pois eu lhes digo que isto que está escrito deve se cumprir em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}: 'E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi contado com os transgressores.' Pois também o que [diz respeito] a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} tem um fim."
pt.B: Pois eu lhes digo: o que está escrito precisa se cumprir em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}: 'Ele foi contado entre os transgressores.' Sim, o que foi escrito a {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} respeito está chegando ao seu cumprimento."
pt.R: Eu digo a vocês: as Escrituras dizem: 'Ele foi tratado como um criminoso.' Isso precisa se cumprir em {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Tudo o que foi escrito sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} está se tornando realidade agora."

decisions.choice: he was counted with the lawless: Isaiah 53:12
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes Isaiah's servant of the Lord, who pours out his life to death, is counted with wrongdoers and bears the sin of many. Luke shows it fulfilled when Jesus is crucified between two criminals (23:32-33).

decisions.choice: has an end: is reaching its goal, is being fulfilled
alternatives: is about to be over and done with
decisions.reason: The word means end or goal. What is written about Jesus is coming to its fulfillment.

decisions.choice: must: God's plan, written in Scripture
alternatives: only what his enemies have decided
decisions.reason: Luke often uses "must" for what God has planned and Scripture foretells (24:26, 44).

decisions.choice: treated as a criminal
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase from Isaiah.

decisions.choice: what was written about me (B); everything written about me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say that the things are those written in Scripture, which the first half of the verse speaks of.

decisions.choice: les sans-loi (L); les hors-la-loi (B); un criminel (R)
decisions.reason: The word means people without law. "Sans-loi" keeps that at Literal; "hors-la-loi" is the everyday French for outlaws and keeps the word "loi"; "malfaiteurs" is the familiar wording of the quotation from Isaiah 53:12 but loses the link with the law. Readable follows the English "criminal".

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for the "he" of Isaiah 53:12, with a span mid-sentence
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the prophecy as being about himself, so the servant of the prophecy is spoken of with the reverent "Ngài", as the English gives it the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "불법자들과 함께 여겨졌다" (L), "불법자들과 한 무리로 여겨졌다" (B), "범죄자들과 같은 취급을 받았다" (R)
decisions.reason: Isaiah 53:12 (meaning decision): Literal and Balanced keep "the lawless", and Readable says plainly that he was treated as a criminal, as the English does. The quoted servant is "그", with no honorific, since Jesus speaks of himself.

decisions.choice: os transgressores
decisions.reason: The Greek word means people without law, lawbreakers (m1). "Transgressores" says exactly that in written Portuguese; "sem-lei" is not a Portuguese noun, and "malfeitores" or "criminosos" (Readable) say what they did rather than that they broke the law.

decisions.choice: está chegando ao seu cumprimento
decisions.reason: "Chegar ao fim" would suggest that what was written is ending or being cancelled; the word means reaching its goal (m2), which "cumprimento" says.

source.text: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Κύριε, ἰδοὺ μάχαιραι ὧδε δύο.

records.literal_gloss: They and said, Lord, look, swords here two.

en.L: And they said, "Lord, look, here [are] two swords."
en.B: They said, "Lord, look, here are two swords."
en.R: The apostles said, "Lord, look! We have two swords here."

es.L: Y ellos dijeron: «Señor, mira, aquí [hay] dos espadas».
es.B: Ellos dijeron: «Señor, mira, aquí hay dos espadas».
es.R: Los apóstoles dijeron: «¡Señor, mira! Tenemos aquí dos espadas».

fr.L: Et ils dirent : « Seigneur, voici, deux épées ici. »
fr.B: Ils dirent : « Seigneur, regarde, il y a ici deux épées. »
fr.R: Les apôtres ont dit : « Seigneur, regarde ! Nous avons deux épées ici. »

sw.L: Nao wakasema, "Bwana, tazama, hapa [kuna] panga mbili."
sw.B: Wakasema, "Bwana, tazama, hapa kuna panga mbili."
sw.R: Mitume wakasema, "Bwana, tazama! Tuna panga mbili hapa."

vi.L: Và họ nói: "Lạy Chúa, kìa, đây có hai thanh gươm."
vi.B: Họ thưa: "Lạy Chúa, đây có hai thanh gươm."
vi.R: Các sứ đồ thưa: "Lạy Chúa, xem này! Ở đây chúng con có hai thanh gươm."

ko.L: 그러자 그들이 말했다. "주님, 보십시오, 여기 칼 두 자루가 있습니다."
ko.B: 그들이 말했다. "주님, 보십시오. 여기 칼이 두 자루 있습니다."
ko.R: 사도들이 말했다. "주님, 보십시오! 저희에게 칼이 두 자루 있습니다."

pt.L: E eles disseram: "Senhor, olha, aqui [há] duas espadas."
pt.B: Eles disseram: "Senhor, olha: aqui estão duas espadas."
pt.R: Os apóstolos disseram: "Senhor, olha! Temos duas espadas aqui."

decisions.choice: here are two swords: the apostles take Jesus' words literally
decisions.reason: They answer as though Jesus meant them to arm themselves now. His reply suggests they had missed his point (22:38b, 22:51).

decisions.choice: look (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the disciples point to the swords, so "look" is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: voici (L); regarde (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English keeps "look" here at every level, Balanced and Readable say "regarde", the word the disciples would use as they point to the swords; Literal keeps "voici", as elsewhere in Luke.

decisions.choice: "보십시오" for idou at every level
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Literal says "보라" for idou, but the disciples speak to Jesus in 합쇼체, so the call to look takes the polite form, as at Luke 15:29.

source.text: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἱκανόν ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: He and said to them, Enough it is.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "It is enough."
en.B: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "That is enough."
en.R: Jesus answered, "That is enough!"

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «Es suficiente».
es.B: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dijo: «¡Basta!».
es.R: Jesús respondió: «¡Basta ya!».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « C’est assez. »
fr.B: Il leur dit : « Cela suffit. »
fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Ça suffit ! »

sw.L: Naye akawaambia, "Inatosha."
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Basi, inatosha."
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Inatosha!"

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Thế là đủ."
vi.B: Ngài bảo họ: "Đủ rồi."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Đủ rồi!"

ko.L: 그러자 그분이 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그것으로 족하다."
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그만하면 되었다."
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "그만하면 됐다!"

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "É suficiente."
pt.B: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Basta."
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "Já basta!"

decisions.choice: it is enough: probably "enough of this talk", ending the conversation
alternatives: two swords are enough for what is needed
decisions.reason: If Jesus meant two swords were enough, he could not have meant armed resistance, since two swords could not defend a group. More likely he ends a conversation they have misunderstood, as in Deuteronomy 3:26 where God tells Moses, "Enough!"

decisions.choice: "Thế là đủ" (L); "Đủ rồi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Đủ rồi" can mean both "that is enough" and "enough of this", the two readings the footnoted meaning decision weighs, so Vietnamese does not have to choose.

decisions.choice: "그것으로 족하다" (L); "그만하면 되었다" (B); "그만하면 됐다" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the words as probably ending the talk, with "two swords are enough" in the footnote; the Korean phrases can mean both, as the English "That is enough" does.

decisions.choice: É suficiente (L); Basta (B); Já basta (R)
decisions.reason: The words most likely end a conversation the apostles have misunderstood (m1), but could be read as "two swords are enough". "Basta" keeps both readings, as the English "That is enough" does; "Chega!" would decide for the first, and "duas espadas bastam" for the second.

source.text: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὸ ἔθος εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν· ἠκολούθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ μαθηταί.

records.literal_gloss: And having gone out he went according to the custom to the Mount of the Olives; followed then him also the disciples.

en.L: And going out, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went according to [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] custom to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples also followed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} left and went, as was {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} habit, to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples went with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Then Jesus left the city and went to the Mount of Olives, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} usually did. His disciples went with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y saliendo, se fue, según [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] costumbre, al monte de los Olivos; y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} siguieron también los discípulos.
es.B: Luego salió y fue, como era {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} costumbre, al monte de los Olivos, y los discípulos se fueron con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Luego Jesús salió de la ciudad y fue al monte de los Olivos, como solía hacer. Sus discípulos se fueron con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: Et étant sorti, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se rendit, selon [{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}}] coutume, au mont des Oliviers ; et les disciples aussi {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suivirent.
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sortit et se rendit, comme d’habitude, au mont des Oliviers, et les disciples {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}accompagnèrent.
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus est sorti de la ville. Il est allé au mont des Oliviers, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le faisait souvent. Ses disciples sont partis avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Naye akitoka, alienda kama ilivyokuwa desturi [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}] mpaka Mlima wa Mizeituni; nao wanafunzi pia wakamfuata.
sw.B: Kisha akatoka, akaenda kama ilivyokuwa desturi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, mpaka Mlima wa Mizeituni, na wanafunzi wakaenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akatoka mjini, akaenda Mlima wa Mizeituni, kama alivyozoea kufanya. Wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wakaenda pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.

vi.L: Và đi ra, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến núi Ô-li-ve theo thói quen, và các môn đồ cũng đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra đi, đến núi Ô-li-ve như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn thường làm, và các môn đồ cũng đi theo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Sau đó Đức Giê-xu rời thành và đi đến núi Ô-li-ve, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn thường làm. Các môn đồ cũng đi với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 나가셔서 [그분의] 습관대로 올리브 산으로 가셨다. 그리고 제자들도 그분을 따라갔다.
ko.B: 예수께서 성 밖으로 나가셔서, 늘 하시던 대로 올리브 산으로 가셨다. 제자들도 예수를 따라갔다.
ko.R: 예수께서 성을 떠나 올리브 산으로 가셨다. 예수께서는 늘 그곳에 가셨다. 제자들도 예수와 함께 갔다.

pt.L: E, saindo, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi, segundo [o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}}] costume, para o monte das Oliveiras; e os discípulos também {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} seguiram.
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} saiu e foi, como era o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} costume, para o monte das Oliveiras, e os discípulos foram com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Depois Jesus saiu da cidade e foi para o monte das Oliveiras, como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} costumava fazer. Os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos foram com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

decisions.choice: according to his custom: he spent his nights there during that week
decisions.reason: Luke has said that Jesus taught in the temple by day and spent the nights on the Mount of Olives (21:37). Judas therefore knew where to find him.

decisions.choice: the Mount of Olives: the ridge east of Jerusalem, across the Kidron valley
decisions.reason: The hill was named for its olive groves (19:29, 37). Luke does not name the garden or Gethsemane; he calls it "the place" (22:40).

decisions.choice: "올리브 산" at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:26 and John 8:1; "감람산" is the familiar older form.

source.text: γενόμενος δὲ ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Προσεύχεσθε μὴ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς πειρασμόν.

records.literal_gloss: Having come then to the place he said to them, Pray not to enter into temptation.

en.L: And when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} came to the place, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Pray not to enter into temptation."
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} arrived at the place, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Pray that you do not come into temptation."
en.R: When they reached the place, Jesus said to them, "Pray that you will not give in when you are tested."

es.L: Y llegado al lugar, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} [para] no entrar en tentación».
es.B: Al llegar al lugar, les dijo: «{{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que no {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a caer en la tentación».
es.R: Cuando llegaron al lugar, Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Oren|Orad}} para que no {{plural_you:se rindan|os rindáis}} cuando {{plural_you:sean probados|seáis probados}}».

fr.L: Et arrivé à l’endroit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Priez de ne pas entrer en tentation. »
fr.B: Arrivé à cet endroit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Priez pour ne pas entrer en tentation. »
fr.R: Quand ils sont arrivés à cet endroit, Jésus leur a dit : « Priez pour ne pas céder quand vous serez mis à l’épreuve. »

sw.L: Na alipofika mahali pale, aliwaambia, "Ombeni msiingie katika majaribu."
sw.B: Alipofika mahali hapo, akawaambia, "Ombeni ili msiingie majaribuni."
sw.R: Walipofika mahali hapo, Yesu aliwaambia, "Ombeni kwamba msishindwe mtakapojaribiwa."

vi.L: Và khi đến nơi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Hãy cầu nguyện để không sa vào cám dỗ."
vi.B: Khi đến nơi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bảo họ: "Hãy cầu nguyện để các con không rơi vào cám dỗ."
vi.R: Đến nơi, Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Hãy cầu nguyện để các con không chịu thua khi bị cám dỗ."

ko.L: 그리고 그곳에 이르시자 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "시험에 들어가지 않도록 기도하여라."
ko.B: 그곳에 이르셔서 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "시험에 빠지지 않도록 기도하여라."
ko.R: 그곳에 이르자 예수께서 제자들에게 말씀하셨다. "시험이 닥쳐올 때 넘어가지 않도록 기도하여라."

pt.L: E, chegando ao lugar, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Orem para não entrarem em tentação."
pt.B: Quando chegou ao lugar, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Orem para que vocês não entrem em tentação."
pt.R: Quando chegaram ao lugar, Jesus disse a eles: "Orem para que vocês não cedam quando forem postos à prova."

decisions.choice: temptation: a time of testing that could make them fall away
alternatives: the final great trial at the end of the age
decisions.reason: The word means testing or temptation. Jesus has taught them to pray not to be led into temptation (11:4). Satan wants to sift them (22:31); tonight they will be tested.

decisions.choice: enter into temptation: be drawn into the testing and overcome by it
decisions.reason: To enter into temptation means to give way under it, not only to face it.

decisions.choice: give in when you are tested
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m2).

decisions.choice: majaribu
decisions.reason: A time of testing that could make them fall away (meaning decision m1). "Majaribu" covers both the testing and the pull to give in, as in Mark 14:38; "kishawishi" is only an enticement to sin. The same in 22:46.

decisions.choice: "sa vào cám dỗ" (L); "rơi vào cám dỗ" (B); "chịu thua khi bị cám dỗ" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the Vietnamese Mark 14:38 and Matthew 26:41, the parallel command: the meaning decision describes a test that could make them fall away, which "cám dỗ" names.

decisions.choice: "시험에 들어가다" (L); "시험에 빠지다" (B); "시험이 닥쳐올 때 넘어가다" (R), also 22:46
decisions.reason: "시험" covers both testing and temptation (meaning decision), as in the Korean Mark 14:38 and Luke 11:4; Literal keeps the Greek "enter into", and Readable says what giving in means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπεσπάσθη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύχετο λέγων· Πάτερ, εἰ βούλει παρένεγκε τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ· πλὴν μὴ τὸ θέλημά μου ἀλλὰ τὸ σὸν γινέσθω.

records.literal_gloss: And he withdrew from them about a stone's throw, and having placed the knees he was praying \v 42 saying, Father, if you are willing take away this the cup from me; yet not the will of me but the yours let be done.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} withdrew from them about a stone's throw, and kneeling down {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was praying, \v 42 saying, "Father, if {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are willing, take this cup away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; yet not {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} will, but {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}} be done."
en.B: Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went off from them about a stone's throw, knelt down, and began to pray, \v 42 "Father, if {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are willing, remove this cup from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Yet let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will be done, not {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}."
en.R: Then Jesus went a short distance away from them, about as far as a person could throw a stone. He knelt down and prayed. \v 42 He said, "Father, if {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are willing, take away this cup of suffering from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. But do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want, not what I want."

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se apartó de ellos como a un tiro de piedra, y poniéndose de rodillas oraba, \v 42 diciendo: «Padre, si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, aparta de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} esta copa; pero no {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} voluntad, sino que la {{deity_pronoun:tuya|Tuya}} se cumpla».
es.B: Luego se alejó de ellos como a un tiro de piedra, se arrodilló y se puso a orar: \v 42 «Padre, si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, aleja de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} esta copa. Pero que se cumpla {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad, no la {{deity_pronoun:mía|Mía}}».
es.R: Luego Jesús se alejó un poco de ellos, más o menos hasta donde se puede tirar una piedra. Se arrodilló y oró. \v 42 Dijo: «Padre, si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, quita de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} esta copa de sufrimiento. Pero haz lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres, no lo que quiero yo».

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’éloigna d’eux d’environ un jet de pierre, et s’étant mis à genoux, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} priait, \v 42 en disant : « Père, si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le veux, éloigne de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} cette coupe ; cependant, que ce ne soit pas {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} volonté, mais la {{deity_pronoun:tienne|Tienne}} qui se fasse. »
fr.B: Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’éloigna d’eux à la distance d’un jet de pierre, se mit à genoux et pria : \v 42 « Père, si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le veux, écarte de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} cette coupe. Pourtant, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté se fasse, et non la {{deity_pronoun:mienne|Mienne}}. »
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus s’est éloigné un peu d’eux, à peu près à la distance où l’on peut lancer une pierre. Il s’est mis à genoux et il a prié. \v 42 Il a dit : « Père, si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le veux, enlève-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} cette coupe de souffrance. Mais fais ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux, et non ce que je veux. »

sw.L: Naye alijitenga nao kiasi cha kutupa jiwe, na akipiga magoti alikuwa akiomba, \v 42 akisema, "Baba, ukipenda, kiondoe kikombe hiki {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}; lakini yasifanyike mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, bali {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."
sw.B: Kisha akaenda mbali nao kiasi cha mtu kutupa jiwe, akapiga magoti, akaanza kuomba, \v 42 "Baba, ukipenda, kiondoe kikombe hiki {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. Lakini mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndiyo yafanyike, si {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."
sw.R: Kisha Yesu alikwenda mbali kidogo nao, umbali ambao mtu anaweza kutupa jiwe. Akapiga magoti, akaomba. \v 42 Akasema, "Baba, ukipenda, niondolee kikombe hiki cha mateso. Lakini fanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unachotaka, si kile ninachotaka {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."

vi.L: Và chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rời khỏi họ chừng một quăng đá, quỳ gối xuống và cầu nguyện, \v 42 rằng: "Cha ơi, nếu Cha muốn, xin cất chén này khỏi Con; nhưng không phải ý Con, mà ý Cha được thực hiện."
vi.B: Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi cách xa họ chừng một quăng đá, quỳ gối xuống và cầu nguyện: \v 42 "Cha ơi, nếu Cha muốn, xin cất chén này khỏi Con. Nhưng xin cho ý Cha được thực hiện, chứ không phải ý Con."
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu đi xa các môn đồ một quãng ngắn, khoảng bằng một người ném hòn đá. Ngài quỳ xuống và cầu nguyện. \v 42 Ngài nói: "Cha ơi, nếu Cha muốn, xin cất chén đau khổ này khỏi Con. Nhưng xin Cha làm theo ý Cha, chứ không theo ý Con."

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 돌을 던져 닿을 만한 거리쯤 그들에게서 떨어져 가셔서, 무릎을 꿇고 기도하고 계셨다. \v 42 그리고 말씀하셨다. "아버지, 아버지께서 원하시면 이 잔을 제게서 거두어 주십시오. 그러나 제 뜻이 아니라 아버지의 뜻이 이루어지게 하십시오."
ko.B: 예수께서는 그들에게서 돌을 던지면 닿을 만한 거리만큼 떨어져 가셔서, 무릎을 꿇고 기도하셨다. \v 42 "아버지, 아버지께서 원하시면 이 잔을 제게서 거두어 주십시오. 그러나 제 뜻대로 하지 마시고, 아버지의 뜻대로 되게 해 주십시오."
ko.R: 예수께서는 제자들에게서 조금 떨어진 곳으로 가셨다. 돌을 던지면 닿을 만한 거리였다. 예수께서는 무릎을 꿇고 기도하셨다. \v 42 "아버지, 아버지께서 원하시면 이 고난의 잔을 제게서 거두어 주십시오. 그러나 제가 원하는 대로 하지 마시고, 아버지께서 원하시는 대로 해 주십시오."

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou deles cerca de um tiro de pedra e, pondo-se de joelhos, orava, \v 42 dizendo: "Pai, se queres, afasta de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} este cálice; contudo, não se faça a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} vontade, mas a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}}."
pt.B: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se afastou deles mais ou menos à distância de um arremesso de pedra, ajoelhou-se e começou a orar: \v 42 "Pai, se queres, tira de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} este cálice. Mas que seja feita a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vontade, e não a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}}."
pt.R: Depois Jesus se afastou deles uma pequena distância, mais ou menos até onde uma pessoa consegue atirar uma pedra. Ele se ajoelhou e orou. \v 42 Ele disse: "Pai, se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} quiseres, tira de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} este cálice de sofrimento. Mas que seja feito o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres, e não o que eu quero."

decisions.choice: this cup: the suffering and death God has given him to bear
decisions.reason: In the prophets a cup stands for what God gives people to endure, often his anger against sin (Isaiah 51:17; Jeremiah 25:15). Jesus shrinks from it, yet accepts it.

decisions.choice: not my will, but yours be done: Jesus submits his own will to the Father's
alternatives: Jesus had no will of his own
decisions.reason: Jesus does not hide his wish to be spared, but he puts the Father's will first, as he taught in the prayer "your will be done" (Matthew 6:10).

decisions.choice: kneeling: a sign of earnest prayer
decisions.reason: Jews usually stood to pray (18:11, 13). Kneeling shows how urgent this prayer is (Acts 7:60; 20:36).

decisions.choice: was praying: he went on praying
decisions.reason: The imperfect tense shows prayer that continued.

decisions.choice: cup of suffering
decisions.reason: Readable says what the cup stands for (m1).

decisions.choice: about as far as a person could throw a stone
decisions.reason: Readable explains the measure.

decisions.choice: spans on the Father's "tu" and "la tienne", and on Jesus' "moi", "ma", "la mienne"
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks to the Father and of himself, so both sets of pronouns carry the deity_pronoun span, as the English "You", "Yours", "My", "Mine" do. The possessive pronouns take the forms "tienne/Tienne" and "mienne/Mienne", which agree with "volonté".

decisions.choice: "Cha" for "you" and "Con" for "I/me", with no setting spans
decisions.reason: Jesus prays to the Father as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:36 and Matthew 26:39; these are nouns of address, always capitalised, so the English deity_pronoun spans have no counterpart.

decisions.choice: Jesus prays in 합쇼체 with "저/제" and calls the Father "아버지" for "you"; "잔" (L, B), "고난의 잔" (R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide settles for Jesus speaking to the Father and as in the Korean Mark 14:36; Readable names what the cup stands for (meaning decision), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: se queres
decisions.reason: Jesus prays to the Father with "tu" (style §4). Portuguese shows the person in the verb, so "se queres" needs no pronoun and has no deity_pronoun span where the English "You" has one; the Father's "tua" vontade carries the span. Readable writes "se tu quiseres", the pronoun making the plain prayer clearer.

source.text: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἐνισχύων αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Appeared then to him an angel from heaven strengthening him.

en.L: And an angel from heaven appeared to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, strengthening {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Then an angel from heaven appeared to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} strength.
en.R: Then an angel from heaven came to Jesus and made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} strong.

es.L: Y se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} apareció un ángel del cielo, que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} fortalecía.
es.B: Entonces se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} apareció un ángel del cielo y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio fuerzas.
es.R: Entonces un ángel del cielo vino a Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llenó de fuerza.

fr.L: Et un ange du ciel {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} apparut, {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} fortifiant.
fr.B: Alors un ange venu du ciel {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} apparut et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} fortifia.
fr.R: Alors un ange du ciel est venu vers Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné de la force.

sw.L: Na malaika kutoka mbinguni akamtokea, akimtia nguvu.
sw.B: Kisha malaika kutoka mbinguni alimtokea, akamtia nguvu.
sw.R: Kisha malaika kutoka mbinguni akamjia Yesu, akampa nguvu.

vi.L: Và một thiên sứ từ trời hiện ra với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thêm sức cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Bấy giờ có một thiên sứ từ trời hiện ra với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và thêm sức cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Bấy giờ có một thiên sứ từ trời đến với Đức Giê-xu và làm cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: 그런데 하늘에서 천사가 그분께 나타나 그분께 힘을 북돋아 드렸다.
ko.B: 그때 하늘에서 천사가 예수께 나타나 힘을 북돋아 드렸다.
ko.R: 그때 하늘에서 천사가 예수께 와서 힘을 드렸다.

pt.L: E um anjo do céu {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} apareceu, fortalecendo-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}.
pt.B: Então um anjo do céu {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} apareceu e {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} deu forças.
pt.R: Então um anjo do céu veio até Jesus e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} fortaleceu.

decisions.choice: 22:43-44 are part of the text (SBLGNT, without brackets)
alternatives: the verses are left out by several early manuscripts
some manuscripts mark them as doubtful or place them in Matthew 26
decisions.reason: The two verses are missing from several important early witnesses, among them Papyrus 75, Codex Vaticanus, Codex Alexandrinus and a corrector of Codex Sinaiticus; other early witnesses, among them the first hand of Codex Sinaiticus, Codex Bezae and most later manuscripts, have them, and writers of the second century knew them. Some manuscripts mark them with signs of doubt, and some lectionary manuscripts read them after Matthew 26:39. Whether they were added, or left out by copyists who found them troubling, is much debated. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: strengthening: God answers his prayer by giving him strength, not by taking the cup away
alternatives: the angel freed him from suffering
decisions.reason: As angels served Jesus after his testing in the wilderness in other accounts (Mark 1:13), here God sends help to bear what he must face.

source.text: καὶ γενόμενος ἐν ἀγωνίᾳ ἐκτενέστερον προσηύχετο· καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἱδρὼς αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ θρόμβοι αἵματος καταβαίνοντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν.

records.literal_gloss: And having been in agony more earnestly he was praying; and became the sweat of him like great drops of blood falling down upon the ground.

en.L: And being in agony, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was praying more earnestly; and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sweat became like drops of blood falling down upon the ground.
en.B: In {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anguish {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} prayed all the more intensely, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sweat became like thick drops of blood dripping down onto the ground.
en.R: Jesus was in great distress, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} prayed even harder. His sweat was like large drops of blood falling to the ground.

es.L: Y hallándose en angustia, oraba con mayor intensidad; y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sudor llegó a ser como gotas espesas de sangre que bajaban sobre la tierra.
es.B: En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} angustia oraba con más fervor todavía, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sudor se volvió como gruesas gotas de sangre que goteaban hasta el suelo.
es.R: Jesús sufría mucho, y oraba con más fuerza todavía. Su sudor era como grandes gotas de sangre que caían al suelo.

fr.L: Et étant dans l’angoisse, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} priait plus intensément ; et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sueur devint comme des gouttes de sang tombant sur la terre.
fr.B: Dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} angoisse, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} priait avec plus d’ardeur encore, et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sueur devint comme de grosses gouttes de sang qui tombaient à terre.
fr.R: Jésus était dans une très grande détresse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prié encore plus fort. Sa sueur était comme de grosses gouttes de sang qui tombaient par terre.

sw.L: Naye akiwa katika dhiki kuu, alikuwa akiomba kwa bidii zaidi; na jasho {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} likawa kama matone ya damu yakishuka juu ya nchi.
sw.B: Akiwa katika uchungu mwingi, aliomba kwa bidii zaidi, na jasho {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} likawa kama matone mazito ya damu yakidondoka ardhini.
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa katika dhiki kubwa, akaomba kwa bidii zaidi. Jasho {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} lilikuwa kama matone makubwa ya damu yakianguka chini.

vi.L: Và đang trong cơn thống khổ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầu nguyện càng tha thiết hơn; và mồ hôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở nên như những giọt máu lớn rơi xuống đất.
vi.B: Trong cơn thống khổ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầu nguyện càng thiết tha hơn, và mồ hôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như những giọt máu đặc nhỏ xuống đất.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu vô cùng đau đớn trong lòng, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầu nguyện càng tha thiết hơn. Mồ hôi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như những giọt máu lớn rơi xuống đất.

ko.L: 그리고 그분은 고뇌에 빠지셔서 더욱 간절히 기도하셨다. 그러자 그분의 땀이 땅에 떨어지는 핏방울들처럼 되었다.
ko.B: 예수께서 고뇌에 싸여 더욱 간절히 기도하시니, 땀이 굵은 핏방울처럼 되어 땅에 떨어졌다.
ko.R: 예수께서는 몹시 괴로워하시며 더욱 힘써 기도하셨다. 땀이 큰 핏방울처럼 땅에 뚝뚝 떨어졌다.

pt.L: E, estando em agonia, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} orava mais intensamente; e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} suor se tornou como gotas de sangue caindo sobre a terra.
pt.B: Na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} angústia, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} orava com mais intensidade ainda, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} suor ficou como grossas gotas de sangue escorrendo até o chão.
pt.R: Jesus estava muito angustiado e orou com mais força ainda. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} suor era como grandes gotas de sangue caindo no chão.

decisions.choice: part of the text (SBLGNT), with 22:43
alternatives: left out by several early manuscripts
decisions.reason: See the note on 22:43. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: like drops of blood: his sweat fell like great drops of blood
alternatives: his sweat was mixed with real blood
decisions.reason: "Like" makes a comparison: the sweat fell in thick, heavy drops, as blood falls from a wound. The text does not say that it was blood, though some have read it so.

decisions.choice: agony: anguish, intense struggle
decisions.reason: The word means great distress of mind, such as an athlete or fighter feels before a contest.

decisions.choice: thick drops
decisions.reason: The word means a lump or clot; Balanced uses "thick" for drops that are heavy.

decisions.choice: l’angoisse (L, B); une très grande détresse (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word gives the English "agony", but French "agonie" now means the last moments before death, which is not the sense here (m3). "Angoisse" says the anguish of the struggle.

decisions.choice: "máu" for blood at every level
decisions.reason: "Huyết" is kept for the blood of the covenant (22:20); here the word only describes his sweat, so the everyday "máu" is used.

source.text: καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπὸ τῆς προσευχῆς ἐλθὼν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εὗρεν κοιμωμένους αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς λύπης, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τί καθεύδετε;

records.literal_gloss: And having risen up from the prayer, having come to the disciples he found sleeping them from the grief, \v 46 and he said to them, Why are you sleeping?

en.L: And rising up from prayer, coming to the disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} found them sleeping from grief, \v 46 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Why are you sleeping?
en.B: When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} got up from prayer and came back to the disciples, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} found them asleep, worn down by their grief. \v 46 And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to them, "Why are you sleeping?
en.R: Then Jesus got up from praying and went back to the disciples. He found them asleep, because they were so tired and sad. \v 46 He said to them, "Why are you sleeping?

es.L: Y levantándose de la oración, viniendo a los discípulos, los encontró durmiendo a causa de la tristeza, \v 46 y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:duermen|dormís}}?
es.B: Cuando se levantó de orar y volvió a los discípulos, los encontró dormidos, agotados por la tristeza. \v 46 Y les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:están|estáis}} durmiendo?
es.R: Luego Jesús se levantó de orar y volvió a donde estaban los discípulos. Los encontró dormidos, porque estaban muy cansados y tristes. \v 46 Les dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:están|estáis}} durmiendo?

fr.L: Et s’étant levé de la prière, étant venu vers les disciples, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les trouva endormis de tristesse, \v 46 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur dit : « Pourquoi dormez-vous ?
fr.B: Après avoir prié, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se leva et revint vers les disciples. Il les trouva endormis, épuisés par la tristesse. \v 46 Il leur dit : « Pourquoi dormez-vous ?
fr.R: Puis Jésus a fini de prier et s’est levé. Il est retourné vers les disciples. Ils dormaient, parce qu’ils étaient très fatigués et tristes. \v 46 Jésus leur a dit : « Pourquoi est-ce que vous dormez ?

sw.L: Naye akiinuka kutoka katika maombi, akija kwa wanafunzi, aliwakuta wamelala kwa sababu ya huzuni, \v 46 akawaambia, "Mbona mnalala?
sw.B: Alipoinuka kutoka katika maombi na kurudi kwa wanafunzi, aliwakuta wamelala, wamechoshwa na huzuni. \v 46 Akawaambia, "Mbona mmelala?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu aliinuka kutoka katika maombi, akarudi kwa wanafunzi. Akawakuta wamelala, kwa sababu walikuwa wamechoka sana na wenye huzuni. \v 46 Akawaambia, "Mbona mmelala?

vi.L: Và đứng dậy sau khi cầu nguyện, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với các môn đồ và thấy họ đang ngủ vì buồn rầu, \v 46 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với họ: "Sao các con ngủ?
vi.B: Cầu nguyện xong, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng dậy, trở lại với các môn đồ và thấy họ đang ngủ, vì buồn rầu quá đỗi mà kiệt sức. \v 46 Ngài nói với họ: "Sao các con ngủ?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu cầu nguyện xong và đứng dậy. Ngài trở lại với các môn đồ và thấy họ đang ngủ, vì họ quá mệt mỏi và buồn rầu. \v 46 Ngài nói với họ: "Sao các con lại ngủ?

ko.L: 그리고 기도를 마치고 일어나 제자들에게 오셔서, 그들이 슬픔 때문에 잠들어 있는 것을 보셨다. \v 46 그리고 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "어찌하여 자고 있느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 기도를 마치고 일어나 제자들에게 돌아와 보시니, 그들은 슬픔에 지쳐 잠들어 있었다. \v 46 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 자고 있느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 기도를 마치고 일어나 제자들에게 돌아가셨다. 그런데 제자들은 잠들어 있었다. 너무 슬프고 지쳐서 잠이 든 것이다. \v 46 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "왜 자고 있느냐?

pt.L: E, levantando-se da oração [e] vindo aos discípulos, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os encontrou dormindo de tristeza, \v 46 e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Por que vocês estão dormindo?
pt.B: Quando se levantou da oração e voltou aos discípulos, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os encontrou dormindo, esgotados pela tristeza. \v 46 E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes disse: "Por que vocês estão dormindo?
pt.R: Depois Jesus se levantou da oração e voltou para junto dos discípulos. Ele os encontrou dormindo, porque estavam muito cansados e tristes. \v 46 Ele disse a eles: "Por que vocês estão dormindo?

decisions.choice: sleeping from grief: their sorrow wore them out
alternatives: they slept because they did not care
decisions.reason: Luke alone gives this reason; he treats the disciples gently. Deep sorrow can leave people exhausted.

decisions.choice: because they were so tired and sad
decisions.reason: Readable explains how grief led to sleep (m1).

source.text: ἀναστάντες προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν.

records.literal_gloss: Having risen up pray, that not you may enter into temptation.

en.L: Rise up [and] pray, so that you may not enter into temptation."
en.B: Get up and pray, so that you will not come into temptation."
en.R: Get up and pray that you will not give in when you are tested."

es.L: {{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}} [y] {{plural_you:oren|orad}}, para que no {{plural_you:entren|entréis}} en tentación».
es.B: {{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}} y {{plural_you:oren|orad}}, para que no {{plural_you:lleguen|lleguéis}} a caer en la tentación».
es.R: {{plural_you:Levántense|Levantaos}} y {{plural_you:oren|orad}} para que no {{plural_you:se rindan|os rindáis}} cuando {{plural_you:sean probados|seáis probados}}».

fr.L: Levez-vous [et] priez, afin que vous n’entriez pas en tentation. »
fr.B: Levez-vous et priez, pour ne pas entrer en tentation. »
fr.R: Levez-vous et priez pour ne pas céder quand vous serez mis à l’épreuve. »

sw.L: Inukeni [na] mwombe, ili msiingie katika majaribu."
sw.B: Amkeni mwombe, ili msiingie majaribuni."
sw.R: Amkeni mwombe kwamba msishindwe mtakapojaribiwa."

vi.L: Hãy đứng dậy cầu nguyện, để các con không sa vào cám dỗ."
vi.B: Hãy đứng dậy và cầu nguyện, để các con không rơi vào cám dỗ."
vi.R: Hãy dậy và cầu nguyện, để các con không chịu thua khi bị cám dỗ."

ko.L: 일어나서 시험에 들어가지 않도록 기도하여라."
ko.B: 일어나서 시험에 빠지지 않도록 기도하여라."
ko.R: 일어나서 기도하여라. 시험이 닥쳐올 때 넘어가지 않도록 기도하여라."

pt.L: Levantem-se [e] orem, para que não entrem em tentação."
pt.B: Levantem-se e orem, para que vocês não entrem em tentação."
pt.R: Levantem-se e orem para que vocês não cedam quando forem postos à prova."

decisions.choice: pray that you may not enter into temptation: the same command as in 22:40
decisions.reason: Jesus repeats his words from 22:40, so the scene begins and ends with the call to pray.

decisions.choice: give in when you are tested
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom, as in 22:40.

source.text: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ ὄχλος, καὶ ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα προήρχετο αὐτούς, καὶ ἤγγισεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ φιλῆσαι αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: While still of him speaking, look, a crowd, and the [one] being called Judas, one of the Twelve, was going before them, and he drew near to the Jesus to kiss him.

en.L: While {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still speaking, look, a crowd [came], and the one called Judas, one of the Twelve, was going ahead of them; and he came near to Jesus to kiss {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: While {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was still speaking, a crowd appeared. The man called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them, and he came up to Jesus to kiss {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Jesus was still speaking when a crowd of people came. Judas, one of the twelve apostles, was leading them. He walked up to Jesus to kiss {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todavía hablaba, mira, una multitud [llegó], y el llamado Judas, uno de los Doce, iba delante de ellos; y se acercó a Jesús para besarlo.
es.B: Mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todavía estaba hablando, apareció una multitud. El llamado Judas, uno de los Doce, iba al frente, y se acercó a Jesús para besarlo.
es.R: Jesús todavía estaba hablando cuando llegó mucha gente. Judas, uno de los doce apóstoles, los guiaba. Se acercó a Jesús para darle un beso.

fr.L: Tandis qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlait encore, voici une foule, et celui qu’on appelait Judas, l’un des Douze, marchait devant eux ; et il s’approcha de Jésus pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}embrasser.
fr.B: Il parlait encore quand une foule survint. Celui qu’on appelait Judas, l’un des Douze, marchait à sa tête. Il s’approcha de Jésus pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}embrasser.
fr.R: Jésus parlait encore quand une foule de gens est arrivée. Judas, l’un des douze apôtres, marchait devant eux. Il s’est approché de Jésus pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}embrasser.

sw.L: Alipokuwa bado akisema, tazama, umati [ukaja], na yule aitwaye Yuda, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, alikuwa akiwatangulia; naye akamkaribia Yesu ili ambusu.
sw.B: Alipokuwa bado akisema, umati wa watu ukatokea. Yule aitwaye Yuda, mmoja wa wale Kumi na Wawili, alikuwa akiwaongoza, naye akamkaribia Yesu ili ambusu.
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa bado anasema wakati umati wa watu ulipofika. Yuda, mmoja wa mitume kumi na wawili, ndiye aliyekuwa akiwaongoza. Akamwendea Yesu ili ambusu.

vi.L: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đang nói, kìa, có một đám đông [đến], và người tên là Giu-đa, một trong [nhóm] Mười Hai, đi trước họ; ông ta đến gần Đức Giê-xu để hôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đang nói, thì có một đám đông kéo đến. Người tên là Giu-đa, một trong nhóm Mười Hai, dẫn đầu họ. Ông ta tiến lại gần Đức Giê-xu để hôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu còn đang nói thì một đám đông kéo đến. Giu-đa, một trong mười hai môn đồ, dẫn đầu đám đông ấy. Ông ta bước đến gần Đức Giê-xu để hôn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분이 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 보라, 무리가 [왔다]. 그리고 열둘 가운데 하나인 유다라고 하는 사람이 그들보다 앞서 오고 있었다. 그리고 그가 예수께 입을 맞추려고 다가왔다.
ko.B: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에, 한 무리가 나타났다. 열두 제자 가운데 하나인 유다라는 사람이 앞장서서 그들을 이끌고 왔다. 유다는 예수께 입을 맞추려고 다가왔다.
ko.R: 예수께서 아직 말씀하고 계실 때에 많은 사람이 몰려왔다. 열두 제자 가운데 하나인 유다가 그들을 이끌고 있었다. 유다는 예수께 입을 맞추려고 다가왔다.

pt.L: Enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ainda falava, eis que [veio] uma multidão, e o chamado Judas, um dos Doze, ia à frente deles; e ele se aproximou de Jesus para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} beijar.
pt.B: Enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ainda falava, apareceu uma multidão. O homem chamado Judas, um dos Doze, vinha à frente dela e se aproximou de Jesus para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} beijar.
pt.R: Jesus ainda estava falando quando chegou uma multidão. Judas, um dos doze apóstolos, vinha guiando aquela gente. Ele chegou perto de Jesus para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} beijar.

decisions.choice: to kiss him: the usual greeting of a disciple to his teacher
decisions.reason: A kiss was a common greeting among friends and from a pupil to a teacher. Mark says Judas had agreed to use it as a signal (Mark 14:44); Luke lets Jesus' words make the point (22:48).

decisions.choice: one of the Twelve: Luke repeats it to stress the betrayal
decisions.reason: Luke has already said this in 22:3; saying it again underlines that a chosen apostle led the arresting party.

decisions.choice: look (L); not rendered as a separate word, or "now" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Luke uses this word to draw attention to what follows. "Behold" is old-fashioned; Literal says "look", and Balanced and Readable carry the force in the flow of the sentence.

decisions.choice: "hôn" for the kiss
decisions.reason: A disciple's usual greeting to his teacher (meaning decision); the plain word is kept, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:45.

decisions.choice: 무리가 [왔다] (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no verb for the crowd; Korean needs one, which Literal brackets, as in the Korean Mark 14:43.

source.text: Ἰησοῦς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἰούδα, φιλήματι τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδως;

records.literal_gloss: Jesus then said to him, Judas, with a kiss the Son of the Man are you handing over?

en.L: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, with a kiss are you handing over the Son of Man?"
en.B: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, is it with a kiss that you betray the Son of Man?"
en.R: Jesus said to him, "Judas, are you using a kiss, a sign of friendship, to betray the Son of Man?"

es.L: Pero Jesús le dijo: «Judas, ¿con un beso entregas al Hijo del Hombre?».
es.B: Pero Jesús le dijo: «Judas, ¿con un beso traicionas al Hijo del Hombre?».
es.R: Jesús le dijo: «Judas, ¿usas un beso, una señal de amistad, para traicionar al Hijo del Hombre?».

fr.L: Mais Jésus lui dit : « Judas, c’est par un baiser que tu livres le Fils de l’homme ? »
fr.B: Jésus lui dit : « Judas, c’est par un baiser que tu trahis le Fils de l’homme ? »
fr.R: Jésus lui a dit : « Judas, tu utilises un baiser, un signe d’amitié, pour trahir le Fils de l’homme ? »

sw.L: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, "Yuda, kwa busu unamkabidhi Mwana wa Adamu?"
sw.B: Lakini Yesu akamwambia, "Yuda, je, ni kwa busu unamsaliti Mwana wa Adamu?"
sw.R: Yesu akamwambia, "Yuda, unatumia busu, ishara ya urafiki, kumsaliti Mwana wa Adamu?"

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói với ông ta: "Giu-đa, con nộp Con Người bằng một cái hôn sao?"
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói với ông ta: "Giu-đa, con phản bội Con Người bằng một cái hôn sao?"
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với ông ta: "Giu-đa, con dùng cái hôn, là dấu hiệu của tình bạn, để phản bội Con Người sao?"

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "유다야, 입맞춤으로 인자를 넘겨주느냐?"
ko.B: 예수께서 그에게 말씀하셨다. "유다야, 입을 맞추어서 인자를 배반하려느냐?"
ko.R: 예수께서 유다에게 말씀하셨다. "유다야, 친구라는 표시인 입맞춤으로 인자를 배반하느냐?"

pt.L: Mas Jesus lhe disse: "Judas, com um beijo você entrega o Filho do Homem?"
pt.B: Mas Jesus lhe disse: "Judas, é com um beijo que você trai o Filho do Homem?"
pt.R: Jesus disse a ele: "Judas, você está usando um beijo, um sinal de amizade, para trair o Filho do Homem?"

decisions.choice: with a kiss: placed first, to stress the shock
decisions.reason: The Greek puts "with a kiss" first: a sign of love is used to betray.

decisions.choice: betray (B, R); handing over (L)
decisions.reason: As in 22:4, Literal keeps the plain sense of the verb.

decisions.choice: a sign of friendship
decisions.reason: Readable says what the kiss meant (m1 of 22:47).

decisions.choice: "con" for Jesus speaking to Judas
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese John 13:27: Jesus speaks to Judas as to any of his disciples; "ngươi" would make him harsh, which the Greek does not.

source.text: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν τὸ ἐσόμενον εἶπαν· Κύριε, εἰ πατάξομεν ἐν μαχαίρῃ;

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then those around him what would be, they said, Lord, if we will strike with sword?

en.L: And when those around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} saw what was about to happen, they said, "Lord, shall we strike with [the] sword?"
en.B: When those around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"
en.R: Jesus' followers saw what was about to happen. They said, "Lord, should we fight them with our swords?"

es.L: Y viendo los que estaban en torno a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo que iba a suceder, dijeron: «Señor, ¿heriremos a espada?».
es.B: Cuando los que estaban alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vieron lo que iba a pasar, dijeron: «Señor, ¿atacamos con nuestras espadas?».
es.R: Los que estaban con Jesús vieron lo que estaba a punto de pasar. Dijeron: «Señor, ¿peleamos contra ellos con nuestras espadas?».

fr.L: Et ceux qui étaient autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, voyant ce qui allait arriver, dirent : « Seigneur, frapperons-nous de l’épée ? »
fr.B: Voyant ce qui allait se passer, ceux qui étaient autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dirent : « Seigneur, faut-il frapper avec nos épées ? »
fr.R: Les disciples de Jésus ont vu ce qui allait se passer. Ils ont dit : « Seigneur, est-ce qu’on se bat avec nos épées ? »

sw.L: Na wale waliokuwa kandokando {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} walipoona yatakayotokea, wakasema, "Bwana, tupige kwa upanga?"
sw.B: Wale waliokuwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} walipoona kitakachotokea, wakasema, "Bwana, tuwapige kwa panga zetu?"
sw.R: Wafuasi wa Yesu waliona kile kilichokaribia kutokea. Wakasema, "Bwana, tupigane nao kwa panga zetu?"

vi.L: Và những người ở quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thấy điều sắp xảy ra, thì nói: "Lạy Chúa, chúng con có nên dùng gươm mà đánh không?"
vi.B: Những người ở quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy việc sắp xảy ra, thì thưa: "Lạy Chúa, chúng con có nên dùng gươm mà đánh không?"
vi.R: Các môn đồ của Đức Giê-xu thấy điều sắp xảy ra. Họ thưa: "Lạy Chúa, chúng con có nên dùng gươm đánh lại họ không?"

ko.L: 그러자 그분 주위에 있던 사람들이 일어날 일을 보고 말했다. "주님, 저희가 칼로 쳐도 되겠습니까?"
ko.B: 예수 주위에 있던 사람들이 무슨 일이 일어날지 알아차리고 말했다. "주님, 저희가 칼로 쳐도 되겠습니까?"
ko.R: 예수의 제자들은 무슨 일이 일어나려는지 보았다. 그들이 말했다. "주님, 저희가 칼을 써서 싸워도 되겠습니까?"

pt.L: E, vendo os que [estavam] ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} o que ia acontecer, disseram: "Senhor, feriremos à espada?"
pt.B: Quando os que estavam ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} viram o que ia acontecer, disseram: "Senhor, devemos atacar com as nossas espadas?"
pt.R: Os seguidores de Jesus viram o que estava para acontecer. Eles disseram: "Senhor, vamos lutar contra eles com as nossas espadas?"

decisions.choice: if we will strike: a direct question, asking permission
decisions.reason: In the Greek of this time "if" can introduce a direct question.

decisions.choice: those around him: the disciples with him
decisions.reason: These are the apostles who have the two swords (22:38).

decisions.choice: "쳐도 되겠습니까?" for "shall we strike?"
decisions.reason: The question asks permission (meaning decision); "-ㄹ까요" is 해요체, and the disciples keep 합쇼체 to Jesus, so Korean asks whether it is allowed.

source.text: καὶ ἐπάταξεν εἷς τις ἐξ αὐτῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τὸν δοῦλον καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ τὸ δεξιόν.

records.literal_gloss: And struck one certain of them of the high priest the slave and cut off the ear of him the right.

en.L: And a certain one of them struck the slave of the high priest and cut off his right ear.
en.B: And one of them struck the high priest's servant and cut off his right ear.
en.R: One of them swung his sword at the high priest's servant and cut off the man's right ear.

es.L: Y uno de ellos hirió al esclavo del sumo sacerdote y le cortó la oreja derecha.
es.B: Y uno de ellos atacó al siervo del sumo sacerdote y le cortó la oreja derecha.
es.R: Uno de ellos le tiró un golpe con la espada al siervo del sumo sacerdote y le cortó la oreja derecha.

fr.L: Et l’un d’eux frappa l’esclave du grand prêtre et lui emporta l’oreille droite.
fr.B: Et l’un d’eux frappa le serviteur du grand prêtre et lui coupa l’oreille droite.
fr.R: L’un d’eux a donné un coup d’épée au serviteur du grand prêtre et lui a coupé l’oreille droite.

sw.L: Na mmoja wao akampiga mtumwa wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio lake la kulia.
sw.B: Na mmoja wao akampiga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio la kulia.
sw.R: Mmoja wao akampiga kwa upanga mtumishi wa kuhani mkuu, akamkata sikio lake la kulia.

vi.L: Và một người trong số họ đánh nô lệ của thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm và chém đứt tai phải của người ấy.
vi.B: Một người trong số họ chém đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, làm đứt tai phải của anh ta.
vi.R: Một người trong số họ vung gươm chém đầy tớ của thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm và làm đứt tai phải của anh ta.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 가운데 어떤 한 사람이 대제사장의 종을 쳐서 그의 오른쪽 귀를 잘라 버렸다.
ko.B: 그리고 그들 가운데 한 사람이 대제사장의 종을 내리쳐서 그의 오른쪽 귀를 잘라 버렸다.
ko.R: 그들 가운데 한 사람이 대제사장의 종에게 칼을 휘둘러 그의 오른쪽 귀를 잘라 버렸다.

pt.L: E um certo dentre eles feriu o escravo do sumo sacerdote e lhe cortou a orelha direita.
pt.B: E um deles feriu o servo do sumo sacerdote e lhe cortou a orelha direita.
pt.R: Um deles atacou com a espada o servo do sumo sacerdote e cortou a orelha direita do homem.

decisions.choice: slave: a slave owned by the high priest
decisions.reason: The word means a slave. As a high priest's slave he may have held some authority in the household. John gives his name as Malchus and says Peter struck him (John 18:10); Luke names neither.

decisions.choice: his right ear: Luke alone, with John, says which ear
decisions.reason: Luke the careful reporter gives the detail, which also prepares for the healing in 22:51.

decisions.choice: swung his sword at
decisions.reason: Readable says how he struck, from 22:49.

decisions.choice: servant
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: esclavo (L); siervo (B, R)
decisions.reason: A slave owned by the high priest (meaning decision m1). The term used through the Gospels: Literal says what he was, Balanced and Readable say "siervo", as the English says "servant".

decisions.choice: l’esclave (L); le serviteur (B, R); le grand prêtre, with no hyphen
decisions.reason: As in Mark 14:47 and the style guide: Literal keeps "esclave", Balanced and Readable say "serviteur"; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the man was owned.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (L); mtumishi (B, R)
decisions.reason: A slave owned by the high priest (meaning decision m1). The term used through the Gospels: Literal says what he was, Balanced and Readable say "mtumishi", as the English says "servant".

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R); "thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm"
decisions.reason: The style guide's rendering of doulos and of the high priest, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:47 and John 18:10.

decisions.choice: "종" for doulos at every level
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide gives it and the Korean Mark 14:47 has it: "종" names someone owned by a master without the harsh modern picture of "노예", so one word serves where English has "slave" and "servant".

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἐᾶτε ἕως τούτου· καὶ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὠτίου ἰάσατο αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: Having answered then the Jesus said, Permit until this; and having touched the ear he healed him.

en.L: But Jesus answered and said, "Permit [it] as far as this!" And touching the ear, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} healed him.
en.B: But Jesus said, "Enough of this!" And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} touched the man's ear and healed him.
en.R: But Jesus said, "Stop! No more of this!" Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} touched the man's ear and healed him.

es.L: Pero respondiendo Jesús, dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} hasta aquí!». Y tocando la oreja, lo sanó.
es.B: Pero Jesús dijo: «¡Basta de esto!». Y tocó la oreja del hombre y lo sanó.
es.R: Pero Jesús dijo: «¡{{plural_you:Deténganse|Deteneos}}! ¡No más!». Luego tocó la oreja del hombre y lo sanó.

fr.L: Mais Jésus, prenant la parole, dit : « Laissez[-les faire] jusque-là ! » Et ayant touché l’oreille, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le guérit.
fr.B: Mais Jésus dit : « Assez ! Arrêtez ! » Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} toucha l’oreille de l’homme et le guérit.
fr.R: Mais Jésus a dit : « Arrêtez ! Ça suffit ! » Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a touché l’oreille de l’homme et l’a guéri.

sw.L: Lakini Yesu akajibu, akasema, "Acheni hata hapo!" Naye akiligusa sikio, akamponya.
sw.B: Lakini Yesu akasema, "Inatosha hivyo!" Akaligusa sikio la mtu yule, akamponya.
sw.R: Lakini Yesu akasema, "Acheni! Msiendelee tena!" Kisha akaligusa sikio la mtu yule, akamponya.

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu đáp lại và nói: "Hãy để [mặc] đến đây thôi!" Và chạm vào tai người ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành anh ta.
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói: "Thôi, đủ rồi!" Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào tai người ấy và chữa lành anh ta.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Giê-xu nói: "Dừng lại! Đừng làm thế nữa!" Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạm vào tai người ấy và chữa lành cho anh ta.

ko.L: 그러나 예수께서 대답하여 말씀하셨다. "여기까지 [하게] 두어라!" 그리고 그 귀를 만지셔서 그를 고쳐 주셨다.
ko.B: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "이제 그만하여라!" 그리고 그 사람의 귀를 만지셔서 고쳐 주셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서 말씀하셨다. "그만! 더는 이러지 마라!" 그리고 그 사람의 귀를 만지셔서 낫게 해 주셨다.

pt.L: Mas Jesus, respondendo, disse: "Deixem [isso] até aqui!" E, tocando a orelha, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o curou.
pt.B: Mas Jesus disse: "Chega disso!" E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tocou a orelha do homem e o curou.
pt.R: Mas Jesus disse: "Parem! Chega disso!" Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tocou a orelha do homem e o curou.

decisions.choice: permit as far as this: stop, that is enough
alternatives: let them go ahead and arrest me
let me reach the wounded man
decisions.reason: The words are short and unclear. Most likely Jesus tells the disciples to stop. They could also be spoken to those arresting him, asking them to put up with this one blow, or mean "let them have their way".

decisions.choice: he healed him: Jesus does good even to an enemy
decisions.reason: Only Luke tells of this healing. Jesus does what he taught: love your enemies and do good to those who hate you (6:27).

decisions.choice: [it]
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; Literal supplies one in brackets.

decisions.choice: Laissez[-les faire] jusque-là ! (L)
decisions.reason: French "laisser" needs an object and a verb to make sense here; the brackets supply them as the English "[it]" does. The words probably mean "stop, that is enough" (m1), which Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "여기까지 [하게] 두어라" (L); "이제 그만하여라" (B); "그만! 더는 이러지 마라" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom most likely means "stop, that is enough" (meaning decision, footnoted); Literal keeps the Greek "permit as far as this", bracketing the verb Korean needs.

source.text: εἶπεν δὲ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς παραγενομένους ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ στρατηγοὺς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ πρεσβυτέρους· Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων;

records.literal_gloss: Said then Jesus to those having come against him, chief priests and captains of the temple and elders, As against a robber have you come out with swords and clubs?

en.L: Then Jesus said to the chief priests and captains of the temple and elders who had come against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?
en.B: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard and the elders who had come out against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "Did you have to come out with swords and clubs, as if I were a bandit?
en.R: Then Jesus spoke to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard and the elders who had come to arrest {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He said, "Am I a bandit, that you have come out with swords and clubs to get {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}?

es.L: Y dijo Jesús a los que habían venido contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, principales sacerdotes y capitanes del templo y ancianos: «¿Como contra un bandido {{plural_you:han salido|habéis salido}} con espadas y palos?
es.B: Entonces Jesús dijo a los jefes de los sacerdotes, a los oficiales de la guardia del templo y a los ancianos que habían venido contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}: «¿{{plural_you:Tenían|Teníais}} que salir con espadas y palos, como si yo fuera un bandido?
es.R: Entonces Jesús habló a los jefes de los sacerdotes, a los oficiales de la guardia del templo y a los ancianos que habían venido a arrestarlo. Les dijo: «¿Acaso soy un bandido, para que {{plural_you:salgan|salgáis}} con espadas y palos a atraparme?

fr.L: Puis Jésus dit à ceux qui étaient venus contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, chefs des prêtres, commandants du temple et anciens : « Comme contre un brigand, vous êtes sortis avec des épées et des bâtons ?
fr.B: Jésus dit alors aux chefs des prêtres, aux officiers de la garde du temple et aux anciens qui étaient venus contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} : « Fallait-il venir avec des épées et des bâtons, comme si j’étais un bandit ?
fr.R: Ensuite, Jésus a parlé aux chefs des prêtres, aux officiers de la garde du temple et aux anciens qui étaient venus pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}arrêter. Il leur a dit : « Est-ce que je suis un bandit ? Pourquoi êtes-vous venus avec des épées et des bâtons pour {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} prendre ?

sw.L: Naye Yesu akawaambia wakuu wa makuhani na wakuu wa walinzi wa hekalu na wazee waliokuja juu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, "Je, mmetoka kama juu ya mnyang'anyi, mkiwa na panga na marungu?
sw.B: Kisha Yesu akawaambia wakuu wa makuhani, wakuu wa walinzi wa hekalu na wazee waliokuja dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, "Ilibidi mje na panga na marungu, kana kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni mnyang'anyi?
sw.R: Kisha Yesu akasema na wakuu wa makuhani, wakuu wa walinzi wa hekalu na wazee waliokuja kumkamata. Akawaambia, "Je, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni mnyang'anyi, hata mje na panga na marungu kunikamata?

vi.L: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với các thầy tế lễ cả, các viên chỉ huy đền thờ và các trưởng lão đã đến bắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Các người đã đem gươm và gậy ra như [đi bắt] một tên cướp sao?
vi.B: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với các thầy tế lễ cả, các viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ và các trưởng lão đã đến bắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Các người phải đem gươm và gậy đến, như đi bắt một tên cướp sao?
vi.R: Rồi Đức Giê-xu nói với các thầy tế lễ cả, các viên chỉ huy lính canh đền thờ và các trưởng lão đã đến bắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài nói: "Ta là một tên cướp hay sao mà các người đem gươm và gậy đến bắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?

ko.L: 그리고 예수께서 자기에게 맞서 온 대제사장들과 성전 경비대장들과 장로들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 강도에게 하듯이 칼과 몽둥이를 가지고 나왔느냐?
ko.B: 예수께서 자기를 잡으러 나온 대제사장들과 성전 경비대장들과 장로들에게 말씀하셨다. "너희는 강도를 잡듯이 칼과 몽둥이를 들고 나왔느냐?
ko.R: 예수께서 자기를 잡으러 온 대제사장들과 성전 경비대의 대장들과 장로들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 강도라도 된다는 말이냐? 그래서 칼과 몽둥이를 들고 나를 잡으러 왔느냐?

pt.L: Então Jesus disse aos chefes dos sacerdotes, aos capitães do templo e aos anciãos que tinham vindo contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}: "Como contra um bandido vocês saíram, com espadas e porretes?
pt.B: Então Jesus disse aos chefes dos sacerdotes, aos oficiais da guarda do templo e aos anciãos que tinham vindo contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}: "Vocês precisavam sair com espadas e porretes, como se eu fosse um bandido?
pt.R: Então Jesus falou com os chefes dos sacerdotes, os oficiais da guarda do templo e os líderes mais velhos do povo que tinham vindo {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} prender. Ele disse: "Por acaso eu sou um bandido, para vocês virem com espadas e porretes {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pegar?

decisions.choice: robber: a bandit, or a violent rebel
decisions.reason: The word is used of armed robbers on the roads (10:30) and later of rebels against Rome. Jesus is treated like a dangerous man, though he taught openly every day (22:53).

decisions.choice: chief priests, captains of the temple, elders: the leaders of the council came themselves
decisions.reason: Luke says that some of the leaders were there in person with the arresting party.

decisions.choice: captains of the temple: the officers of the temple guard
the officers of the temple guard
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who the captains were (m3).

decisions.choice: "các người" for the leaders; "một tên cướp"
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to opponents, as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:48 and Matthew 26:55, which use the same words for the robber.

decisions.choice: "강도" for lestes at every level
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 14:48 and Matthew 26:55: an armed outlaw (meaning decision); "강도" is plain enough for Readable.

source.text: καθ’ ἡμέραν ὄντος μου μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὐκ ἐξετείνατε τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ ἐμέ· ἀλλ’ αὕτη ἐστὶν ὑμῶν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ἡ ἐξουσία τοῦ σκότους.

records.literal_gloss: Every day being of me with you in the temple not you stretched out the hands against me; but this is of you the hour and the authority of the darkness.

en.L: While I was with you every day in the temple, you did not stretch out [your] hands against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; but this is your hour, and the power of darkness."
en.B: Day after day I was with you in the temple, and you did not lift a hand against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness."
en.R: Every day I was with you in the temple, and you did not try to arrest {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. But this is your time. This is when darkness is allowed to rule."

es.L: Estando yo cada día con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el templo, no {{plural_you:extendieron|extendisteis}} las manos contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; pero esta es {{plural_you:la hora de ustedes|vuestra hora}}, y la autoridad de las tinieblas».
es.B: Día tras día estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el templo, y no {{plural_you:levantaron|levantasteis}} la mano contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Pero esta es {{plural_you:la hora de ustedes|vuestra hora}}, y la del poder de las tinieblas».
es.R: Todos los días estuve con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en el templo, y no {{plural_you:trataron|tratasteis}} de arrestarme. Pero ahora es {{plural_you:el momento de ustedes|vuestro momento}}. Ahora la oscuridad tiene permiso para mandar».

fr.L: Alors que j’étais chaque jour avec vous dans le temple, vous n’avez pas étendu les mains sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; mais c’est votre heure, et le pouvoir des ténèbres. »
fr.B: Jour après jour, j’étais avec vous dans la cour du temple, et vous n’avez pas levé la main sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Mais c’est maintenant votre heure, et le pouvoir des ténèbres. »
fr.R: Tous les jours, j’étais avec vous dans la cour du temple, et vous n’avez pas essayé de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}arrêter. Mais c’est maintenant votre moment. C’est le moment où les ténèbres ont le droit de régner. »

sw.L: Nilipokuwa pamoja nanyi kila siku hekaluni, hamkunyoosha mikono [yenu] juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; lakini hii ndiyo saa yenu, na mamlaka ya giza."
sw.B: Siku baada ya siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi hekaluni, wala hamkuninyooshea mkono. Lakini hii ndiyo saa yenu, na saa ya mamlaka ya giza."
sw.R: Kila siku nilikuwa pamoja nanyi hekaluni, wala hamkujaribu kunikamata. Lakini huu ndio wakati wenu. Huu ndio wakati ambao giza limeruhusiwa kutawala."

vi.L: Khi hằng ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở với các người trong đền thờ, các người đã không giơ tay ra chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; nhưng đây là giờ của các người, và là quyền lực của bóng tối."
vi.B: Ngày nào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ở với các người trong sân đền thờ, vậy mà các người không hề giơ tay bắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nhưng đây là giờ của các người, là lúc bóng tối nắm quyền."
vi.R: Ngày nào {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng ở với các người trong sân đền thờ, nhưng các người không tìm cách bắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nhưng bây giờ là lúc của các người. Đây là lúc bóng tối được phép cai trị."

ko.L: 내가 날마다 성전에서 너희와 함께 있었으나, 너희는 나에게 손을 뻗지 않았다. 그러나 지금은 너희의 때요, 어둠의 권세[의 때]이다."
ko.B: 내가 날마다 성전 뜰에서 너희와 함께 있었지만, 너희는 나에게 손 하나 대지 않았다. 그러나 지금은 너희의 때이고, 어둠이 권세를 부리는 때이다."
ko.R: 나는 날마다 성전 뜰에서 너희와 함께 있었다. 그때는 너희가 나를 붙잡으려 하지 않았다. 그러나 지금은 너희의 때다. 어둠이 다스리도록 허락된 때다."

pt.L: Estando eu todos os dias com vocês no templo, vocês não estenderam as mãos contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; mas esta é a hora de vocês, e o poder das trevas."
pt.B: Dia após dia eu estive com vocês no templo, e vocês não levantaram a mão contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Mas esta é a hora de vocês, e o poder das trevas."
pt.R: Todos os dias eu estava com vocês no templo, e vocês não tentaram {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} prender. Mas esta é a hora de vocês. Este é o momento em que as trevas têm permissão para dominar."

decisions.choice: your hour, and the power of darkness: God allows the leaders and the powers of evil a short time to act
alternatives: their power over Jesus is lasting
decisions.reason: "Darkness" stands for Satan's realm (Acts 26:18; Colossians 1:13). Satan is at work in the betrayal (22:3). This is their hour, but it is only an hour; God's plan stands (22:22).

decisions.choice: power: authority, the right to act
decisions.reason: The word means authority or power to act. It is the authority of darkness for this hour.

decisions.choice: every day: during the days he taught in the temple
decisions.reason: Jesus had taught in the temple each day since he entered Jerusalem (19:47; 21:37).

decisions.choice: try to arrest me
alternatives: stretch out your hands against me
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom.

decisions.choice: This is when darkness is allowed to rule
decisions.reason: Readable says the sense of the phrase in plain words (m1).

decisions.choice: la autoridad (L); el poder (B)
decisions.reason: The authority, the right to act, that God allows the powers of evil for a short time (meaning decisions m1, m2). Literal keeps "autoridad", the word for this Greek term through the Gospels; Balanced says "poder", as the English does. "Potestad" is old-fashioned.

decisions.choice: le temple (L); la cour du temple (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the whole temple area, where Jesus taught in the courts, as in 2:27; Balanced and Readable say where he was.

decisions.choice: "đền thờ" (L); "sân đền thờ" (B, R) for hieron
decisions.reason: As the style guide gives for hieron, and as in the Vietnamese Mark 14:49: Jesus taught in the temple courts.

decisions.choice: "là lúc bóng tối nắm quyền" (B)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "giờ của các người và quyền lực của bóng tối" joins two unlike nouns awkwardly; Balanced says that the hour is the time when darkness holds power (meaning decision), which Literal keeps word for word.

decisions.choice: "성전" (L), "성전 뜰" (B, R) for hieron; "때" for hora
decisions.reason: As the Korean John and Mark 14:49 do for hieron: he taught in the temple courts. "때" keeps the hour as an appointed time, as in 22:14.

decisions.choice: "어둠의 권세[의 때]" (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek joins "your hour" and "the power of darkness" under one verb; Korean reads "the power" as a second time only with the noun repeated, which Literal brackets.

source.text: Συλλαβόντες δὲ αὐτὸν ἤγαγον καὶ εἰσήγαγον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως· ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει μακρόθεν.

records.literal_gloss: Having seized then him they led away and led into the house of the high priest; the and Peter was following from a distance.

en.L: And seizing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, they led [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] away and brought [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] into the house of the high priest; and Peter was following from a distance.
en.B: They seized {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, led {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} away and brought {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} into the high priest's house. Peter followed at a distance.
en.R: They arrested Jesus and took {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} away to the high priest's house. Peter followed them, staying far behind.

es.L: Y después de prenderlo, se [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] llevaron y [{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}] hicieron entrar en la casa del sumo sacerdote; y Pedro seguía de lejos.
es.B: Ellos {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} arrestaron, se {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaron y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} metieron en la casa del sumo sacerdote. Pedro seguía de lejos.
es.R: Arrestaron a Jesús y se {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} llevaron a la casa del sumo sacerdote. Pedro iba detrás, pero muy lejos.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ayant saisi, ils [{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}]emmenèrent et [{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}] firent entrer dans la maison du grand prêtre ; et Pierre suivait de loin.
fr.B: Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}arrêtèrent, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}emmenèrent et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} conduisirent dans la maison du grand prêtre. Pierre suivait à distance.
fr.R: Ils ont arrêté Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont emmené dans la maison du grand prêtre. Pierre les a suivis, mais il restait loin derrière.

sw.L: Na wakimkamata, walimchukua, wakamwingiza katika nyumba ya kuhani mkuu; naye Petro alikuwa akifuata kwa mbali.
sw.B: Walimkamata, wakamchukua, wakamwingiza nyumbani kwa kuhani mkuu. Petro akafuata kwa mbali.
sw.R: Walimkamata Yesu, wakampeleka nyumbani kwa kuhani mkuu. Petro aliwafuata, lakini alibaki nyuma mbali.

vi.L: Và bắt lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, họ dẫn [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đi và đưa [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] vào nhà thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm; còn Phi-e-rơ đi theo từ xa.
vi.B: Họ bắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giải đi và đưa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào nhà thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. Phi-e-rơ đi theo từ đằng xa.
vi.R: Họ bắt Đức Giê-xu và giải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến nhà thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm. Phi-e-rơ đi theo họ, nhưng ông đi cách xa phía sau.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그분을 붙잡아 끌고 가서 대제사장의 집으로 데리고 들어갔다. 그런데 베드로는 멀리서 따라가고 있었다.
ko.B: 그들은 예수를 붙잡아 끌고 가서 대제사장의 집으로 데리고 들어갔다. 베드로는 멀찍이 떨어져서 따라갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 예수를 붙잡아 대제사장의 집으로 끌고 갔다. 베드로는 멀리 떨어져서 그 뒤를 따라갔다.

pt.L: E, prendendo-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}, [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] levaram e [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] fizeram entrar na casa do sumo sacerdote; e Pedro seguia de longe.
pt.B: Eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} prenderam, {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levaram dali e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conduziram para dentro da casa do sumo sacerdote. Pedro ia atrás, à distância.
pt.R: Eles prenderam Jesus e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} levaram para a casa do sumo sacerdote. Pedro foi atrás deles, mas ficou bem para trás.

decisions.choice: the high priest: Caiaphas, though Luke does not name him here
decisions.reason: Luke names Annas and Caiaphas together as high priests (3:2). Caiaphas held the office then (Matthew 26:57); John says Jesus was first taken to Annas (John 18:13).
